story.title: The Moon Priestess guarding the Azrya Woodlands
story.lore: Born at the end of the Era of Strife, Miya bore witness to the unspeakable tragedies that befell the elves during the Endless War. She saw how the Abyss defiled the Shadow Swamp and corrupted many of her people into Dark Elves. It was not until the Moon Goddess created the Lunar Aegis over Azrya that the Moon Elves were able to thrive again under its protection. Miya became the Priestess of the Moon, and for thousands of years she served faithfully in the Lunar Temple, diligently watching over her people. However, with the continued expansion of the Abyss and its dark legions, the Land of Dawn is once again shrouded by the fog of war. From the Moonlit Forest, a call to war that has not been heard in thousands of years sounded again. Miya took up her silver bow and swore by the light of the moon to fight for her people.

skills.desc: Each time Miya hits a target with her Basic Attack Basic Attack, she gains 5% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times. After reaching full stacks, Miya summons a Moonlight Shadow with each Basic Attack that deals 30 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

Miya shoots two extra arrows with each Basic Attack Basic Attack, dealing 10–35 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target enemy and 30% damage to nearby targets. This effect lasts 4 seconds. Each extra arrow inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

Miya launches an empowered arrow on the target area, dealing 270–420 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds. The arrow then splits into 6 scattering minor arrows, each dealing 40–105 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

Miya removes all debuffs on her and conceals herself, gaining 65% extra Movement Speed. This state lasts 2 seconds or until she launches an attack. Miya gains full stacks of Moon Blessing upon leaving the state.

story.title: The Orc Warrior who bathes in the blood of his enemies
story.lore: Balmond is a fearsome half-orc warrior whose battle lust knows no bounds. Born into a savage tribe on the outskirts of the Land of Dawn, he learned early that only strength matters. In every battle, Balmond grows stronger as the blood of his enemies spills — a terrifying trait that has made him both celebrated and feared among his kin. When the wars for the Land of Dawn began to intensify, Balmond set out not for glory or gold, but simply for the thrill of battle. He fights on whichever side promises the most carnage, and in the chaos of war, he has found his truest calling.

skills.desc: Balmond restores 4% of his Max HP when he kills a minion, and 10% of his Max HP when he kills a hero.

Balmond charges in the target direction, dealing 150–300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies he passes through and slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds. This skill can be used again within 5 seconds to deal 120–240 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to a single target and briefly stun them.
Balmond spins his axe, continuously dealing 60–85 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to surrounding enemies. Deals 120% damage to monsters. Lasts 3 seconds.

Balmond raises his axe and cleaves forward in a fan-shaped area, dealing 350–550 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies hit. Deals additional true damage equal to 20%–30% of enemies' missing HP (up to 1000 against monsters).

story.title: The cyborg swordsman hunting his forgotten past
story.lore: Saber was once a renowned swordsman, a master of his craft. After a catastrophic defeat that cost him his body, he was rebuilt as a cyborg by a mysterious organization known only as the Laboratory. His humanity stripped away and his memories fragmented, Saber serves as a deadly weapon — but somewhere beneath the cold metal exterior, the ghost of the man he once was still lingers. He wanders the Land of Dawn seeking answers about his past, cutting down anyone who stands between him and the truth.

skills.desc: Each of Saber's Basic Attacks reduces the target's Physical Defense by 6 for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times for a maximum reduction of 30.

Saber summons 5 flying swords to orbit around him for 5 seconds. Each sword deals 100–175 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage when it flies out to a nearby enemy. The swords are released one by one when Saber deals damage with his Basic Attack or skills.
Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 150–250 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

Saber dashes to the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne and dealing 3 instances of 200–350 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage over a short duration. The target cannot act during this time.

story.title: The immortal Queen of the Abyss who feasts on human blood
story.lore: Alice is no ordinary mage — she is a centuries-old being of immense dark power who feeds on the life force of the living. Having conquered death itself, she rules over the Abyss as its queen, commanding legions of shadows and demons. Her beauty belies her monstrous nature; she lures the unwary with grace and elegance before consuming their very essence. Alice has existed since the earliest conflicts of the Land of Dawn, and she intends to outlast them all. She enters battles not out of necessity, but for the sheer pleasure of feeding — and to ensure that no power in the world grows strong enough to threaten her eternal reign.

skills.desc: Whenever a nearby enemy minion dies, Alice absorbs its soul orb, permanently increasing her Max HP by 10. After collecting 15 orbs, she also permanently gains 5 Magic Power.

Alice fires a blood orb in the target direction, dealing 250–400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit. Alice can then teleport to the orb's location within 3.5 seconds. Enemies hit are also slowed by 30% for 2 seconds.

Alice toggles this ability to unleash dark magic, dealing 100–130 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds. While active, she restores 70–90 (+10% Total Magic Power) HP for each enemy hit. Costs 50 HP per second while active.

Alice deals 400–600 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and slows them by 60% for 2 seconds. She also gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP and 30% extra Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

story.title: The cheerful leonin mage with a transforming magical companion
story.lore: Nana is a young leonin girl with a gift for magic that far exceeds her years. Carefree and playful, she rarely takes things seriously — much to the exasperation of those around her. Her constant companion is Molina, a magical cat-like creature she conjured herself, who shares her mischievous spirit. Though she may seem like a simple village girl, Nana's magical potential is extraordinary. When her home was threatened by dark forces encroaching on the leonin village, she took up her staff not with a war cry, but with a cheerful grin — and set off to protect the people she loves in her own uniquely chaotic way.

skills.desc: When Nana's HP drops below 30%, Molina will automatically protect her, granting a shield that absorbs up to 600–1500 (+150% Total Magic Power) damage for 2 seconds and briefly making her untargetable. This effect has a 90-second cooldown.

Nana launches Molina in the target direction, dealing 250–400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies along the path. Molina then returns to Nana, dealing the same damage again to enemies on the return path.
Nana commands Molina to pounce on the target area after a short delay, transforming the first enemy hero hit into an adorable Molina for 2 seconds. While transformed, the enemy cannot act.

Nana summons Molina to charge in the target direction 3 times in a fan-shaped pattern. Each charge deals 300–500 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows enemies by 70% for 1.5 seconds. Enemies hit by all three charges are briefly stunned.

story.title: The legendary commander of the Moniyan Empire's Imperial Guard
story.lore: Tigreal is the greatest warrior of the Moniyan Empire, commander of the Imperial Knights and the most feared soldier on the battlefield. Renowned for his unyielding sense of justice and iron will, he has dedicated his life to protecting the people of Moniyan from the forces of darkness. Having survived countless battles against the Abyss and its demon legions, Tigreal bears both the scars and the medals of a lifetime of service. Though some see him as a relic of a simpler era, Tigreal's resolve has never wavered. When the Land of Dawn trembled once more under the shadow of evil, he donned his golden armor and raised his sword — as he always has, and always will.

skills.desc: Each time an ally or Tigreal is shielded or healed, Tigreal gains a Sacred Orb (up to 5). Each orb increases his Physical Defense by 5 and Magic Defense by 5.

Tigreal dashes in the target direction, dealing 200–350 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies along the path and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Can be used twice in quick succession.

Tigreal charges in the target direction, dealing 150–300 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking back all enemies hit. If knocked-back enemies collide with terrain, they are stunned for 1 second.

Tigreal plunges his sword into the ground, pulling all nearby enemies toward him and dealing 270–430 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. After a brief delay, the enemies are stunned for 1.5 seconds.

story.title: The demon hunter who wields demonic power to destroy demons
story.lore: Raised by the Church of Light after his village was destroyed by demons, Alucard grew up with one purpose — to hunt and destroy every demon he could find. Trained as a warrior-priest, he wielded the sacred powers of the light with fierce precision. But the more demons he slew, the more he was exposed to their essence, and slowly that darkness began to seep into him. Rather than shun this power, Alucard chose to harness it, believing that fighting darkness with darkness was the only way to truly win. He walks a razor's edge between the light that raised him and the abyss that calls to him — a demon hunter who is slowly becoming something more.

skills.desc: After using a skill, Alucard's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 1.2× damage and locks onto the target, chasing them a short distance. This also grants Alucard 15% Spell Vamp for 3 seconds.
Alucard leaps to the target area, dealing 270–395 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies hit. If only one enemy is hit, this skill deals 1.5× damage.
Alucard slashes all nearby enemies in a 360° swing, dealing 270–395 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds.

Alucard marks the target enemy hero and locks onto them. For the next 6 seconds, his Basic Attacks and skills deal an additional 300–500 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the marked target. He also gains 90% Spell Vamp during this period. Only one target can be marked at a time.

story.title: The twin-blade dark elf assassin who feeds on the fallen
story.lore: Karina is a dark elf assassin who grew up in the Shadow Swamp — a place corrupted by the Abyss long before she was born. Where others saw the corruption as a curse, Karina learned to embrace it, honing her twin blades and dark magic into a lethal art form. Silent and efficient, she kills not out of hatred but with a detached professionalism that makes her all the more terrifying. She has forged an uneasy alliance with the forces that oppose the Abyss, seeing them as a more interesting employer than the demons themselves. She follows the coin and the challenge, and she has never failed to deliver.

skills.desc: Every 2 non-ultimate skills Karina uses marks the next Basic Attack to deal 180–250 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. When Karina kills or assists in killing an enemy hero, all her skill cooldowns are reset.

Karina enters a dance state, dodging Basic Attacks for 2 seconds. During this state, she can dash through the target enemy twice with Dance of Death, each hit dealing 175–275 (+55% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Karina spins her blades around herself, dealing 250–400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and healing herself for 30% of the damage dealt to enemy heroes.

Karina leaps at the target enemy hero, dealing 450–700 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. If this kills the target, the cooldown is immediately reset. If the target dies within 3 seconds of being hit, the cooldown is also reset.

story.title: The wandering panda warrior mastering the art of the drum
story.lore: Akai grew up in a remote mountain monastery, trained from birth in the ancient panda warrior traditions. Unlike the fierce soldiers of the lowlands, his people's art of war was rooted in rhythm — the beat of the war drum dictating the flow of battle. Akai mastered the drum and the body techniques that accompanied it, turning his rotund frame into a whirling weapon of unstoppable force. Despite his intimidating abilities, Akai is warm-hearted and jovial, quick with a laugh and even quicker with a spinning tackle. He joined the fight for the Land of Dawn after his monastery was threatened, and he brings with him a relentless, bouncy chaos that few enemies can contain.

skills.desc: Each time Akai uses a skill, he gains a stack of Rhythm, with each stack granting 4% extra Movement Speed. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 4 seconds.
Akai dashes in the target direction. If he hits an enemy, he deals 250–400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, briefly tossing them into the air.
Akai headbutts the target enemy, dealing 200–350 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them back. If the target collides with terrain, they are stunned for 1 second.

Akai spins rapidly for up to 3.5 seconds, pushing all nearby enemies away and dealing 100–160 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per second. He is immune to crowd control while spinning and can be directed by the player. Enemies pushed into terrain receive bonus damage and are briefly stunned.

story.title: The ice-blooded Viking berserker from the frozen north
story.lore: Franco hails from the frozen wastes of the far north, where only the strong survive the brutal winters and constant monster attacks. Born into a Viking clan of fearsome warriors, he earned his place at the head of his tribe through sheer brute force and an almost supernatural tolerance for cold. Franco's hook is legendary — he forged it himself from the bones of a frost giant he slew with his bare hands. He is not a man of strategy or subtlety; he is a force of nature who drags enemies to their doom and crushes them underfoot. He came to the Land of Dawn when the fighting reached his frozen shores, and he has been enjoying himself ever since.

skills.desc: Franco continuously regenerates 2% of his Max HP per second when out of combat for more than 2 seconds.

Franco throws his hook in the target direction, dealing 500–800 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and dragging them to his location. The hook can be retracted early by using this skill again. If the hook hits a minion or creep, Franco is pulled toward it instead.

Franco slams his hook down, dealing 150–300 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1.5 seconds. Franco also gains 60% extra Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds.

Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 2 seconds, repeatedly slashing them and dealing 180–280 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 8 times. The target is unable to act during this time. Nearby allies are notified when Franco begins this ability.

story.title: The cursed pirate king who commands the power of the sea
story.lore: Bane was once the most feared pirate to sail the seas of the Land of Dawn. Known as the Frozen King, he commanded a vast armada and plundered every shore he could reach. His endless hunger for power led him to the Twisted Trench, a place of ancient sea magic, where he made a pact with a primordial sea deity. The power he gained was immense — but so was the price. The curse twisted his body and bound his fate to the ocean forever. Now Bane sails not for treasure but to feed the insatiable hunger of the power within him, unleashing tidal waves and toxic grog upon any who dare oppose him.

skills.desc: Bane's Basic Attacks and skills apply Rum to enemies, stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, the target takes 4–7% of their Max HP as extra Magic Damage (once per second). Bane also gains 30 HP per second for each nearby enemy minion while Shark Bite is active.

Bane imbues his anchor with sea power, causing his next Basic Attack to deal 120–195 (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+50% Total Magic Power) bonus Mixed Damage to enemies in a cone in front of him, and slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. During Shark Bite, minions killed by his Basic Attacks release a healing wave that restores 220–370 (+80% Total Magic Power) HP to the nearest ally.

Bane calls forth a tidal wave in the target direction, dealing 300–480 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in its path and pushing them back. The wave deals 1.5× damage to enemy structures.

Bane summons a massive school of sharks to crash down in the target area after a short delay, dealing 450–700 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds. Each enemy hit generates a shockwave that deals 150–250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

story.title: The bionic-legged street footballer turned battlefield hero
story.lore: Bruno grew up on the streets, where football was everything. A prodigy with a ball, he dreamed of playing on the biggest stages in the Land of Dawn — until a terrible accident crushed his legs and shattered those dreams. Left for dead by those who once cheered for him, Bruno was found by a brilliant engineer who rebuilt his legs with cutting-edge bionic technology, giving him a kick far more powerful than any human could achieve. Rather than return to the pitch, Bruno channeled his newfound power into protecting the people the world had forgotten — people like the boy he once was. He fights not for glory, but for those who never had a chance.

skills.desc: Bruno's Critical Chance is converted: for every 1% Critical Chance, he gains 1% extra Attack Speed instead (up to a conversion cap). His Basic Attacks against the same target build Weakening stacks, each reducing the target's Physical Defense by 3. Stacks up to 5 times.

Bruno kicks an energy ball in the target direction, dealing 250–450 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path. The ball bounces off walls and units up to 4 times. Each bounce reduces the damage by 10%.

Bruno leaps to the target location, performing a bicycle kick that deals 150–300 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and briefly knocking them back. After landing, his next Basic Attack has enhanced range and deals bonus damage.

Bruno kicks a giant energy ball forward, dealing 350–600 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path and knocking them back. The ball grows larger with each enemy hero it hits, dealing increased damage and applying greater knockback. Enemies hit are also slowed by 40% for 2 seconds.

story.title: The lone gunslinger riding the frontier in search of justice
story.lore: Clint is a wandering gunslinger from the Western Expanse, a lawless frontier where justice is whatever the fastest draw says it is. Raised by a sheriff father who was gunned down by outlaws, Clint took up his father's revolver and vowed to bring order to the chaos. He rides alone, taking bounties and settling scores across the Land of Dawn — never staying in one place long enough to call it home. Beneath the brim of his hat and behind those cold eyes is a man who has seen too much to believe in anything but the weight of a pistol and the clarity of a clean shot.

skills.desc: After using a skill, Clint's next Basic Attack fires an extra projectile that deals 80–200 (+60% Total Physical Attack) bonus Physical Damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5 seconds.
Clint fires a penetrating shot in the target direction, dealing 250–450 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in a line. Enemies hit are also slowed by 30% for 1 second.

Clint fires a trap shot at the target location. If an enemy steps on it, they are immobilized for 1.2 seconds and take 150–250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Clint can place up to 2 traps at a time.

Clint rapidly fires 6 explosive rounds at the target area over 2 seconds, each dealing 250–400 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the impact zone. Each round also briefly slows enemies hit by 40%.

story.title: The fallen angel of light walking the path of redemption
story.lore: Rafaela was once a high-ranking angel in the Celestial Palace, tasked with guarding the balance between light and darkness in the Land of Dawn. When a moment of compassion led her to defy divine law — sparing a mortal who was meant to die — she was cast out and stripped of her full celestial power. Now she walks among mortals, using what power remains to her to heal the wounded and protect the innocent. Her fall from grace has made her more human than divine, and in that humanity she has found a purpose far more meaningful than anything the Celestial Palace ever gave her.

skills.desc: After Rafaela uses a skill, her next Basic Attack deals an additional 200–350 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows the target by 30% for 1 second.

Rafaela calls down holy light on the target area, dealing 250–400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies and revealing them for 3 seconds. Allies in the area are healed for 200–350 (+70% Total Magic Power) HP.
Rafaela channels healing energy to herself and the most injured nearby ally, restoring 350–600 (+100% Total Magic Power) HP to each target and granting them 30% extra Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

Rafaela strikes all enemies in front of her with sacred light in a wide beam, dealing 400–650 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, slowing them by 80% for 1.5 seconds, and then stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

story.title: The electromancer prodigy who left the Magic Academy to seek her own path
story.lore: Eudora was the most gifted student the Magic Academy had seen in a generation. Her mastery of lightning magic came naturally, almost frighteningly so, and the professors struggled to keep pace with her rapid advancement. But the Academy's rigid structure and bureaucratic rules felt like a cage to her restless mind. After a particularly explosive falling-out with the Academy's headmaster, Eudora left — taking nothing but her staff and her crackling ambition. She roams the Land of Dawn, honing her craft through real combat rather than textbook exercises, and proving to anyone who doubts her that raw talent, properly unleashed, is a force beyond measure.

skills.desc: Eudora's skills apply Superconductor to enemy heroes for 4 seconds. While a target has Superconductor, they take 15% more Magic Damage from Eudora's skills and her next skill that hits them will deal bonus chain lightning damage to nearby enemies.
Eudora fires a ball of electricity at the target enemy, dealing 280–480 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 1–1.5 seconds. Applies Superconductor.

Eudora releases an electric pulse around herself, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. If the target has Superconductor, the pulse also chains to up to 2 nearby enemies.

Eudora calls down a massive bolt of lightning on the target enemy, dealing 600–1000 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. If the target has Superconductor, the bolt splits and chains to up to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 70% of the damage to each.

story.title: The dragon warrior carrying the sacred spear of his ancestors
story.lore: Zilong is a descendant of the legendary Dragon Warriors, an ancient order sworn to protect the Land of Dawn from chaos. Raised in the Dragon Shrine high in the mountains, he trained from childhood with the sacred dragon spear passed down through his lineage. When the shrine was attacked by forces of darkness and his master was killed, Zilong took the spear and descended from the mountain for the first time in his life — not just to avenge his master, but to fulfill the ancient oath of his order. He is disciplined, honorable, and ferociously skilled, a warrior who moves like water and strikes like thunder.

skills.desc: Every 3rd Basic Attack from Zilong strikes twice, dealing bonus Physical Damage equal to 100% of his Basic Attack damage. This double strike also applies on-hit effects.
Zilong dashes to the target enemy and flips them over his shoulder, dealing 300–500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly airborne-ing the target.
Zilong charges his spear and unleashes a powerful thrust forward, dealing 250–450 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in a line and knocking them back.

Zilong enters a heightened battle state for 6 seconds, gaining 30%–50% Attack Speed, 20%–30% Movement Speed, and immunity to slows. His Dragon Flurry passive triggers on every 2nd Basic Attack instead of every 3rd during this state.

story.title: The cable-swinging sky pirate who fights for freedom above all else
story.lore: Fanny grew up in the floating sky city of the Western Expanse, where freedom meant living above the clouds and beyond the reach of anyone who wanted to control you. Her father, a renowned aerial engineer, taught her the cable-blade combat style he invented — a brutal, acrobatic fighting technique that turns the battlefield into a three-dimensional chessboard. When the sky city was seized by corrupt nobles, Fanny refused to submit. She took her cables, her twin blades, and her fiery spirit, and declared herself a pirate of the open sky. She fights on her own terms, and she always will.

skills.desc: Fanny gains 10 Energy when she hits an enemy with a Basic Attack. Hitting an enemy in the air restores an additional 5 Energy. When Fanny's Energy is full, her next Basic Attack deals bonus Physical Damage equal to 10% of the target's current HP.
Fanny spins and deals 250–400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all nearby enemies. This skill consumes 20 Energy and is primarily used to build stacks for Fanny's cable dashes.

Fanny launches a cable in the target direction, swinging through the air and dealing 200–350 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies she passes through. Each subsequent cable cast within 3 seconds deals 15% more damage. Costs 25 Energy per use.

Fanny locks onto the target enemy hero and rapidly slashes them 5 times, dealing 100–180 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per slash. The target is briefly slowed. If Fanny kills or assists a hero within 5 seconds of using this ability, its cooldown is reduced by 70%.

story.title: The cheerful engineer whose plasma cannon packs more punch than she looks
story.lore: Layla is a young engineer and inventor from a small town on the outskirts of the Moniyan Empire. Gifted with a brilliant mechanical mind and an optimistic personality that refuses to be dampened by reality, she built her signature plasma cannon almost entirely by accident — an experiment gone gloriously right. She joined the battle for the Land of Dawn not because she craves conflict, but because she saw an opportunity to test her inventions in the field and maybe, just maybe, do some good in the process. She may look like she wandered into the wrong war, but her cannon hits harder the farther the target — and Layla has excellent aim.

skills.desc: Layla's Basic Attack range and Basic Attack damage increase progressively as the battle progresses, up to a maximum of 30% extra range and 35% extra damage after being in combat for a certain duration. Her skills also gain increased range alongside her Basic Attacks.
Layla fires an energy bomb in the target direction, dealing 200–370 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

Layla fires an energy orb that creates a small void field on impact, dealing 150–300 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 60% for 2 seconds. The field lingers briefly, slowing enemies who enter it.

Layla charges her cannon to full power and fires a massive energy beam across the entire map in the target direction, dealing 400–700 (+200% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

story.title: The raging labyrinth guardian who fights to master the beast within
story.lore: The Minotaur was born from the ancient magic of the Labyrinth, a being of immense physical power and equally immense inner turmoil. Feared by all who encounter him, he has spent most of his life in isolation, shunned for his terrifying appearance and the berserker rage that overwhelms him in battle. A chance encounter with a wise elder who saw past his monstrous exterior gave him a new purpose — to channel his rage into protection rather than destruction. The Minotaur now fights as a guardian, using his fury as a weapon while desperately holding onto the sliver of peace his elder taught him to find.

skills.desc: Minotaur builds Rage when taking damage or dealing damage. At full Rage, he enters Enrage mode, increasing his size, Movement Speed by 15%, and empowering all his skills. Rage decays when out of combat.

Minotaur stomps the ground, dealing 150–300 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. While Enraged, this skill also heals nearby allies for 300–500 (+80% Total Magic Power) HP.

Minotaur lets out a powerful roar, granting nearby allies a shield equal to 8% of their Max HP and increasing their Movement Speed by 20% for 2 seconds. While Enraged, the shield is doubled and nearby enemies are also briefly slowed.

Minotaur leaps into the air and repeatedly slams down on the target area for up to 3 seconds, dealing 200–350 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per slam to all enemies in the area and knocking them back. While Enraged, the final slam launches enemies into the air for 1.5 seconds. Minotaur can move during this ability.

story.title: The hammer-wielding steel elf guardian with a heart of gold
story.lore: Lolita is a young elf from a family of renowned engineers who craft mechanical marvels for the Moniyan Empire. Trained since childhood alongside her elder brother Leomord, she developed not only mechanical genius but a fierce, protective spirit that made her the unofficial guardian of her village. When her home came under threat, Lolita strapped on her mechanical guardian armor and took up her massive hammer — a weapon she built herself — to stand between her people and harm. Cheerful, energetic, and almost worryingly enthusiastic about hitting things, Lolita is the kind of tank who makes her enemies question their life choices.

skills.desc: Lolita passively charges her shield by moving. When fully charged, her next Basic Attack deals 220–320 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.5 seconds.

Lolita charges forward, dealing 150–300 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in her path. She then raises her shield, blocking all incoming projectiles from the front for 3 seconds. Allies behind Lolita are also protected from projectiles.

Lolita channels energy in her shield and releases it, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in front of her and slowing them by 50% for 1.5 seconds. If Lolita blocked any projectiles with Guardian's Bulwark, this skill deals extra damage for each projectile blocked, up to 3 stacks.

After a brief channel, Lolita calls down a powerful energy strike on the target area, dealing 400–650 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies hit and stunning them for 2 seconds. Allies in the area are warned before the strike lands.

story.title: The shadow ninja torn between his clan's dark legacy and his own honor
story.lore: Hayabusa is a master ninja of the Shadow Clan, an ancient order that has served the darkness for generations. Trained from birth in the lethal arts of ninjutsu and shadow-stepping, Hayabusa was the clan's greatest prodigy — until he began to question whether their cause was just. When he discovered that the clan's true masters were servants of the Abyss, he turned against them, earning a death sentence from the very order that raised him. Now hunted by his former brothers, Hayabusa walks alone, using the shadow techniques they taught him to fight against the darkness they serve. He is a ghost on the battlefield — silent, precise, and merciless.

skills.desc: For each shadow Hayabusa has placed on the battlefield, he gains 4% Spell Vamp. Shadows can be placed by landing skills on enemies. Up to 4 shadows can be active at once.

Hayabusa throws 3 shurikens in a fan pattern, each dealing 160–260 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and ricocheting back to him. Each returning shuriken restores 30 Energy and places a shadow on enemies hit.

Hayabusa dashes in the target direction and creates a shadow at the destination. He can reactivate this skill to teleport to any of his active shadows. Dashing through an enemy deals 180–280 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and places a shadow on them.

Hayabusa becomes untargetable and rapidly slashes all nearby enemies that have his shadows on them 6 times, dealing 100–180 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per slash, for a total of 600–1080 damage to each marked target. Enemies with more shadows take increased damage per hit.

story.title: The Valkyrie warrior descended from the heavens to forge her own legend
story.lore: Freya is a Valkyrie — one of the divine warrior maidens of the Northern Vale who escort the souls of fallen heroes to the afterlife. Unlike her sisters, who were content with their sacred duty, Freya yearned for the thrill of battle itself. When a catastrophic war in the Land of Dawn threatened to overwhelm the mortal realm, she descended from the heavens without permission, driven by an unquenchable hunger to fight alongside the greatest warriors of the age. Cast out from the Valkyrie order for her defiance, she roams the battlefield with her twin blades and divine shield, carving her own legend — one she intends to be worthy of the songs they will one day sing about her.

skills.desc: Every 2 Basic Attacks, Freya leaps into the air and crashes down on the target, dealing bonus Physical Damage equal to 100% of her Basic Attack to nearby enemies and briefly knocking them airborne.

Freya leaps to the target location, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in the landing area and knocking them airborne for 0.8 seconds. Sacred Orbs are generated for each enemy hit.

Freya charges forward with her shield, dealing 150–280 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in her path and knocking them back. She then follows up with a sweeping strike, dealing an additional 150–280 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

Freya consumes all Sacred Orbs to enter a divine battle state for 6 seconds, gaining Attack Speed, Movement Speed, and enhanced versions of her skills. Each Sacred Orb consumed increases her Physical Attack by 15. During this state, her passive triggers on every Basic Attack rather than every 2nd.

story.title: The eccentric arcane professor who treats every battle as an experiment
story.lore: Gord is the foremost authority on arcane theory at the Magic Academy, a man whose brilliance is matched only by his complete disregard for conventional safety practices. His lectures are as likely to end in a controlled explosion as a coherent conclusion, and his laboratory has been rebuilt three times following incidents he cheerfully refers to as 'productive accidents.' When dark forces began threatening the stability of arcane ley lines across the Land of Dawn, Gord declared it a matter of academic urgency and marched off to investigate — staff in hand, notebooks under arm, students strongly advised not to follow. He fights with the detached curiosity of a man who finds even the most dangerous battle primarily interesting as a data point.

skills.desc: When Gord deals damage to the same target 5 times, a Mystic Projectile is summoned to strike that target, dealing 230–330 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Gord fires a ball of mystic energy in the target direction, dealing 270–420 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and stunning them for 1 second.
Gord conjures a mystic field at the target location for 4 seconds, dealing 120–195 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 seconds and slowing them by 30%.

Gord channels a powerful beam of mystic energy in the target direction for up to 3 seconds, dealing 220–370 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second to all enemies in the beam. He can rotate the beam while channeling. This ability can be interrupted early.

story.title: The Church's silent blade who hunts demons from the shadows
story.lore: Natalia was taken in by the Church of Light as an orphaned child and trained in their most secretive division — a group of shadow operatives who do what the Church's public face cannot. Her target: demons, corrupted mages, and anyone who threatens the stability of the holy order. Raised without a past and given only a mission, Natalia became the Church's most effective assassin, operating in total silence, leaving no witnesses and no evidence. But the more she learned about the Church's darker dealings, the more her loyalty began to fracture. She still hunts demons — she has simply broadened her definition of what counts as a demon.

skills.desc: When no enemies are nearby and Natalia is in a bush, she enters Stealth after 2 seconds, becoming invisible and gaining 15% Movement Speed. Her first Basic Attack out of Stealth deals bonus Physical Damage and silences the target for 1 second. Stealth is broken upon attacking or taking damage.

Natalia dashes to the target enemy, dealing 230–380 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If this kills the target or the target is a minion/monster, the cooldown is immediately reset. Costs 30 Energy.

Natalia throws a smoke bomb at the target location, creating a smokescreen for 4 seconds. Enemies inside the smoke are slowed by 40% and have their vision reduced. Natalia's Basic Attacks against enemies inside the smoke deal 10% bonus Physical Damage.

Natalia marks the target enemy hero for 5 seconds. During this time, she gains 20% extra Movement Speed toward the target. Her Basic Attacks against the marked target deal 400–650 (+130% Total Physical Attack) bonus Physical Damage on the first hit and silence the target for 1.5 seconds. Costs 50 Energy.

story.title: The onmyouji shrine maiden who commands the sacred Seimei Umbrella
story.lore: Kagura is the most gifted onmyouji of her generation, trained in the ancient arts of the Onmyouji clan — wielders of paper magic, spirit binding, and the sacred art of the umbrella. Her partner is Seimei, a powerful spirit sealed within her enchanted umbrella who amplifies her abilities in battle. Though calm and composed on the surface, Kagura carries the weight of her clan's legacy on her shoulders; she is the last of a long line of masters, and the fate of their ancient craft rests with her. She fights not with aggression but with elegant precision, a dancer in battle whose every movement is calculated to devastating effect.

skills.desc: When Kagura and the Seimei Umbrella are reunited (Kagura picks up her umbrella), she deals 300–500 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and removes all crowd control effects on herself.

With umbrella in hand: Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella forward, dealing 250–400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in its path. Without umbrella: Kagura dashes to the umbrella's location. The umbrella then creates a field that slows nearby enemies by 40%.

With umbrella in hand: Kagura pulls all nearby enemies toward the umbrella's location and deals 200–350 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Without umbrella: Kagura dashes in the target direction and sends the umbrella back to her original position.

With umbrella in hand: Kagura deals 350–550 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage in a large area around the umbrella and creates a whirlpool that pulls enemies toward its center and slows them by 70% for 2 seconds. Without umbrella: Kagura deals 350–550 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage in a large area around herself and knocks nearby enemies airborne for 1 second.

story.title: The street-fighting kung fu prodigy who punches his way to enlightenment
story.lore: Chou grew up on the streets of a bustling city in the Land of Dawn, where he taught himself kung fu from stolen scrolls and sheer stubborn practice. What began as a way to survive became an obsession, and his obsession became mastery. By the time he was a teenager, he had already surpassed instructors who had trained for decades. His fighting style is raw, fluid, and devastatingly effective — a street-born fusion of classical technique and improvised brutality. Chou doesn't fight for any nation, order, or cause. He fights because there is always someone stronger, and until he's beaten the best, he can't stop. He hasn't stopped yet.

skills.desc: Every 8 yards Chou travels restores 4 Energy. When Chou's Energy is full, his next Basic Attack deals 180–280 (+80% Total Physical Attack) bonus Physical Damage and briefly slows the target.

Chou dashes forward, dealing 150–250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in his path. This skill can be cast up to 3 times in quick succession, with the third hit knocking enemies airborne. Costs 30 Energy total.

Chou dashes to the target location, becoming immune to crowd control for 0.6 seconds. If he hits an enemy, he deals 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by 80% for 1 second. Costs 40 Energy.

Chou delivers a flying sidekick that launches the target enemy hero backward, dealing 400–600 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If the target hits terrain, they bounce back toward Chou and are knocked airborne for 1 second. Chou can then follow up with a rapid combo strike. Costs 60 Energy.

story.title: The legendary Monkey King reborn to challenge heaven itself
story.lore: Sun is the reincarnation of the Great Sage, a legendary being whose power and arrogance once shook the heavens. Sealed away for centuries as punishment for his rebellion against the celestial order, he finally broke free when the Land of Dawn's conflict grew powerful enough to crack the divine seal. He emerged not humbled, but more confident than ever — certain that his long imprisonment only proves how much the heavens feared him. Armed with his enchanted staff and the ability to conjure clones of himself, Sun revels in chaos, fights with gleeful ferocity, and fully intends to finish the business with the heavens he started so long ago.

skills.desc: Each time a doppelganger hits an enemy, Sun's Physical Attack increases by 4% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Doppelgangers inherit 80% of Sun's Physical Attack and most of his equipment effects.

Sun throws his staff forward, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. He then summons a doppelganger at the staff's landing point that charges toward the nearest enemy.

Sun and his doppelgangers perform a sweeping strike, dealing 160–260 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all nearby enemies. Sun then swaps position with one of his doppelgangers. If no doppelganger exists, he summons one before swapping.

Sun summons 2 doppelgangers and enhances them, causing them to deal 100% of his Physical Attack damage for 12 seconds. During this time, each doppelganger killed explodes, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Sun becomes immune to the next crowd control effect after activation.

story.title: The laboratory-born super soldier searching for his lost brother
story.lore: Alpha and his brother Beta were created in the same Laboratory that rebuilt Saber — experimental super soldiers engineered for perfect combat performance. Where Beta was designed for agility and infiltration, Alpha was built for raw power and relentless assault. When the Laboratory was destroyed in a conflict, the two brothers were separated, and Beta's fate became unknown. Alpha now scours the Land of Dawn searching for his brother, tearing through anyone who gets in his way. He carries no ideology and feels no loyalty to any faction — only the singular, burning mission to find the one person who shares his origin and understands what it means to be something that was made, not born.

skills.desc: Beta accompanies Alpha in battle, marking enemies that Alpha hits with his skills. When an enemy accumulates 2 marks, Beta strikes them, dealing 280–400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly slowing them.

Alpha commands Beta to fly in the target direction, dealing 170–270 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in Beta's path. Alpha then leaps forward to Beta's location, dealing an additional 170–270 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his landing area.

Alpha delivers a powerful blow in the target direction, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in a line and slowing them by 50% for 1.5 seconds. Beta also swoops in on the same targets to apply an additional mark.

Alpha launches Beta as a powerful projectile in the target direction, dealing 350–550 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1 second. Alpha recovers 20% of his Max HP after using this ability.

story.title: The scythe-wielding Little Red Hood who hunts the wolves that plague her village
story.lore: Ruby's village sits on the edge of a vast, dark forest that has always been home to monsters. As a child, she listened to the old tale of Little Red Hood as a warning — but where others heard fear, Ruby heard a challenge. When the monsters from the forest began attacking her village in earnest, she didn't wait for a hero to arrive. She forged herself a massive scythe and walked into the dark woods herself. Her fighting style is brutish and relentless — she swings her scythe in wide arcs, pulling enemies toward her and refusing to go down no matter how many times she's hit. The monsters of the forest have learned to fear the girl in the red cloak.

skills.desc: Ruby gains 80% Spell Vamp on her skills. This is reduced to 40% Spell Vamp when hitting minions and monsters.

Ruby dashes in the target direction, swinging her scythe to deal 160–260 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all nearby enemies. She can then immediately use this skill again to dash back to her original position, dealing the same damage on the return swing.
Ruby swings her scythe in a wide arc, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies hit and pulling them toward her. Enemies hit are also slowed by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

Ruby swings her giant scythe in a full 360° arc three times, dealing 180–300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per swing to all nearby enemies and pulling them toward her with each hit. Each swing also applies a slow.

story.title: The legendary admiral who commands both sword and bow with equal mastery
story.lore: Yi Sun-shin is one of the most celebrated heroes in the history of the Land of Dawn — a legendary admiral who turned the tide of an impossible naval war through brilliant strategy and unmatched personal valor. Equally skilled with his glaive in close combat and his bow at range, he adapted to every situation his enemies threw at him. His fleet was always outnumbered and never outmatched. After the war ended, Yi Sun-shin could not rest — peace felt like an insult to the soldiers who never came home. He continues to patrol the waters and battlefields of the Land of Dawn, offering his sword and his bow to whatever righteous cause needs them, carrying the memory of the fallen like armor.

skills.desc: Yi Sun-shin wields both a glaive and a longbow. When enemies are nearby, he uses his glaive for melee Basic Attacks. When no enemies are nearby, he switches to his bow for enhanced ranged Basic Attacks that deal bonus Physical Damage and slow the target by 30% for 1 second. The first ranged Basic Attack after switching deals increased damage.

Yi Sun-shin dashes in the target direction with his glaive, dealing 280–450 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies he passes through and briefly slowing them. If he hits a wall during the dash, he launches himself off it to deal additional damage.

Yi Sun-shin summons his Turtle Ship at the target location. The ship fires flaming projectiles in the target direction, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies hit and setting them alight, slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. The ship persists for 6 seconds and can fire again after a short delay.

Yi Sun-shin shoots a flaming arrow into the sky that reveals all enemies on the map for 3 seconds. Three volleys of arrows then rain down on all revealed enemy heroes, each volley dealing 300–500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 30%.

story.title: The disgraced spear master who made a pact with darkness to reclaim his honor
story.lore: Moskov was the finest spear fighter in his clan, a prodigy destined for glory — until a rival framed him for treason and had him cast out in disgrace. Consumed by rage and humiliation, he wandered to the edge of the Abyss, where a dark entity offered him a pact: unimaginable power in exchange for his service. Moskov accepted without hesitation. His spear, now imbued with shadowy energy, can pierce through multiple enemies in a single throw, and his speed has become almost supernatural. He serves the darkness for now — but his true goal has never changed. He will return to his clan, expose the man who betrayed him, and drive his spear through the heart of the lie that destroyed his life.

skills.desc: Moskov's Basic Attacks penetrate enemies in a line, hitting all enemies behind the primary target. Each Basic Attack also reduces the target's Physical Defense by 4 for 3 seconds, stacking up to 5 times for a maximum reduction of 20.

Moskov dashes toward the target enemy and flips them over, dealing 130–230 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning them for 0.8 seconds. If the enemy is knocked into terrain, the stun duration is increased to 1.5 seconds.
Moskov dashes backward and enhances his next 3 Basic Attacks within 4 seconds, causing them to deal 20%–40% bonus Physical Damage and extend his Basic Attack range.

Moskov hurls an enormous spectral spear across the entire map in the target direction, dealing 400–700 (+200% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path and briefly immobilizing them for 1 second. The spear also reveals all enemies it passes through for 3 seconds.

story.title: The mechanical guardian who transforms into a battle car for his allies
story.lore: Johnson was once a brilliant engineer working for the Laboratory, the same shadowy organization responsible for creating Alpha and rebuilding Saber. When he uncovered the Laboratory's darkest experiments — human subjects converted into weapons without consent — he tried to leak the information and was nearly killed for it. To save his life, his colleagues fused his consciousness into a prototype mechanical battle suit before the Laboratory could silence him. Now Johnson exists as a man and a machine in one, fighting against the very organization that made him what he is. Despite his metal exterior, he is warm, protective, and fiercely loyal — the kind of ally who will literally throw himself in front of danger to keep others safe.

skills.desc: Johnson's Basic Attacks charge his battery. At full charge, his next Basic Attack releases a burst of electricity, dealing 100–200 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and briefly stunning them for 0.5 seconds.
Johnson fires a volley of missiles at the target area, dealing 150–280 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in the area and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
Johnson gains a shield equal to 10%–18% of his Max HP for 3 seconds. If an enemy Basic Attacks him while the shield is active, they are stunned for 0.5 seconds.

Johnson transforms into a race car, allowing one ally to board him. He then accelerates and drives in the target direction, reaching full speed after 1.5 seconds. Upon collision with an enemy hero or terrain, Johnson deals 400–700 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stuns the target for 0.5–1.5 seconds (longer the faster the speed at impact). Johnson remains in vehicle form for 5 seconds or until he crashes.

story.title: The one-eyed star magician who sees the entire universe in his single gaze
story.lore: Cyclops was born with a single enormous eye that, rather than being a deformity, grants him the ability to perceive the magical currents flowing through the cosmos. Shunned by his people as a child for his unusual appearance, he retreated into the study of stellar magic — the art of harnessing the power of stars and planetary bodies. What others saw as isolation, Cyclops experienced as revelation: the universe spoke to him through his eye, and he listened. He eventually emerged from his studies as one of the most powerful mages in the Land of Dawn, armed with the ability to summon planetary orbs and bend gravitational forces to his will. He is gentle, curious, and perpetually distracted by something only his single eye can see.

skills.desc: Each time Cyclops' skill hits an enemy hero, all his skill cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.
Cyclops fires 2 stardust orbs in the target direction, each dealing 200–350 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds.

Cyclops launches a giant planetary orb at the target location. The orb expands upon landing and slowly shrinks over 3 seconds, dealing 150–250 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second to enemies in the area and slowing them by 60%. Enemies in the center of the orb take increased damage.

Cyclops charges and fires a giant star at the target enemy, dealing 600–950 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. If the star hits an enemy hero, it locks onto them and detonates after a short delay, dealing an additional 300–500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

story.title: The Moon Elf King who sacrificed his power to protect his people
story.lore: Estes is the ancient king of the Moon Elves, a wise and compassionate ruler who has guided his people through ages of strife with patience and grace. When the Lunar Aegis — the divine barrier protecting the Moon Elf homeland — began to weaken under the relentless pressure of the Abyss, Estes made a decision that no king should have to make. He channeled the majority of his own life force into the barrier, sacrificing much of his divine power to keep his people safe. Now diminished but unbroken, he fights on the front lines himself, healing allies with the remaining moonlight magic he commands and refusing to let his sacrifice be rendered meaningless by a battlefield defeat.

skills.desc: Estes charges his Book of Moonlight over time. When fully charged, his next Basic Attack deals 175–300 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows the target by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

Estes links a beam of moonlight to the target ally, healing them for 700–1100 (+150% Total Magic Power) HP over 3 seconds. While the link is active, Estes can move freely. Casting any other skill does not break the link.

Estes conjures a field of moonlight around himself for 4 seconds, dealing 150–250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second to all enemies in the area and slowing them by 30%. Allies inside the field receive a 10% Movement Speed boost.

Estes channels the power of the Moon Goddess, instantly healing all nearby allies for 800–1200 (+100% Total Magic Power) HP and linking them with Moonlight Immersion simultaneously for 4 seconds. During this time, the healing from the links is doubled.

story.title: The sworn protector of the Megalith Wasteland and its ancient stones
story.lore: Hilda is the guardian of the Megalith Wasteland, a harsh and ancient land covered in mysterious standing stones that are said to hold the memories of a forgotten civilization. Raised among the stones by a tribe of hardy warriors, she bonded with the Megalith's latent power at a young age, learning to draw strength from the earth itself. When foreign armies began invading the Wasteland to harvest the stones' energy, Hilda took up her great sword and became the wasteland's last line of defense. She is stoic, powerful, and utterly immovable in her convictions — a warrior who regenerates in the bushes like the stones regenerate in the earth, always rising to fight again.

skills.desc: While Hilda is in a bush, she rapidly regenerates HP (up to 2% Max HP per second) and builds up Power of Megalith stacks. Each stack increases her next Basic Attack's damage by 100–180 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Stacks up to 8 times.

Hilda charges in the target direction, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies she passes through. She gains a shield equal to 8%–14% of her Max HP for 3 seconds after charging.

Hilda marks the target enemy, then leaps toward them and deals 300–500 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, briefly slowing them by 60% for 1 second. If the target is in a bush, the damage is increased by 30%.

Hilda delivers a devastating strike to the target enemy hero, dealing 600–900 (+200% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. This damage is increased by up to 60% based on the target's missing HP. Nearby enemies also take 50% of the damage as splash.

story.title: The ice queen of the Northern Vale whose heart is as cold as her magic
story.lore: Aurora is the queen of the Northern Vale, a vast frozen kingdom where she rules with an iron will and a frost-covered fist. Born with an innate command over ice and cold so powerful that she can freeze the very air around her, she spent her childhood learning to control a gift that threatened to consume her. The land she rules is perpetually winter, and she prefers it that way — ice, she believes, preserves. It keeps things pure and unchanging in a world that is always rotting and shifting. When the warmth of the Abyss's corruption began creeping toward her borders, Aurora rode out to meet it personally, determined to freeze it solid before it could reach her kingdom.

skills.desc: Aurora's skills charge a Frost Energy meter. When fully charged, her next skill that hits an enemy hero will freeze them solid for 1.5 seconds.

Aurora fires a bolt of frost energy in the target direction, dealing 350–550 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Charges Frost Energy.

Aurora conjures a ring of ice shards around herself that expands outward, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Charges Frost Energy.

Aurora summons a massive glacier to fall at the target location, dealing 800–1200 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area and freezing them for 2 seconds. Fully charges Frost Energy before impact, potentially causing a second freeze if Frost Energy was nearly full.

story.title: The island chieftain who refuses to bow to any foreign power
story.lore: Lapu-Lapu is the fierce chieftain of Makadan Island, a proud warrior people who have defended their home against foreign invaders for generations. When powerful foreign forces arrived on his shores demanding submission, Lapu-Lapu met them on the beach with his twin blades drawn. He drove them back not with superior numbers but with superior will — his people's ferocity in defense of their homeland more than compensating for every disadvantage. His legend grew across the Land of Dawn as a symbol of defiance against tyranny. He does not fight for conquest or glory; he fights because his people's freedom is something no foreign power has the right to take, and he will die before he lets them try.

skills.desc: Lapu-Lapu gains Bravery stacks whenever he deals damage. At full stacks (8), he enters Heavy Sword mode, empowering his skills. In Heavy Sword mode, his Basic Attacks deal bonus Physical Damage and have increased range.

Dual Blade mode: Lapu-Lapu dashes forward and slashes in a cross pattern, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies twice. Heavy Sword mode: He slams his combined blade down in a wide arc, dealing 300–500 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in front and briefly knocking them back.

Dual Blade mode: Lapu-Lapu spins his blades around himself, dealing 150–250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and gaining 20% extra Movement Speed for 2 seconds. Heavy Sword mode: He sweeps his combined blade in a wide circle, dealing 250–400 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing all enemies hit by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

Lapu-Lapu combines his dual blades into a single great sword, immediately entering Heavy Sword mode and gaining a shield equal to 20% of his Max HP for 4 seconds. He also deals 400–650 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and briefly knocks them airborne.

story.title: The necromancer queen who rules the undead in defiance of death itself
story.lore: Vexana was once a noblewoman of the Moniyan Empire who fell desperately in love with a man the Empire deemed unsuitable. When her love was executed on the orders of the Imperial Court, something inside Vexana broke — and then something far darker took its place. She delved into the forbidden arts of necromancy, seeking a way to undo death itself. She never brought her love back, but she became something terrifying in the attempt: a necromancer of unmatched power who now commands legions of the undead. She serves the Abyss not out of loyalty, but because they promised her the one thing she has always wanted — the power to make death meaningless.

skills.desc: Vexana's skills apply Nether Touch to enemies. When a marked enemy dies, they become a Puppet under Vexana's control for 10 seconds, inheriting their stats and dealing damage to enemies.

Vexana launches a cursed orb in the target direction, dealing 300–480 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hero hit and charming them for 1.2 seconds, forcing them to walk toward Vexana.

Vexana summons a necrotic field at the target location that detonates after 1.5 seconds, dealing 300–480 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area and briefly slowing them by 50% for 1.5 seconds.

Vexana curses the target enemy hero, dealing 400–650 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and summoning a Deadly Puppet to fight for her. The Puppet inherits the target's appearance and 80% of their stats, fighting for 8 seconds. If the cursed hero dies while the Puppet is active, the Puppet is empowered.

story.title: The wolf hunter cursed to become the very beast he hunted
story.lore: Roger was the most renowned monster hunter in the Northern Vale, famed for tracking and slaying the Dire Wolves that plagued the mountain villages. On the night of his greatest hunt, he cornered the alpha of the pack — a massive, ancient beast — only to be bitten just as he delivered the killing blow. The curse took root slowly, but it took root completely. Now Roger transforms with the moon, his hunter's mind at war with the wolf's primal instincts. He has not stopped hunting; he simply hunts different prey now. He uses his human form's marksmanship to scout and wound, then shifts into his wolf form for the kill — and some nights, he is not entirely sure which form is the real one.

skills.desc: Roger transforms between Human and Wolf form using his skills. In Human form, his Basic Attacks and skills apply Freeze stacks to enemies. In Wolf form, his Basic Attacks deal bonus Physical Damage based on the target's missing HP and grant him Movement Speed.

Human form: Roger fires a silver bullet that deals 250–420 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and slows them by 60% for 1.5 seconds. Wolf form: Roger pounces on the target enemy, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly slowing them.

Human form: Roger dashes backward while firing a shockwave forward, dealing 180–300 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40%. Wolf form: Roger howls, gaining 30%–50% Movement Speed and 20% Physical Lifesteal for 3 seconds.

skills.ability-name: Entering Wolf Form / Returning Human Form
skills.desc: Human form: Roger transforms into a wolf, dashing to the target location and dealing 300–500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Wolf form: Roger transforms back to human, firing a silver bullet that deals 300–500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and slowing them by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

story.title: The wandering lightwheel fighter who drifts between worlds like a lost star
story.lore: Karrie is a warrior from a dimension parallel to the Land of Dawn, a place where time flows differently and the boundaries between worlds are thin. A catastrophic collapse of dimensional barriers swept her into the Land of Dawn as a child, severing her connection to her home world. She was taken in by a traveling fighter who taught her the lightwheel combat style — a technique that turns her twin lightwheels into precision instruments of death at any range. For years she searched for a way home, following every rumor about dimensional rifts and unstable magic. She keeps searching, but the Land of Dawn has given her enough fights to keep her occupied in the meantime.

skills.desc: Karrie's Basic Attacks and skills stack Lightwheel Marks on enemies. At 5 stacks, a Lightwheel is fired at the target, dealing True Damage equal to 7%–10% of the target's Max HP. This can occur once every 0.8 seconds.

Karrie dashes in the target direction and fires a Lightwheel that deals 100–175 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path. The Lightwheel bounces off walls, and each enemy hit generates a Lightwheel Mark.

Karrie fires a Lightwheel in the target direction, dealing 150–250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. She then dashes a short distance in the opposite direction.

Karrie enters Dual Wheel mode for 4 seconds, causing each Basic Attack to fire 2 Lightwheels instead of 1. Each Lightwheel hit generates a Lightwheel Mark. During this state, she gains 20%–30% extra Movement Speed and her Attack Speed is significantly increased.

story.title: The steel-boned demigod warrior forged in divine fire
story.lore: Gatotkaca is a legendary warrior from the ancient epics of the Land of Dawn — a demigod born of divine bloodline whose body was forged in sacred fire to give him bones of steel and strength beyond any mortal. Raised as a champion of his people, he was tested from birth by gods and monsters alike, each trial making him stronger and more indestructible. He wields no weapon because he needs none; his fists and feet, hardened by divine magic, are more lethal than any blade. Gatotkaca is not simply powerful — he is a living legend, a being whose story has been told for generations, and who carries the weight of every expectation with unshakeable pride.

skills.desc: Gatotkaca converts 3% of his Extra HP into Magic Attack. Additionally, the more HP he is missing, the higher his Physical and Magic Defense become, up to a bonus of 100 of each defense at 30% HP.

Gatotkaca stomps the ground, creating a ring of fire that deals 150–280 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. The ring lingers for 3 seconds; enemies standing in it continue to take damage and are slowed.

Gatotkaca charges in the target direction, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in his path and briefly knocking them back. During the charge, he is immune to slow effects.

Gatotkaca leaps to the target location from anywhere on the map after a brief delay, dealing 400–650 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the landing area and stunning them for 1–2 seconds (based on how far he leaped). Allies near the landing zone are warned before impact.

story.title: The boy genius magician whose tricks are anything but harmless
story.lore: Harley is a child prodigy who enrolled in the Magic Academy at an absurdly young age and promptly drove every professor to the edge of their patience. His magical aptitude is extraordinary, but his attention span is not — he finds formal study unbearably dull compared to inventing his own spells on the fly. He ran away from the Academy at age ten, taking nothing but a top hat, a deck of cards, and enough raw magical talent to level a city block. He travels the Land of Dawn like a street magician, performing tricks that are increasingly difficult to distinguish from outright destruction, and treating every battle as an opportunity to test out whatever new combination of spells he dreamed up the night before. The Academy would very much like him to come back. He has not.

skills.desc: Harley's Basic Attacks deal bonus Magic Damage equal to 30–60 (+20% Total Magic Power). After using a skill, his next Basic Attack fires an enhanced magic bullet that deals an additional 80–150 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Harley throws 5 cards in the target direction in a fan pattern, each dealing 130–205 (+35% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit. Cards that hit the same target deal 50% reduced damage after the first.

Harley blinks to the target location and leaves a hat at his original position. He can reactivate this skill within 3 seconds to teleport back to the hat. While the hat is on the ground, enemies near it are slowed by 25%.

Harley places a ring of fire on the target enemy hero that shrinks over 3.5 seconds. When the ring closes, it deals Magic Damage equal to 400–650 (+150% Total Magic Power) plus 12%–18% of the target's Max HP as Magic Damage. The target also takes 15% increased Magic Damage from all sources while the ring is active.

story.title: The jungle huntress who rides her loyal tiger companion Leo into battle
story.lore: Irithel grew up deep in the heart of the great jungle, raised not by people but by the jungle itself after she was separated from her family as a toddler. She was found and adopted by a pride of tigers, and among them she grew strong, feral, and utterly fearless. Her closest bond is with Leo, a massive tiger she has fought alongside since they were both young. Together they move through the jungle like shadows — Irithel's crossbow picking off targets from above while Leo closes the distance with terrifying speed. When the jungle began to shrink under the advance of civilization and war, Irithel and Leo rode out of the trees to defend the only home they have ever known.

skills.desc: Irithel rides Leo at all times, firing her crossbow while moving. Her Basic Attacks fire 3 bolts in a cone in front of her, each dealing 40%–60% of her Physical Attack as Physical Damage and applying on-hit effects.

Irithel fires a heavy bolt at the target location, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in the area and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Leo roars, frightening nearby enemies and briefly reducing their Attack Speed by 30%.

Leo leaps in the target direction, carrying Irithel and dealing 150–250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in the landing area. For 4 seconds after landing, Irithel's Basic Attacks deal bonus Physical Damage equal to 80–140 (+40% Total Physical Attack).

Irithel switches to a massive crossbow for 6 seconds, causing each Basic Attack to fire a single heavy bolt that deals 200–350 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in a line, piercing through them. This ability also briefly grants extra Movement Speed.

story.title: The ancient stone titan awakened to defend the ruins of a forgotten age
story.lore: Grock is not merely a warrior — he is a remnant of an age long forgotten, a titan of living stone who was sealed within an ancient fortress when the civilization that created him crumbled to dust. For millennia he slept within the walls, his consciousness merged with the stone around him, dreaming of battles long past. When the current wars of the Land of Dawn shook the earth hard enough to crack his prison, Grock awoke — and found a world he did not recognize. The fortress he once guarded is ruins. The people he protected are gone. With nothing left to protect, he now wanders the battlefields, fighting not out of loyalty or purpose, but because battle is the only language he has ever spoken fluently.

skills.desc: Grock gains 10% extra Movement Speed and 100 extra Physical Attack when near a wall or structure. This bonus doubles when he is within 2 yards of terrain.

Grock raises his staff and slams it down, dealing 300–500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in front of him and knocking them back. If the target is knocked into terrain, they are stunned for 1.5 seconds.

Grock creates a stone wall in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. The wall blocks enemy movement and projectiles. Grock himself can move through the wall freely and gains bonus Physical and Magic Defense while near it.

Grock charges in the target direction, dealing 400–650 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in his path and knocking them aside. If Grock collides with terrain, he erupts in a shockwave, dealing an additional 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning all nearby enemies for 1.5 seconds.

story.title: The fallen angel corrupted by the Abyss who embraces his own darkness
story.lore: Argus was once a celebrated warrior of the Moniyan Empire, a knight of tremendous valor who fought alongside Tigreal in service of the light. But where Tigreal's faith was unshakeable, Argus's was fragile — he craved power more than purity, and when a demon of the Abyss offered him a deal in the depths of a losing battle, he accepted. The corruption was total and irreversible. His wings turned black, his eyes burned with dark fire, and his sword became an instrument of the Abyss. But Argus does not mourn his fall — he revels in it. He is stronger than he ever was in the light, and he has decided that the darkness suits him just fine.

skills.desc: Argus's Basic Attacks and skills charge his Warmonger meter. At full charge, his next Basic Attack deals 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) bonus Physical Damage and grants him 20% extra Movement Speed for 2 seconds.
Argus dashes in the target direction, slashing enemies twice. Each slash deals 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all nearby enemies and charges his Warmonger meter.

Argus hurls his dark sword in the target direction, dealing 250–400 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and briefly slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds. The sword then returns to Argus, damaging any enemies in its return path.

Argus transforms into his Dark Angel form for 5 seconds, becoming immune to death. During this state, all damage he takes is absorbed rather than reducing his HP — when the transformation ends, his HP is set to the amount remaining from before he transformed (minimum 1 HP). He also gains 40%–60% extra Attack Speed and his Basic Attacks deal bonus Physical Damage.

story.title: The swan princess whose enchanted dance channels the power of pure magic
story.lore: Odette is a princess of a peaceful kingdom blessed by an ancient magic that flows through the royal bloodline as song and dance. From childhood she was trained in the sacred dance forms that channel this magic into powerful spells, each movement precise and deliberate, each step a verse in a spell older than the kingdom itself. When war reached her kingdom's borders, Odette refused to flee or hide. She descended from the palace to the battlefield in her swan gown, her dance transformed from a beautiful art form into a devastating weapon. Enemies who expect elegance find ruin — her swansong is the last thing many of them hear.

skills.desc: When Odette casts a skill, her next Basic Attack fires a magic bolt that deals 135–270 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and bounces between nearby enemies up to 4 times, dealing 20% reduced damage per bounce.

Odette fires a magical swan feather in the target direction, dealing 300–480 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and briefly slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. The feather bounces to up to 3 nearby enemies, dealing 60% of the damage to each.

Odette releases a ring of magical energy that expands outward, dealing 150–250 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies it passes through and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. She also gains a shield equal to 8% of her Max HP.

Odette channels her ultimate dance, continuously dealing 280–450 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second to all enemies in a large area around her for up to 3.5 seconds. Each pulse also slows nearby enemies by 40%. Odette gains a shield at the start of the channel, but the ability can be interrupted by crowd control.

story.title: The narcissistic noble swordsman whose blade is as sharp as his wit
story.lore: Lancelot is a nobleman of the Baroque Empire, heir to a storied house of swordsmen who have served the empire for generations. He is devastatingly handsome, insufferably charming, and completely aware of both facts. His fencing style is a form of art he has elevated to a philosophy — every duel a performance, every kill a masterpiece. Beneath the vanity, however, is a warrior of genuine brilliance. His speed and precision with a blade are unmatched, and his ability to weave through enemies like smoke makes him one of the most frustrating opponents in the Land of Dawn.
