He fights for the thrill, for the glory, and — if pressed — for the people he loves, though he would never admit to that last part.

skills.desc: After using a skill, Lancelot gains a brief immunity to damage for 0.5 seconds. Each skill use also marks the target, and Lancelot's subsequent attacks against marked targets deal 10%–20% bonus Physical Damage.

Lancelot dashes to the target enemy, dealing 150–260 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. This skill can be cast up to 3 times in quick succession, each dash dealing increasing damage. The third dash knocks the target airborne briefly.

Lancelot dashes in the target direction, leaving a trail of rose thorns that deal 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies he passes through and briefly slowing them by 40% for 1 second.

Lancelot becomes untargetable and summons phantom blades that slash across the target area 3 times in sequence, each slash dealing 300–500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies hit. Enemies hit by all 3 slashes take bonus damage.

story.title: The clock-obsessed owl inventor who bends time to protect his allies
story.lore: Diggie is a tiny owl with an enormous brain and an even more enormous obsession with time. A self-taught inventor who built his first clockwork device at age three (owl years), he became convinced early on that time itself was a mechanism — one that could, with sufficient ingenuity, be tinkered with. He constructed the Timekeeper device after decades of work: a machine that can rewind small pockets of time, trapping enemies in temporal loops and freeing allies from the effects of attacks that haven't technically happened yet. He joined the wars of the Land of Dawn not out of any grand ideology, but because war generates more interesting temporal data than anything he could simulate in his workshop.

skills.desc: Upon death, Diggie transforms into an egg for 2.5 seconds, becoming untargetable. If the egg is not destroyed within that time, Diggie is revived with 35%–55% of his Max HP. While in egg form, he can still use his Ultimate.

Diggie throws a time bomb at the target location that sticks to the first enemy hero it touches. After 2.5 seconds, the bomb explodes, dealing 300–500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area and stunning them for 1.2 seconds. Diggie can reactivate this skill early to detonate the bomb immediately.

Diggie creates a temporal field at the target location for 3 seconds. Enemies that enter the field are slowed by 50% and continuously pulled toward the center. Enemies caught in the center when the field expires are briefly stunned.

Diggie grants all nearby allies immunity to crowd control for 3 seconds and removes all existing crowd control effects from them. Affected allies also gain a shield equal to 500–800 (+150% Total Magic Power) HP that lasts for the duration.

story.title: The centaur warden who guards the sacred ley lines of the Land of Dawn
story.lore: Hylos is the Grand Warden of the Ley Lines — the ancient magical pathways that carry energy across the Land of Dawn. A centaur of immense stature and wisdom, he has guarded these pathways for longer than most civilizations have existed, keeping them free from corruption and ensuring that the Land of Dawn's magical balance is maintained. His bond with the ley lines is so deep that he can draw power from them in battle, converting his mana directly into physical endurance. When the Abyss began corrupting the ley lines from within, Hylos abandoned his post at the nexus to fight the corruption at its source — a decision that cost him some of his power, but that he would make again in an instant.

skills.desc: Hylos converts 1.5% of his Max Mana into Max HP. His skills consume HP instead of Mana when his Mana runs out, allowing him to continue casting at the cost of his own health.

Hylos summons the power of the ley lines, creating a ring of chains around him that expands outward. Enemies hit by the chains take 250–400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are slowed by 60% for 2 seconds. Enemies at the edge of the ring are stunned for 1 second instead.

Hylos creates a sacred path in the target direction that lasts 5 seconds. Allies on the path gain 30%–50% extra Movement Speed and 15% extra Physical and Magic Defense. Enemies that step onto the path are slowed by 50%.

Hylos channels the ley line energy and charges in the target direction, trampling all enemies in his path and dealing 150–250 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second for up to 3 seconds. Enemies he tramples are slowed by 70%. At the end of the charge, Hylos rears up and deals 300–500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in front of him and briefly stuns them.

story.title: The alien swarm lord who came to consume the Land of Dawn
story.lore: Zhask is not from the Land of Dawn — he is from somewhere far beyond it, a dimension of endless void where his kind, the Netherspiders, are the apex predators. He arrived in the Land of Dawn not as a refugee or a conqueror in the traditional sense, but as a harvester. His world had been stripped bare and he came seeking a new feeding ground for his swarm. What he found was a world with more resistance than expected. He rules his swarm through a psychic link, commanding his spawn with perfect efficiency. The people of the Land of Dawn are merely the next world on a very long list — and Zhask is nothing if not patient.

skills.desc: Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that attacks nearby enemies, dealing 100–180 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per attack. The Spawn persists until destroyed and can be empowered by Zhask's other skills. Only one Spawn can exist at a time.

Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn at the target location. The Spawn has its own HP pool and attacks the nearest enemy. Zhask can resummon the Spawn if it is destroyed after a short cooldown. The Spawn gains bonus stats based on Zhask's Magic Power.

Zhask channels his psychic energy and fires a concentrated blast in the target direction, dealing 300–500 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. If the blast hits the Nightmaric Spawn's target, the damage is increased by 30%.
Zhask releases a swarm of parasites from the Nightmaric Spawn in all directions, each dealing 150–250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds.

Zhask fuses with his Nightmaric Spawn, empowering it into a giant Dominator form for 8 seconds. In this form, all of the Spawn's attacks deal 200–350 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and knock enemies back. The Dominator also has a point-blank shockwave that deals 500–800 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stuns nearby enemies for 1 second. Zhask's movement is controlled by the Dominator during this time.

story.title: The shadow creature who silences the world before consuming it
story.lore: Helcurt is a creature of pure darkness, born not from flesh or magic but from the void between dimensions — a living shadow that feeds on sound and light. He came to the Land of Dawn drawn by the density of life and the noise of war, both of which he finds irresistible. He does not fight for conquest or ideology; he fights because the silence after a kill is the only thing that satisfies him. His tail silences enemies before they can scream, and he moves through darkness like he was born to it — because he was. The armies of the Abyss use him as a weapon, but Helcurt serves no master. He simply goes where the darkness is deepest and waits for the world to come to him.

skills.desc: When Helcurt uses a skill, nearby enemy heroes are silenced for 1 second. This effect has a 2-second cooldown per target.

Helcurt dashes to the target enemy, dealing 250–420 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If the target is below 30% HP, this skill deals 1.5× damage. Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds if the target dies shortly after.

Helcurt fires a barrage of 8 stingers in the target direction in a spread pattern, each dealing 80–140 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit. Enemies hit by multiple stingers take reduced damage from subsequent hits.

Helcurt shrouds the entire battlefield in darkness for 3 seconds, reducing all enemy heroes' vision to near zero and revealing only his own position. He also gains 30%–50% extra Movement Speed and 20% extra Physical Attack during this period. All enemies caught in the darkness are slowed by 20%.

story.title: The Crow Witch mourning her cursed beloved
story.lore: Pharsa is a witch of great power who fell deeply in love with Verri, a man cursed to take the form of a crow. Determined to break his curse, Pharsa immersed herself in forbidden arcane arts, awakening a devastating magical power within. Though she succeeded in partially restoring Verri, the curse could never be fully undone. Together the two roam the Land of Dawn — Verri perched faithfully upon her shoulder — as Pharsa unleashes her wrathful magic against those who threaten the innocent. Her power is born of grief and love in equal measure, and her enemies rarely survive long enough to understand the difference.

skills.desc: Verri periodically marks a nearby enemy, granting Pharsa 30% extra Movement Speed when moving toward that enemy. When Pharsa uses Energy Waves, Verri simultaneously attacks the marked target, dealing 150–400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Pharsa transforms the target enemy into a crow for 0.8 seconds, stunning them and disabling their skills. Deals 150–300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target.
Pharsa channels Verri's power to launch a magical energy wave in the designated direction, dealing 400–650 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies hit.

Pharsa takes flight (becoming untargetable) and bombards a large target area with four successive waves of magical feathers over 9 seconds. Each wave deals 400–650 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the impact zone. Pharsa can move freely during this time but cannot use other skills.

story.title: The Imperial sharpshooter on a quest for vengeance
story.lore: Lesley is an elite sniper trained by the Eruditio Intelligence Bureau. As a young girl, she was the sole survivor of a massacre that wiped out her entire family — an event orchestrated by shadowy forces connected to the very organization she would later serve. Raised in secret by a mentor who saw her latent talent, Lesley mastered the art of precision marksmanship and infiltration. She now serves as the bureau's deadliest operative while quietly pursuing the truth behind her family's destruction. Cold, calculated, and unflinchingly patient, Lesley never misses her mark — and she never forgets a target.

skills.desc: Lesley gains 10 Energy per Basic Attack. After 3 seconds without taking damage or using skills, she enters Conceal state, gaining 30% extra Physical Penetration on her next Basic Attack, increasing its range and dealing 130% Physical Damage.

Lesley dashes in the specified direction and tosses a grenade that slows all nearby enemies by 80% for 0.8 seconds and grants her 1 second of Conceal. This skill resets immediately if it eliminates an enemy.

Lesley fires a high-powered shot in the target direction, dealing 300–500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit, ignoring 20 Physical Defense. The projectile passes through minions.

Lesley locks onto up to 4 enemy heroes and fires 4 sniper rounds over 3 seconds. Each round deals 400–650 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and can be re-aimed between shots. Enemies can intercept bullets by moving into their path.

story.title: The rampaging robot built by a genius inventor
story.lore: Jawhead is a mechanical combat unit originally constructed by the eccentric genius Dr. Rooney as a caretaking robot. Programmed with the personality of a loyal and gentle guardian, Jawhead's original purpose was to protect and assist. An encounter with hostile forces corrupted his combat protocols, transforming him into an unstoppable war machine. Despite his fearsome capabilities, Jawhead retains fragments of his original benevolent programming — he still refers to enemies as 'friends' before launching them across the battlefield. Dr. Rooney desperately tries to keep up with her creation, who now marches across the Land of Dawn offering 'hugs' to all who stand in his way.

skills.desc: Each Basic Attack applies a stack of Compression on the target, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack deals 15–40 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per second (affected by Attack Speed) and reduces the target's Physical and Magic Defense by 4 (up to 20).

Jawhead hurls a nearby allied hero or minion at the target enemy, dealing 300–480 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning the enemy for 1 second. If no ally is nearby, Jawhead launches himself instead.
Jawhead charges to the target location. Any enemy in his path is knocked airborne briefly and takes 180–280 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Jawhead locks onto the target enemy hero and slams into them with full force after a brief delay, dealing 500–800 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking all nearby enemies airborne for 1 second. The charge cannot be stopped.

story.title: The mechanical doll searching for the meaning of love
story.lore: Angela is a sentient android created by the genius Dr. Rooney of Eruditio as an experiment in artificial emotion. Built to experience and express human feelings, Angela developed a deep and genuine capacity for love and compassion that surprised even her creator. She views the world with wide-eyed wonder and cares deeply for those around her. When conflict threatened the people she loved, Angela refused to stand idle. Armed with healing threads and her loving spirit, she latches onto allied heroes to shield them with her body and magic. For Angela, love is not just a programmed response — it is the very reason she exists.

skills.desc: Angela's skills apply Love Thread stacks to enemies, reducing their Movement Speed by 5% per stack (up to 4 stacks, 20% total). Allied heroes carrying Angela's thread gain a shield equal to the stacks' accumulated value.
Angela launches a wave of love energy at the target, dealing 150–300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds while applying a Love Thread stack.

Angela shoots a magic string at the target enemy, rooting them for up to 3 seconds and dealing 40–80 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.5 seconds. She can end the effect early. Allies can pass through the string to apply Love Thread stacks.

Angela attaches herself to the target allied hero anywhere on the map, traveling to their location and entering their body. While attached, she grants them a shield of 1200–2000 (+200% Total Magic Power) and can freely cast her other skills. The effect lasts up to 12 seconds or until she detaches.

story.title: The disgraced holy knight who wields cursed daggers
story.lore: Gusion hails from the revered Paxley family, a noble house of holy knights whose sacred duty is to guard the barrier between the living world and the Abyss. Blessed from birth with tremendous magical talent, Gusion was groomed to be the family's greatest champion. But his insatiable hunger for power led him to experiment with forbidden dark magic, and when discovered, he was stripped of his holy title and cast out in disgrace. Refusing to accept defeat, Gusion mastered the art of dagger-casting — hurling enchanted blades and recalling them through enemies. He now walks a solitary path as an assassin, torn between the holy power he was born with and the darkness he willingly embraced.

skills.desc: After using a skill, Gusion's next Basic Attack deals 150–300 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. This effect has a 0.5-second cooldown.

Gusion hurls a holy dagger in the target direction, dealing 200–350 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit. He can reactivate to dash to the dagger's location. If the dagger has hit an enemy, the dash also deals an additional 100–200 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Gusion throws 5 daggers in a fan-shaped area, each dealing 150–250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit. He can reactivate to recall all daggers, each dealing 100–200 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies they pass through on return.

Gusion instantly resets the cooldowns of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter and enhances them for 5 seconds. Enhanced Sword Spike can be cast twice in rapid succession, and enhanced Shadowblade Slaughter fires 8 daggers instead of 5.

story.title: The fire mage who escaped the Abyss's corruption
story.lore: Valir was born with an extraordinary affinity for fire magic — a gift that drew both admiration and fear from those around him. As a student of the great mage Gord, he showed exceptional promise. But when a catastrophic magical accident destroyed part of his school and injured his peers, Valir was branded a monster and cast out. Consumed by guilt and rage, he wandered the Land of Dawn, his flames burning hotter with his emotional turmoil. He eventually mastered his power not by suppressing it, but by accepting it — learning to channel the inferno within into a precise and devastating force. Now Valir fights to protect others from suffering the rejection and isolation he once endured.

skills.desc: Each time Valir's skills hit an enemy, they accumulate a Fireback stack (up to 3). At 3 stacks, the next hit ignites the target, stunning them for 1 second and dealing 150 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Valir periodically releases a burst of flames, resetting all skill cooldowns.

Valir hurls a fireball in the target direction that explodes on contact with the first enemy, dealing 250–450 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing all enemies in the blast by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
Valir summons a torrent of fire that pushes all enemies in its path away from him, dealing 150–300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The fire lingers briefly, slowing enemies in the area by 40%.

Valir ignites his full power, removing all debuffs on himself and granting immunity to crowd control for 5 seconds. During this time, Burst Fireball explodes into a wide shower of embers and Searing Torrent gains increased range and damage.

story.title: The Ashura King who broke free from the Seal of the Abyss
story.lore: Martis is the King of the Ashura, a divine warrior race born to serve as guardians of the Ten Thousand Years Abyss seal. For millennia, Martis carried the burden of this duty, sacrificing his freedom to keep the darkness imprisoned. As the seal weakened over the ages, the Abyss's malevolent energy began seeping into his soul, corrupting him slowly. Rather than succumb entirely or allow the seal to fail, Martis broke free of his sacred post and descended into the Land of Dawn — not as a servant of light or dark, but as a force of absolute power answering to no one. His twin blades have never known defeat, and his wrath is as boundless as the abyss he once guarded.

skills.desc: Martis's Basic Attacks and skills reduce the cooldown of Ashura Aura by 0.5 seconds. When Ashura Aura is active, Martis ignores Slow effects and gains 60% extra Attack Speed.
Martis summons a powerful spinning force around himself, dealing 150–250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per second to nearby enemies and pulling them toward him. Lasts 3 seconds.

Martis dashes forward and slashes at enemies in his path, dealing 300–500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them airborne for 1 second. This skill can be used up to 2 times in a row.

Martis slashes all nearby enemies with a powerful strike, dealing 500–800 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies below 50% HP are executed instantly. If Martis kills an enemy hero with Decimation, its cooldown is immediately reset.

story.title: The Aethereal guardian born from cosmic energy
story.lore: Uranus is not a being of flesh and blood, but a living embodiment of aethereal energy — a cosmic entity that coalesced in the upper atmosphere of the Land of Dawn ages ago. He descended to the surface after sensing a great imbalance in the world's energies, believing that the ongoing conflicts between light and darkness threatened to unravel the fabric of reality itself. Uranus does not take sides in mortal wars; he acts as a guardian of equilibrium. His body continuously regenerates from ambient cosmic energy, making him seemingly unkillable. Those who face him quickly realize that wearing him down is an exercise in futility — every wound closes before it can turn the tide.

skills.desc: Each time Uranus takes damage, he gains a Radiance stack (up to 20). Each stack grants him 3–8 HP Regen per second. Stacks decay one at a time after leaving combat.

Uranus releases two aethereal discs that orbit him briefly before launching at the nearest enemies, each dealing 150–250 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing the target by 30% for 2 seconds.

Uranus generates an aethereal shield that absorbs up to 800–1400 (+200% Total Magic Power) damage for 3 seconds. While the shield holds, he continuously regenerates HP and generates Radiance stacks at an accelerated rate.

Uranus propels himself toward the target enemy, dealing 500–800 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage on impact and knocking nearby enemies airborne for 1 second. He then creates a field of aethereal energy at the landing site for 4 seconds, slowing all enemies within by 50%.

story.title: The ninja kunoichi who fled the Shadow Clan
story.lore: Hanabi was raised within the secretive Shadow Clan of the Land of Dawn's eastern territories, trained from childhood in the deadly arts of the kunoichi. She excelled above all others in her class, mastering techniques that took others decades in mere years. But when she discovered that the Shadow Clan intended to use her skills not to protect the innocent but to assassinate political rivals and accumulate power, she defected. Taking only her enchanted needles and the forbidden techniques locked in her memory, Hanabi fled and became a wandering warrior. She now uses her petal-like projectiles and barrier techniques to fight for those who cannot protect themselves, atoning for the deeds done in her clan's name.

skills.desc: When Hanabi's Mana is full, her Basic Attacks fire additional petals that bounce to nearby enemies, each dealing 50% of her Physical Attack as Physical Damage. She does not consume Mana while it is full.

Hanabi activates her full petal power, gaining a shield equal to 10–20% of her Max HP and causing her Basic Attacks to split into multiple petals that ricochet between nearby enemies. Lasts 4 seconds.
Hanabi fires a soul scroll in the target direction, dealing 150–300 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and restoring 150–300 Mana on contact.
Hanabi throws a giant petal that roots the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds and spreads root vines to nearby enemies. Each rooted enemy takes 300–500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

story.title: The Moon Palace immortal who descended for her beloved
story.lore: Chang'e is an immortal who dwells in the Moon Palace high above the Land of Dawn, accompanied by her beloved jade rabbit. According to legend, she ascended to the palace after drinking an elixir of immortality, becoming separated from her mortal love. Though centuries have passed, Chang'e has never stopped watching over the world below. When a great darkness began threatening both the mortal realm and the sanctity of the moon itself, Chang'e descended — bringing with her the power of moonlight and cosmic energy. She fights with a smile on her face and her rabbit by her side, but beneath her cheerful demeanor lies the profound loneliness of an immortal who has loved and lost across lifetimes.

skills.desc: Chang'e gains Stardust each time her skills hit enemies. At 50 Stardust, she fully charges her power. In the charged state, Meteor Shower fires additional projectiles and deals increased damage.

Chang'e commands her jade rabbit to dash to the target location, leaving a trail that boosts her Movement Speed. Reactivating the skill recalls the rabbit, which damages enemies along its return path for 200–350 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Chang'e unleashes a crescent-shaped burst of moon energy in the target direction, dealing 300–500 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and briefly slowing nearby enemies by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

Chang'e summons a relentless meteor shower for 3 seconds, launching a barrage of moon projectiles in the target direction. Each projectile deals 100–180 (+35% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit. In her charged state, she fires 50% more projectiles.

story.title: The divine Nazar warrior sent to maintain cosmic order
story.lore: Kaja is a Nazar — a divine being created by the gods to serve as an enforcer of cosmic law in the Land of Dawn. Armed with electrified chains that can bind even the mightiest of warriors, Kaja descends to the mortal realm whenever the balance of power is threatened. His mission is not personal; it is absolute. Those who violate the divine order are dragged before judgment whether they will it or not. Kaja carries no grudge and harbors no ambition — he is merely the instrument of a higher authority. Yet over countless years of witnessing mortal suffering, even this divine soldier has begun to question whether justice and law are always the same thing.

skills.desc: Every 3rd Basic Attack releases a burst of divine lightning that bounces between nearby enemies, dealing 150–300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to each target hit.

Kaja calls down a divine ring at the target location that expands outward then contracts, dealing 300–500 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Movement Speed by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
Kaja dashes to the target location and releases a burst of electricity on arrival, dealing 200–350 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and briefly slowing them.

Kaja swoops toward the target enemy hero and binds them with divine chains, dragging them with him for 2 seconds. During this time, the bound hero's Magic Defense is reduced by 10–30 and they take 350–600 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Kaja can move freely while dragging but cannot use other skills.

story.title: The half-elf chosen by the Abyss to be its emissary
story.lore: Selena was once a Moon Elf of the Azrya Woodlands, gifted with rare beauty and a natural sensitivity to magical energies. When the Abyss reached out to her during a moment of great sorrow, she was drawn into its darkness rather than resisting it. The Abyss granted her tremendous power in exchange for her service as its emissary — a bridge between the dark realm and the mortal world. Now Selena walks both forms: in elven form, she sets traps and bides her time; in abyssal form, she unleashes terrifying destructive power. She serves the Abyss willingly, though deep within her a fragment of her original self still stirs, wondering if there is a way back to the light she once knew.

skills.desc: Selena switches between Elven Form and Abyssal Form. In Elven Form she places Abyssal Traps and marks enemies with her arrow. In Abyssal Form, she deals bonus Magic Damage on the first hit to a marked target. Switching forms refreshes her skill set.

Elven Form: Places an Abyssal Trap that latches onto and slows the first enemy that touches it. Multiple traps on the same target stun them. Abyssal Form: Selena fires a trident in the target direction, dealing 400–650 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies hit and stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

Elven Form: Selena fires a long-range arrow that stuns the first enemy hit for 0.5–3 seconds (scaling with travel distance) and marks them with Abyssal energy. Abyssal Form: She dashes forward with abyssal claws, dealing 300–500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in her path.

Selena transforms between her Elven Form and Abyssal Form. Switching into Abyssal Form grants a burst of Movement Speed and resets her Abyssal Form skills. Switching back to Elven Form resets her elven skills.

story.title: The immortal soul contractor who grows stronger with every kill
story.lore: Aldous is an ancient immortal who has spent centuries forging soul contracts with those who seek power at any price. Through these contracts, he absorbs a fraction of every soul he encounters, growing stronger with each battle. He carries no allegiance to any kingdom or cause — his only motivation is the relentless accumulation of power through conflict. Yet unlike a mindless monster, Aldous is calculating and patient. He observes wars from a distance, choosing his moments carefully, and when he finally moves it is with overwhelming, terrifying force. Each fist he throws carries the weight of every soul he has ever claimed, and he shows no mercy to those who stand between him and the next contract.

skills.desc: Aldous permanently gains stacks from eliminating minions (1 stack), jungle monsters (2 stacks), or enemy heroes (20 stacks). Each stack increases the damage of Contract: Soul Steal by 8 Physical Damage. Stacks are permanent and carry over between respawns.

Aldous charges his fist with soul energy and delivers a devastating blow to the target, dealing base Physical Damage plus 8 damage per stack accumulated. He also gains a brief shield equal to 300–500 HP upon activation.

Aldous creates an explosive soul force around himself, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1 second. He also gains a shield that absorbs 300–500 damage.

Aldous reveals all enemy heroes on the map for 5 seconds and selects one to charge toward at high speed across any distance. Upon reaching the target, he deals 500–800 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Nearby enemies along the path are knocked aside.

story.title: The audacious thief whose greatest heist is victory itself
story.lore: Claude is the Land of Dawn's most infamous thief — a charming, quick-fingered rogue who has stolen treasures from kings, generals, and monsters alike. But Claude is no ordinary criminal. He steals for the thrill of it, for the art of the impossible heist, and occasionally to help those the powerful have wronged. His loyal monkey companion Dexter serves as his partner in crime, swapping positions with Claude mid-battle to confuse enemies and create openings. Flamboyant and infuriatingly self-assured, Claude treats every battle like a performance. Whether he's pilfering enemy Movement Speed or leaping across the map in a flash of light, he operates by one rule: if it's worth having, it's worth taking.

skills.desc: Claude's Basic Attacks summon Dexter to simultaneously attack the same target. Basic Attacks also apply a stack of Friend Zone on the target, reducing their Movement Speed by 4% per stack (up to 5 stacks, 20% total).

Claude sends Dexter to the target location, then dashes to Dexter's position while Dexter moves to Claude's previous location. Can also be activated to first place Dexter at the designated spot before swapping.
Claude fires a wide energy blast in the target direction, dealing 150–250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies hit and stealing 25% of their Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

Claude and Dexter open fire together in all directions for 3 seconds, each dealing 130–200 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit to nearby enemies at extreme speed. Claude can move freely during this time.

story.title: The amnesiac wind mage whose past is carried on the breeze
story.lore: Vale appeared at the gates of the Mage Academy with no memories of his past, only a powerful and innate ability to command the wind. The academy's scholars recognized his extraordinary talent and took him in, hoping to help him recover his identity. But Vale showed little interest in uncovering who he was — he was far more focused on who he could become. Mastering wind magic with breathtaking speed, he developed techniques that let him adapt his magic on the battlefield in real time. His cheerful, carefree personality belies a deep melancholy, and on quiet days he stands in open fields with his eyes closed, listening — as if the wind might someday carry the memories he has lost back to him.

skills.desc: Whenever Vale kills an enemy hero, he can choose to upgrade one of his skills. Windblow can gain Knock Up or Slow; Windstorm can gain a wider area or a pull effect; Gusting Gale can gain a knockback or a grouping pull on detonation.

Vale calls forth a burst of wind in the target direction, dealing 300–500 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies hit. Depending on his upgrade choice, it either knocks enemies airborne or slows them by 50% for 2 seconds.

Vale summons a whirlwind at the target location that deals 200–350 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second for 3 seconds. Depending on upgrade, it either covers a wider area or slowly pulls enemies toward its center.

Vale summons a massive gale that converges on the target area after a brief delay, dealing 600–1000 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies caught within. Depending on upgrade, it either blasts enemies outward or pulls them into the center before detonating.

story.title: The fallen knight who rides his spectral warhorse into eternal battle
story.lore: Leomord was once the greatest knight of the Moniyan Empire, a warrior of unbreakable conviction who swore to protect his kingdom at any cost. When a supernatural calamity threatened to annihilate his people, Leomord made a desperate pact with a dark power, sacrificing his life and mortality to repel the threat. He succeeded — but was reborn as an undead warrior, cursed to ride his spectral warhorse Barbiel across the eternal battlefield. Though stripped of his humanity, Leomord's sense of honor endures. He fights not for glory or conquest but because the oath he swore in life cannot be broken even in death. His blade strikes with the force of a man who has nothing left to lose — because he has already lost everything.

skills.desc: Leomord's Basic Attacks build dark momentum. When mounted on Barbiel, his attack range increases greatly and his Basic Attacks deal extra Physical Damage in a wide arc in front of him.

Leomord charges his blade with dark energy and delivers a crushing sweep in the target direction, dealing 300–500 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in the path and knocking them airborne briefly.
Leomord creates a zone of dark energy around himself, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

Leomord summons Barbiel, who charges in the target direction. The first enemy hero hit is knocked airborne and Leomord mounts Barbiel, greatly increasing his Movement Speed, Attack Range, and Basic Attack damage for 10 seconds. While mounted, Barbiel can perform a separate charge attack.

story.title: The goddess torn between order and chaos within herself
story.lore: Lunox is a cosmic goddess who embodies the eternal conflict between Order and Chaos. Born from the primordial balance of the universe, she was split into two opposing natures that constantly war within her — the golden light of Order and the violet darkness of Chaos. Unlike other beings who are purely light or dark, Lunox must sustain both in equal measure or risk destruction. This duality makes her one of the most powerful and unpredictable beings in the Land of Dawn. She drifts between states of serene clarity and wild abandon, her magic shifting accordingly. Those who face her never know which aspect of Lunox they will encounter — and in either case, the result is catastrophic.

skills.desc: Lunox alternates between accumulating Chaos and Order stacks from her skills. Chaos stacks amplify her damage output; Order stacks grant survivability and shields. At 4 Chaos stacks her ultimate enters Chaos Mode; at 4 Order stacks it enters Order Mode.

Lunox calls down a rain of starlight in the target area, dealing 250–450 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies hit and restoring 150 HP per enemy hit (up to 5 hits). Grants one Order stack.
Lunox fires a beam of chaotic energy in the target direction, dealing 300–500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies hit. Grants one Chaos stack.
When Lunox uses the power of Order and Chaos, she will deal 300–500 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the targets along the way and slow them by 40% for 2 seconds.

Chaos Mode: Lunox enters a state of pure chaos, becoming immune to crowd control and continuously blasting nearby enemies with chaotic bolts for 3 seconds, each dealing 200–350 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Order Mode: Lunox becomes briefly invulnerable and releases a burst of order energy dealing 400–700 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all nearby enemies.

story.title: The demon ninja who sold his soul for forbidden power
story.lore: Hanzo was a young ninja prodigy who believed that true strength had no limits — and was willing to go to any length to prove it. When he discovered the existence of the Nether Demon, an ancient entity of boundless power, Hanzo sought it out and willingly offered his soul as a vessel. The demon accepted, merging with Hanzo and granting him the ability to separate his spirit from his body — projecting a demonic wraith that could traverse the battlefield unseen while his physical form remained hidden. The price of this power was his humanity. Now neither fully man nor demon, Hanzo stalks the shadows of the Land of Dawn, his true loyalties known only to himself and the darkness within.

skills.desc: Hanzo consumes Demon Blood instead of Mana. He gains Demon Blood by hitting enemies with Basic Attacks and killing units. His Basic Attacks deal extra Physical Damage equal to a portion of his missing HP.

Hanzo sends out a demonic claw in the target direction. If it grabs an enemy, he is pulled toward them and deals 300–500 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, also slowing the target by 40% for 1 second.

Hanzo marks a zone around himself with demon seals. After a brief delay, the seals detonate for 200–350 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in range and slow them by 30% for 2 seconds.

Hanzo sends his spirit out as a powerful demonic wraith, leaving his body behind in a hidden state. The wraith has enhanced attacks and skills. If the wraith is killed, Hanzo's real body is revealed and stunned for 2 seconds. The wraith lasts 15 seconds or until Hanzo recalls it.

story.title: The ancient tree guardian awakened by the land's suffering
story.lore: Belerick is one of the oldest living beings in the Land of Dawn — an ancient tree spirit who slumbered for thousands of years in the heart of the primordial forest. He was awakened by the cries of the land itself as deforestation, war, and dark magic tore through the natural world. Rising from his slumber with the slow, unstoppable force of nature, Belerick became the protector of all living things. He is patient beyond mortal comprehension, yet his wrath when roused is like a storm that has waited an eternity to break. He does not fight out of anger or desire — he fights because nature demands a guardian, and he is the oldest and strongest one that remains.

skills.desc: When Belerick receives damage, he retaliates by dealing 60–120 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all nearby enemies. He can also redirect a portion of damage dealt to nearby allies to himself instead (up to 50%).
Belerick tosses a seed at the target location that blooms into vines, entangling all enemies in the area for 1.5 seconds and dealing 250–450 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Belerick channels nature's power to rapidly regenerate 100–200 HP per second for 3 seconds and reduces incoming damage by 20% during the channel.

Belerick slams the ground to release a massive burst of nature energy around himself, dealing 400–700 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and slowing them by 60% for 2 seconds. Nearby allied heroes are simultaneously healed for 200–400 HP.

story.title: The Eruditio rocket scientist who fights on her custom hoverboard
story.lore: Kimmy is a young genius from Eruditio whose passion for rocket propulsion technology borders on obsession. Having graduated top of her engineering class at an age when most students were still struggling with basic principles, Kimmy built her own hoverjet pack and chemical energy cannon as a personal project — before anyone could tell her she was too young to. When Eruditio came under threat, Kimmy refused to sit in a laboratory while others fought. She strapped on her invention, blasted out through the window, and joined the battle. Her weapon fires a continuous stream of chemical energy that can be aimed freely even while moving, making her a terrifyingly mobile and relentless force on the battlefield.

skills.desc: Kimmy's Basic Attacks fire a continuous stream of chemical energy dealing Magic Damage. She can move freely while shooting and aim the stream independently of her movement direction. Basic Attacks consume Energy instead of Mana.

Kimmy fires an accelerated energy ball in the target direction that explodes on contact, dealing 300–500 (+80% Total Magic Power + 80% Total Physical Attack) Magic Damage to all enemies in the blast radius.
Kimmy rockets in the target direction, rapidly replenishing her Energy. During the dash she is briefly immune to Slow effects.

Kimmy overcharges her cannon and fires a massive chemical blast in the target direction, dealing 500–800 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies hit and slowing them by 50% for 2 seconds. Briefly boosts her own Attack Speed and Movement Speed afterward.

story.title: The Scorching Warlord Risen from the Depths of the Abyss
story.lore: Deep within the darkest reaches of the Abyss lived a demon of incomparable fury — Thamuz, Lord of Lava. Even among demonkind, his name was spoken with fear and reverence. Wielding twin scythes forged from volcanic ore and living flame, Thamuz razed entire civilizations with reckless abandon, leaving only ash in his wake. His unchecked destruction alarmed even the Abyss Lords, who imprisoned him behind ancient binding seals to prevent him from consuming their own ranks. But as the war in the Land of Dawn intensified and the demons faced growing resistance, they had no choice but to release him. Freed from his chains, Thamuz marches once more at the vanguard of destruction — not out of loyalty to the Abyss, but because war and ruin are the only things he has ever known.

skills.desc: Thamuz's Basic Attacks and skills charge up Scorching Heat in his twin scythes. Once fully charged, his scythes ignite for a few seconds, causing his Basic Attacks and skills to additionally deal Physical Damage over time to enemies hit. The ignition state resets after it expires.

Thamuz swings his twin scythes in a wide arc, dealing Physical Damage to all enemies in front of him and generating Scorching Heat. If his scythes are already ignited, the swing releases a crescent wave of lava that travels forward and deals additional Physical Damage to all enemies it passes through.

Thamuz hurls molten lava at the target area, dealing Physical Damage to all enemies within and leaving a pool of burning lava on the ground. Enemies who remain in the lava pool are continuously dealt Physical Damage and have their movement speed reduced.

Thamuz channels his volcanic power to fully ignite his scythes, entering a state of maximum heat. During this state his Skill 1 is empowered — each swing covers a significantly larger arc and deals increased Physical Damage. Thamuz also regenerates HP based on a portion of the total damage he deals to enemies during the state's duration.

story.title: The Restless Leonin Mage Chasing the Edges of Time
story.lore: Among the grand academies of Eruditio, few students drew as much admiration — or as many disciplinary notices — as Harith, the gifted young Leonin prodigy. Blessed with an extraordinary talent for spacetime magic, he mastered in months theories that consumed other scholars for decades. But his restless curiosity and irreverent nature made him a constant source of delightful chaos on campus. When an experiment involving a prototype Chrono Device went catastrophically wrong, Harith found himself hurled through time and witnessed a vision of the Land of Dawn's annihilation. Shaken but more determined than ever, he returned to the present armed with new resolve and a set of Chrono Devices of his own design — utterly convinced that he, alone, can rewrite what he saw.

skills.desc: Whenever Harith hits an enemy Hero with a skill, he reduces the cooldown of Chrono Shield (Skill 1's shield component) by a fixed amount. This effect has a brief internal cooldown.

Harith dashes in the target direction, dealing Magic Damage to all enemies in his path. Upon arriving at his destination, he activates Chrono Shield, granting himself a shield that absorbs a portion of incoming damage. Each time Harith takes a hit while Chrono Shield is active, the cooldown of Lightfall Sword (Skill 2) is reduced.

Harith conjures a massive arcane sword above the target area that crashes down after a brief delay, dealing Magic Damage to all enemies hit and briefly immobilizing them. The cooldown of this skill is further reduced each time Harith's Chrono Shield absorbs damage.

Harith activates his Chrono Devices to generate a powerful arcane energy field at the target location. The field continuously deals Magic Damage to enemies within it and reduces their movement speed. The field also briefly absorbs and neutralizes certain projectile effects that pass through it.

story.title: The Unbreakable Warrior King Who Never Retreats
story.lore: In the kingdom of Minkhya, courage was not merely a virtue — it was law. And no soldier embodied that law more completely than Minsitthar, the general who rose from the rank of foot soldier to become his kingdom's greatest champion. In every battle, he led from the front, his golden spear and lion-crested shield becoming symbols of unyielding resolve across the land. When forces of the Abyss descended upon Minkhya and the royal family was forced to flee, Minsitthar refused to abandon his people. He rallied the remaining defenders and held the line against impossible odds, his voice cutting through the chaos with a single command: forward. His legend spread beyond his kingdom's borders, and even heroes who have never seen his face speak his name with deep respect.

skills.desc: Each time Minsitthar's Basic Attack hits an enemy Hero, he gains a stack of Courage, increasing his Physical Defense for a short duration. Courage stacks can accumulate up to a set maximum and decay when Minsitthar has not recently dealt damage.

Minsitthar hurls his spear in the target direction, dealing Physical Damage to all enemies along the path. The spear then retracts back to Minsitthar, pulling all enemies it contacts on the return trip toward him and dealing Physical Damage to them again.

Minsitthar leaps forward and slams his shield into the ground at the target location, dealing Physical Damage to all nearby enemies and briefly slowing them. This ability can also be used to reposition quickly in close combat.

Minsitthar calls upon the royal guards of Minkhya, summoning four elite warriors who charge to his side and form a protective ring around a target area. While within the ring, the guards continuously strike nearby enemies with their spears, dealing Physical Damage each hit. Enemies inside the ring are also unable to use blink or dash skills for the duration.

story.title: The Cursed Princess Who Became Sovereign of the Southern Seas
story.lore: Kadita was once a beloved princess of a prosperous coastal kingdom, adored by her people and blessed with grace and kindness. Her stepmother, consumed by jealousy and fear of being replaced, conspired with a dark shaman to curse her — warping her body with terrible illness and driving her in a fit of madness into the depths of the sea. As she sank into the dark water, crying out in despair, the Ocean Goddess heard her plea. Moved by her innocence and suffering, the goddess descended and purified her, granting Kadita dominion over the waves and rebirth as an avatar of the ocean. Reborn with the power of the sea coursing through her, Kadita rose from the depths — not to reclaim her throne, but to repay the cruelty done to her and to become the eternal protector of all those who cry out in the darkness.

skills.desc: After Kadita takes damage, she gains a brief regeneration effect, recovering a portion of the damage taken as HP over a few seconds. This passive has a cooldown before it can trigger again.

Kadita designates a target area where ocean currents gather beneath the surface. After a short delay, a powerful wave erupts upward, knocking up and dealing Magic Damage to all enemies caught within the area.
Kadita conjures a series of rolling ocean waves in the target direction. The waves travel forward sequentially, dealing Magic Damage and slowing each enemy they hit.

Kadita dissolves into the sea and becomes briefly untargetable as she surges beneath the battlefield in the target direction. She then re-emerges in a massive explosion of ocean power, dealing heavy Magic Damage to all enemies in the area. Kadita heals herself for a portion of the total damage dealt by this ability.

story.title: The Undying Soul Binder Who Walks Between Life and Death
story.lore: Faramis was once a brilliant but obsessive scholar of forbidden arcane arts in Eruditio, consumed by a singular question: what truly lies beyond death? His research led him deep into necromancy and the nature of souls, and he paid a catastrophic price when a ritual experiment shattered his physical form. Yet his consciousness refused to dissolve, clinging to existence through sheer force of will and the dark energy he had spent years accumulating. Now bound to the physical plane as something between a spirit and a sorcerer, Faramis sustains himself by harvesting residual soul energy from the battlefield. He offers his gift — the ability to cheat death — to those willing to trust him. Many who look upon him see a monster. Faramis simply calls himself the inevitable.

skills.desc: After Faramis casts a skill, he places a Soul Curse on nearby enemy Heroes for a few seconds. Allied Heroes nearby can drain the Soul Curse from afflicted enemies through their Basic Attacks, each drain granting the ally a Soul Stack. At maximum Soul Stacks, the ally's next Basic Attack deals bonus Magic Damage.

Faramis summons swirling dark tendrils from the shadows around himself, lashing out and dealing Magic Damage to all nearby enemies. Enemies hit are briefly slowed. Each enemy struck by this ability contributes Soul Stacks to nearby allies.

Faramis blinks to the target location, leaving a spectral clone at his original position. The clone detonates after a short delay, dealing Magic Damage to all enemies around it. The blink itself also passes through thin walls and terrain.

Faramis erects a Cult Altar at the target location for several seconds. Any allied Hero who dies within the altar's radius is immediately reborn within the altar with a portion of their HP and temporarily benefits from enhanced movement speed. The altar can revive multiple allies during its duration.

story.title: The Legendary Tribal Champion Whose Fists Split the Earth
story.lore: The folk tales of Badang's homeland are filled with warriors and kings, but none are as beloved as Badang himself. Born to a poor fishing village on the coast, his life changed on the day he captured a mischievous river spirit in his nets and refused to release it until it granted him a wish. The spirit, defeated, bestowed upon him the gift of impossible strength — power so immense that Badang could shatter boulders with his bare hands, and with a single punch, send walls of stone tumbling into the sea. He rose to become the greatest champion of his people, his fame spreading to kingdoms far beyond his own. Though he passed into legend long ago, the stories endured. Now his spirit has returned to the Land of Dawn — embodying the legend itself, with fists that carry the force of a hurricane.

skills.desc: Badang's Basic Attacks and Skill 1 can knock enemies into a Windwall. When an enemy is pinned against a Windwall by Skill 1, they are briefly stunned and take bonus Physical Damage. Enemies pinned against a wall by Badang's Ultimate take significantly increased damage per hit.

Badang charges forward with a powerful fist strike in the target direction, dealing Physical Damage to all enemies in his path and pushing them back. A Windwall of compressed air is left behind at the location of impact. The Windwall blocks enemy movement and projectiles for several seconds.

Badang unleashes a focused burst of compressed wind energy in the target direction, dealing Physical Damage to all enemies hit and pushing them away from him. If enemies are pushed into an existing Windwall, they are briefly stunned.

Badang charges up and then rapidly fires a storm of powerful compressed-air fist blasts in the target direction, dealing multiple instances of Physical Damage to all enemies in the area over a short duration. Each blast can push enemies, and if enemies are pinned against a Windwall during the barrage, each hit deals substantially increased damage.

story.title: The Ancient Tyrant Awakened from the Sands of Time
story.lore: Thousands of years ago, Khufra ruled his desert kingdom with absolute iron will, his name sufficient to silence dissent across entire provinces. Consumed by a hunger for eternal dominion, he forged a pact with a dark relic, binding his life force to its power in exchange for immortality. But the moon priestess Vexana, sworn enemy of his cruelty, placed an ancient curse upon him and sealed his soul within a cursed bandaged shell deep beneath the desert sands. For millennia he lay dormant — his consciousness intact, his rage undiminished, his hatred growing with each passing century. When the magical upheavals of the modern era cracked his prison seals, Khufra rose again, stepping into a world he no longer recognized. He does not care. He has come to reclaim everything that is his, and to destroy every barrier that dares stand between him and his throne.

skills.desc: Khufra's Basic Attacks charge up a magical curse. At full charge, his next Basic Attack releases the curse, dealing bonus Magic Damage to the target and slowing their movement speed for a short duration.

Khufra transforms his lower body into a massive bouncing orb and launches himself in the target direction, dealing Magic Damage to enemies he collides with and knocking them into the air. He bounces multiple times before stopping, but will halt if he collides with terrain. Each bounce can affect different enemies.

Khufra inflates his body to an enormous size for a short duration, dealing Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and knocking them away. Any enemy Hero who attempts to use a blink or dash skill while passing through Khufra during this state is immediately knocked into the air and briefly stunned.

Khufra reaches out and grabs a nearby enemy Hero, swings them overhead in a wide arc, and slams them into the ground with tremendous force, dealing Physical Damage to the grabbed target. The impact creates a shockwave that stuns all other enemies caught in the blast radius.

story.title: The Wandering Gunslinger Playing the Last Requiem
story.lore: Granger was once a boy with nothing — abandoned, nameless, surviving alone on the cold streets outside Eruditio. He found his first companion not in a person, but in a battered violin he salvaged from a rubbish heap. He taught himself to play by ear, and his haunting, imperfect melodies became the only warmth in an otherwise brutal existence. It was music that eventually earned him a place in a hunter's guild, and music that masked the growing coldness in his heart as the years of violence accumulated. He converted his violin into a custom revolver — his way of merging the two things that defined him — and became one of the most feared bounty hunters in the Land of Dawn. He rarely speaks. He rarely smiles. But in the silence of an empty road, he still plays, mournful notes drifting into the dark for no audience at all.

skills.desc: Granger loads his revolver with bullets in sets of 6. Every 6th bullet is an enchanted Death Bullet that deals bonus Physical Damage and ignores a portion of the target's Physical Defense. Any remaining ordinary bullets are discarded when Granger uses a skill, and he reloads automatically.

Granger fires a rapid burst of bullets in the target direction, with each bullet dealing Physical Damage to the first enemy hit. The final bullet in the burst deals significantly increased damage. This ability consumes the bullets currently loaded in Granger's revolver.

Granger performs a quick sidestep dash in the target direction. He may store up to 2 charges of this ability simultaneously, allowing him to dash twice in rapid succession for repositioning in or out of combat.

Granger assembles his instrument into its full sniper-rifle configuration and fires 2 massive, high-velocity shells in rapid succession along a straight line. Each shell deals heavy Physical Damage to all enemies it passes through. Granger may use Rondo to reposition between the two shots. Both shots consume ammunition and can critically strike.

story.title: The Violet Noble Whose Heart Hides a Blazing Arcane Fire
story.lore: Guinevere is the vivacious, spirited daughter of the noble Paxley family — a household renowned across the Land of Dawn for its mastery of spacetime magic. Where her brother Gusion embraced shadows and the blade, Guinevere channeled the family's arcane legacy through her enchanted violet handbag and her own irrepressible personality. On the surface she is all charm and laughter, bouncing from one adventure to the next with boundless energy. Beneath it lies something fierce and unyielding. When Gusion disappeared down a dangerous path, Guinevere did not mourn at home — she picked up her handbag and went after him. Armed with crackling violet arcane magic and an absolute refusal to back down, she leaps headlong into every battle not because she must, but because she genuinely, wholeheartedly enjoys it.

skills.desc: Guinevere's Basic Attacks and skills generate Arcane Stacks. Upon reaching maximum stacks, her next Basic Attack discharges all stored energy, dealing bonus Magic Damage to the target and surrounding enemies.

Guinevere blinks to the target location. Upon arrival, she fires a burst of arcane energy outward, launching all nearby enemies briefly into the air. This skill can be cast a second time shortly after the first to blink again and extend the combo.

Guinevere releases a crackling wave of violet arcane energy in the target direction, dealing Magic Damage to enemies hit and reducing their Magic Defense for a short duration. The wave passes through minions and targets the first enemy Hero it contacts for maximum effect.

Guinevere leaps into the air and crashes down in a brilliant display of arcane force onto the target area, dealing heavy Magic Damage to all enemies within range. Enemies who are currently airborne from her Skill 1 are suspended in the air for a significantly extended duration, allowing allies to follow up.

story.title: The Star-Touched Astrologer Who Turns Fate Into Fortune
story.lore: High above the mage city in a celestial observatory perched on the clouds, Esmeralda spent her youth charting the movements of stars and reading the weave of fate in the cosmos. As a child, she discovered she could not only interpret the stars — she could reach into the stardust itself and reshape it. Her unique affinity with astral energy granted her a rare gift: the ability to absorb and transmute magical shields, converting the protection of her enemies into her own. When the stars she had charted her whole life began to align in patterns that foretold a great calamity for the Land of Dawn, Esmeralda did not retreat to the safety of her tower. She descended, her shimmering cosmic scarf trailing behind her, determined to read a different ending into the fate the heavens had written — one where those she loves survive.

skills.desc: Each time Esmeralda deals damage to an enemy with her skills, she generates Stardust. Accumulated Stardust is converted into a Shield that protects her. When Esmeralda hits an enemy who has a shield of their own, she drains a portion of that shield and converts it into her own.

Esmeralda swings her cosmic chain in an arc around herself, dealing Magic Damage to nearby enemies and generating a substantial amount of Stardust. Any enemy Hero with an active shield struck by this skill has a portion of their shield stolen and transferred to Esmeralda.

Esmeralda spins in place for a brief duration, continuously dealing Magic Damage to all nearby enemies with each rotation. Each spin generates Stardust and builds up her shield, making her increasingly durable the longer she stays in the middle of a fight.

Esmeralda launches a massive comet of compressed stellar energy at the target location. Upon impact it explodes, dealing heavy Magic Damage to all enemies in a large area and briefly slowing them. Esmeralda gains a significant shield based on the total damage dealt by the comet's impact.

story.title: The Scorned Blacksmith Who Forged His Own Revenge
story.lore: Once the most celebrated craftsman of Lumina City and leader of the Free Smiths' Guild, Terizla was a man of principle who openly defied the Monastery of Light's stranglehold on the city's artisans. His exceptional craft earned him the love of the people and the envy of rivals. Those rivals conspired to frame him as a practitioner of Black Magic, and before he could return home from his workshop with a birthday gift for his son, the Church's Ravens had already laid waste to the Guild's fortress. His family was gone. His people were gone. In the dungeon of the Monastery, Terizla endured years of torment that hardened his grief into something colder and heavier than steel. When he finally escaped, he did not seek redemption. He picked up his hammer, sided with the Abyss, and swore that the Church would pay for every name carved into that burning ruin.

skills.desc: Every 2.5% of Terizla's HP lost converts to 1% Damage Reduction, up to a maximum of 20 (+1 × Hero Level)%. Terizla cannot gain bonus Attack Speed; every 1% extra Attack Speed he would receive is instead converted into 1 additional Physical Attack.

Terizla slams his hammer into the ground, sending a fissure forward that deals 300 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and slows them by 15%. The fissure then drills into that target and explodes after 3.5s, dealing an additional 300 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) plus 20% of the target's lost HP as Physical Damage. Terizla gains 15% Movement Speed for 3.5s upon casting. Cooldown: 7s.

Terizla swings his hammer in a fan-shaped arc up to 3 consecutive times. The first two swings each deal 90 (+135% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow enemies by 20% for 1.25s (slows stack). The third swing deals 225 (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and applies the same stacking slow. Deals only 80% damage to Minions. Cooldown: 5s.

Terizla leaps to a designated area and slams down, dealing 300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking nearby enemies airborne for 0.6s upon landing. He then summons a Scaffold that slows enemies within its range by 25% and repeatedly fires hooks at enemy Heroes, pulling them back and dealing 150 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per pull for the duration. Cooldown: 40–30s.

story.title: The Flame-Clad Avenger Who Burns Away Everything He Once Loved
story.lore: X.Borg grew up in a village on the outskirts of Eruditio, gazing up at the city's towers with pure admiration. He signed on to a local mining project to serve the city he idolized, but a catastrophic fuel leak on-site left his body severely burned. Rushed to Eruditio, he was rebuilt from the wreckage using the city's most advanced neuroprosthetics by the research team of Dr. Rooney. He awoke in a new mechanical body with a promised future. What he was never told was that his village — his home, his family, every face he had ever known — had perished in the same accident. When he finally learned the truth, the grief and rage fused into something unquenchable. X.Borg converted his rebuilt body into a walking weapon of fire and detonation, disappeared into the scrap yards, and began his one-man war against Eruditio — determined to burn away every gilded lie that institution ever built.

skills.desc: X.Borg is protected by a Firaga Armor that inherits 160% of his Max HP and absorbs all incoming damage in his place. When the Armor is destroyed, X.Borg rolls in the joystick direction (briefly invincible) and enters Armorless State, during which the Armor's energy regenerates over time. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the Armor restored to 30% HP. X.Borg's attacks cause enemies to enter Overheated state; Overheated enemies drop Firaga Supplies when damaged by X.Borg, and picking up Supplies restores 10% Armor HP (or 10 energy in Armorless State). All of X.Borg's skills deal True Damage to enemies in Overheated state.

X.Borg activates his flamethrower and sprays fire in a cone ahead, dealing 40 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit continuously for 2s and building up enemy temperature toward Overheated state. In Armorless State, Fire Missiles adjusts to a narrower but longer flame stream, though at slightly reduced damage. Enemies in Overheated state take True Damage instead. Fire Missiles cannot be seen from outside a bush when cast within one.

X.Borg fires 5 Fire Stakes in a fan-shaped spread forward. Each stake deals 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. After 1.7s, the stakes retract and pull enemies and any Firaga Supplies along their path back toward X.Borg. Can be cast while using other skills. In Armorless State, Fire Stake adjusts the launcher so the stakes travel farther and are spaced closer together, ideal for collecting dropped Supplies in one pass.

X.Borg charges in the target direction while spinning and spraying fire, dealing 90 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) (+45% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 12 times to enemies hit and slowing them by 25%. He stops when he makes contact with an enemy hero, applying an additional 40% slow to that target. After 3s, his Firaga Armor detonates, dealing 300 + 15% of the target's Max HP as True Damage in an area. If the Armor is destroyed before detonation, the explosion triggers immediately at 50% damage. Cannot be used in Armorless State. Can be manually detonated early by casting the skill again. Cooldown: 36–24s.

story.title: The Shadowless Swordsman Who Dances Between Heaven and Earth
story.lore: In the martial world of the Cadia Riverlands, there are warriors — and then there is Ling. Raised in a hidden sect that refined the ancient art of Qinggong to its absolute extreme, Ling mastered the ability to traverse walls and leap between surfaces as naturally as breathing. His footsteps leave no sound, his passage leaves no shadow, and his blade finds its mark before most opponents know he has moved. But mastery brought restlessness. With no equal among his sect and no challenge left on the mountain, Ling descended into the wider world — not in pursuit of glory or some great destiny, but simply because the fight is the only thing that still makes him feel alive. With his Cyan Finch blade and a constant, irreverent smirk, he wanders the Land of Dawn, looking for someone worthy enough to make him take the fight seriously.

skills.desc: Ling's Critical Chance is permanently increased by 2.5%. He also gains double the Crit Chance from all other sources (items, emblems, etc.). Ling uses Lightness Points as energy for his skills; these regenerate faster while standing on a wall and restore a small amount each time he deals damage to enemies.

Ling leaps onto a designated wall, entering a half-stealth state that makes him harder to detect, restoring Lightness Points at an accelerated rate, and gaining 30% Movement Speed. The cooldown resets and the half-stealth state refreshes each time he uses this skill to leap from one wall to another. Ling falls to the ground and is slowed by 30% for 2s if he receives hard CC while on a wall. Cooldown: 11–9s.

Ling charges forward and stabs nearby enemies, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If cast while on a wall (no Lightness Point cost), he instead dashes to a designated location on the ground, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. This skill is counted as a Basic Attack.

Ling leaps into the air and becomes invincible for 1.5s, gaining 10% extra Movement Speed and ignoring terrain. He then lands, dealing 250 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area, slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, and knocking those at the center airborne for 1s. A Sword Field persists for 8s at the landing site. Four Tempest of Blades appear at the edge of the field; touching each one reduces the cooldown of Finch Poise by 4s, immediately resets the cooldown of Defiant Sword, and restores 25 Lightness Points. Cooldown: 46–38s.

story.title: The Prince of Light Who Welcomed the Darkness of the Abyss
story.lore: Dyrroth was once a prince of the Moniyan Empire, born into the light, raised on its ideals. All of that ended the day Alice, the Queen of Blood, abducted him and carried him into the depths of the Abyss. In a realm where power is the only currency and cruelty is the only language, the boy who had known nothing but grace was remade. Though not born of demon blood, Dyrroth did not merely survive the Abyss — he flourished in it. He willfully hastened his own corruption, reforging his flesh in darkness, to prove to himself and to every demon around him that he belonged. He severed every bond with the light, with his past, with the empire, with the sister who never stopped searching for him. And yet somewhere in the creature he has become, in the savage Prince of the Abyss who fights without mercy, a fragment of what he once was still flickers — a fact that infuriates him most of all.

skills.desc: Dyrroth has a Rage bar that recovers 2%–5% per second (scales with level). When Rage reaches 50%, Burst Strike and Spectre Step are Abyss Enhanced. After every 2 Basic Attacks, Dyrroth unleashes a Circle Strike, dealing (150%–180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (scales with level) to nearby enemies in an area; this strike does not trigger Attack Effects. Each time Dyrroth damages an enemy, the cooldowns of Burst Strike and Spectre Step are each reduced by 1s.

Dyrroth unleashes a burst of energy in a designated direction, dealing 240 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 25% for 1.5s. Damage decays against the same target hit multiple times and is reduced to 75% against Minions. Abyss Enhanced: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of its original damage, and its Slowing Effect is doubled to 50% for 1.5s.

Dyrroth dashes in the designated direction, stopping when he has traveled the max distance or hits a non-Minion enemy or Creep, dealing 230 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target. Abyss Enhanced: The second stage of Spectre Step reduces the target's Physical Defense by 75% for 3s, making it the primary shred tool against tanky opponents.

Dyrroth charges up his Abyss power and unleashes a devastating forward strike, dealing heavy Physical Damage to enemies in a line. Enemies hit also take additional Physical Damage equal to a percentage of their missing HP, allowing Abysm Strike to execute low-health targets for significantly amplified total damage. This skill has a brief charge animation before releasing.

story.title: The Little Witch Whose Shadow Companion Devours the Light
story.lore: Lylia comes from the frozen city of Iceborn in the Northern Vale, born to a family of minor enchanters who could barely keep the hearth lit. Her gift for dark magic manifested young — too young, and far too powerfully, for the polite magical society around her to accept. It was Gloom who found her first, or perhaps she called him into existence without knowing it: a sentient shadow that shares her appetite for mischief and her contempt for anyone who tells her what she cannot do. Together, Lylia and Gloom left Iceborn far behind, traveling the Land of Dawn and wreaking magical havoc wherever they landed. She does not see herself as dangerous. She sees herself as curious. The craters and fleeing enemies she leaves in her wake, she considers a perfectly reasonable side effect of that curiosity.

skills.desc: Lylia draws power from Gloom, permanently gaining 15% Movement Speed. Each time Gloom devours a Shadow Energy orb and gains an upgrade, Lylia gains an additional 5% Movement Speed bonus (up to 5 upgrades, maximum 40% total from this passive). Each Gloom upgrade also increases the detonation damage of Shadow Energy.

Lylia sends out Gloom riding a shockwave in a target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a line and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. If Gloom contacts a Shadow Energy orb along the path, he immediately devours and detonates it. Gloom restores 20% of Shadow Energy's Recharge Time each time he hits an enemy Hero with this skill.

Lylia condenses Shadow Energy at the target location, dealing 90 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 80% briefly. The Shadow Energy orb lingers at the target spot until detonated by Gloom. Detonation deals 220 (+115% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Each Gloom upgrade increases detonation damage by 20%, up to a maximum bonus of 80%. Lylia starts with 1 Shadow Energy charge and stores an additional charge every 6s (max 2 charges).

Lylia recalls to where her Black Shoes were located 4 seconds ago, instantly removing all debuffs on her and restoring her HP and Mana to the values from that moment, plus an extra 10% of her Max HP. She also gains 20% extra Movement Speed for 2s upon arrival.

story.title: The Ancient Mystic Tortoise Who Guards the Balance of the Cadia Riverlands
story.lore: Long before the conflicts of the modern era, Baxia and Yu Zhong trained together under the Great Dragon, bound by a brotherhood forged in discipline and devotion to their shared guardian duty. When Yu Zhong's ambition twisted into betrayal and he made his move against the Great Dragon itself, it was Baxia who stood in his way. Using his enchanted shield and the mystic power of his ancient tortoise lineage, Baxia drove his former brother out of the realm and sealed the breach. He returned to his vigil, silent and tireless, for years uncounted. Now the tremors have returned. The Black Dragon stirs again in the depths, and Baxia can feel it in the currents of the Cadia Riverlands. He does not rush. He does not fear. He simply rolls forward, shield first, to do exactly what he always has — hold the line.

skills.desc: Baxia permanently activates Baxia Mark, reducing all final incoming damage by a flat 25. Additionally, every time Baxia's skills hit an enemy, their Shield generation and HP Regen are reduced by 50% for 4s. This anti-heal effect is especially effective against regeneration-reliant heroes.

Baxia retracts himself into his shield and accelerates forward. Upon hitting an enemy unit, he deals 300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target and nearby enemies, stunning the target for 0.8s and slightly knocking back other nearby enemies. During the forward charge, casting the skill again launches Baxia upward, allowing him to leap over obstacles and Minions. If an enemy hero is directly beneath Baxia as he lands, the landing deals 375 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, stuns the target for 1.5s, and slightly knocks back other nearby enemies. Cooldown: 11–8s.

Baxia hurls his shield forward, dealing 180 (+120% Total Magic Power) + 6% of the target's Max HP as Magic Damage to enemies along the path, marking them for 5s, and slowing them by 50% for 1s. The shield disappears upon hitting the first enemy Hero or Creep. Shortly after, the skill can be cast a second time. If the shield hits an enemy Hero or Creep, its cooldown is immediately reduced to 15% of its total value. Cooldown: 11–8s.

Baxia raises his shield to the front and charges forward at high speed, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 10s. As he moves, he leaves a trail of lava on the ground behind him. Enemies on the lava path take 40 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are slowed by 15% for 0.5s every 0.5s. While the Ultimate is active, Baxia Mark's Damage Reduction is increased from 25 flat to 200% damage reduction (essentially near-immunity to small instances of damage). Cooldown: 40–30s.

story.title: The Three-Lived Bear Fighter Whose Wrath Shakes the Mountain
story.lore: In the rugged wilderness of the Northern Vale, the people of Masha's clan do not speak of her birth — they speak of the night three wolves howled in unison and a child was born who would not stop crying until dawn. Raised by a warrior tribe that measured worth purely in strength, Masha was fighting before she could read. Her body, unlike any ordinary human's, seemed to carry three separate reservoirs of vitality — as if nature itself had decided one life was not enough to contain her. She has traded blows with monsters, razed bandit camps alone, and reportedly survived being crushed beneath a glacial boulder by simply getting angrier. She travels the Land of Dawn in search of challenges large enough to be worth her time, and the trail of collapsed terrain and bewildered enemies she leaves behind her suggests she has not yet found one.

skills.desc: Masha has 3 HP bars and will not die until the final bar is depleted. Each time she loses an HP bar, she ignores 1 instance of damage. Masha also gains 1.8% extra Attack Speed for every 1% of her total HP lost across all 3 bars. Upon losing her 1st HP bar, she gains 25% extra Physical Lifesteal. Upon losing her 2nd HP bar, she gains an additional 15% Physical Lifesteal and 60% Resilience. Masha generates Energy when dealing damage (3 per hit on Heroes or Creeps, 1 per hit on Minions). After being out of combat for 3s, she may spend 50 Energy to recover one full HP bar.

Masha spends a portion of her current HP to enter a wild state, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed and causing her Basic Attacks to deal an additional 60 (+1% Total HP) Physical Damage each (only 30% of this extra damage applies to Minions and turrets). Masha loses 4% of 1 HP bar's Max HP every 0.5s while in this state. She may end Wild Power early by casting the skill again.
