Masha spends a portion of her HP to unleash an energy shockwave in the target direction, dealing 200 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy Hero or Creep hit and slowing their Movement Speed by 40% and Attack Speed by a significant amount for 2s.

Masha spends 50% of her current HP (calculated per 1 HP bar) to charge directly at the target enemy hero, dealing 300 (+30% Extra HP) Physical Damage and slowing them by 90% for 1s. Masha is immune to all control effects during the charge and gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 3s afterward. The cooldown of Wild Charge resets each time Masha loses one HP bar.

story.title: The Tiger-Chosen Archer Who Carries the Crossbow of Tang
story.lore: Wanwan grew up in a secluded mountain retreat, trained from childhood in the ancient martial arts of the Orient, with a carefree spirit that made even her hardest days feel like an adventure. She knew nothing of destiny or chosen warriors until the day she crossed paths with Yu Zhong — the reincarnation of the Black Dragon — and found herself pulled into a conflict that stretched across centuries. The mark of the Agile Tiger, one of the Four Immortals of the Cadia Riverlands, had been with her all along, waiting for the moment her heart was strong enough to bear it. Armed with the legendary Crossbow of Tang and the quick, dancing footwork of her Tiger-spirit, Wanwan does not approach the battlefield with gravity or ceremony. She approaches it the same way she approaches everything — with a grin, at full speed, and with an arrow already in flight.

skills.desc: Wanwan's Basic Attacks expose an enemy hero's weaknesses (marked positions on their body). When she hits a weakness, she deals an extra 67 (+3 × Hero Level) True Damage and increases the damage that enemy takes from all of her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5s. After each arrow is fired from her Basic Attack, Wanwan can immediately dash a short distance in any direction; the dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.

Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering Tiger Pace (dash) and dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path. The Fire Swallow then splits into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these daggers fly back one by one toward Wanwan, each dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on their return path and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. Enemies struck twice by the returning daggers are immobilized for 0.5s. Cooldown: 10–8s.

Wanwan instantly removes all control effects currently on herself and triggers Tiger Pace (immediately dashing a short distance). This skill provides a critical escape tool and can be used to quickly reposition to avoid burst damage or CC chains. Cooldown: 18–14s.

Can only be cast when all weaknesses of at least one enemy hero have been exposed by Tiger Pace. Wanwan leaps into the air, becoming fully untargetable, and fires a rapid barrage of arrows at the target enemy for 2.5s, dealing 60 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per arrow; the firing rate scales with her Attack Speed. Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. If the target is killed during the assault, Wanwan switches to another enemy hero in range, gains 30% Attack Speed, and extends the duration by 1s (can occur up to 3 times). Cooldown: 40–30s.

story.title: The Imperial Knightess Who Will Not Rest Until She Brings Her Brother Home
story.lore: Silvanna is the daughter of the Paxley family and a knight of the Moniyan Empire, but every rank she earned and every battle she won was in service of a single goal: finding Dyrroth. When her younger brother — then the Empire's beloved prince of light — was abducted by Alice and dragged into the Abyss, the world moved on. The Empire mourned and made arrangements. Silvanna did not move on. She trained harder than any knight before her, mastering the lance arts of the Moniyan tradition until her Imperial Justice technique was unmatched, then descended into the war between light and darkness with a singular stubbornness that even her enemies have come to respect. She has faced what Dyrroth has become — the Prince of the Abyss, the thing that wears her brother's face — and she has not given up. She will not give up. She has decided she will bring him back even if she has to drag him across every dimension in the Land of Dawn to do it.

skills.desc: Silvanna's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+45% Total Physical Attack) (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage instead of Physical Damage. Each Basic Attack or skill hit applies a mark on enemy heroes for 5s, with each mark reducing the target's Physical and Magic Defense by 3–6 (scales with level), stacking up to 5 times. Silvanna's skills and Basic Attacks deal 30% extra damage to enemies with the maximum 5 marks.

Silvanna dashes forward with her lance. Upon reaching maximum range or hitting a non-Minion enemy, she swings the lance in an arc, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and stunning them for 1s. Cooldown: 10–8s.

Silvanna thrusts her lance in the target direction and spins it rapidly 6 times, with each spin dealing 165 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slightly pulling nearby targets toward the center. She simultaneously gains a 350 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield. Silvanna performs 1 additional spin for every 50% extra Attack Speed she possesses. Cooldown: 9–7s.

Silvanna leaps to the target location and creates a Circle of Light upon landing, dealing 350 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area, slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, and restraining the closest enemy hero within the circle for 3.5s (they cannot leave the circle's boundary). This skill cannot be interrupted. While inside the Circle, Silvanna gains 100% Attack Speed and 40% Physical Lifesteal. Cooldown: 45s at all levels.

story.title: The Undying Count Who Chose Love Over an Eternity Alone
story.lore: Cecilion is a Blood Demon of immense age and power — one of the few of his kind who chose exile from demon society rather than the savagery that defined it. He moved through the world quietly, watching centuries pass, wanting nothing except perhaps for it all to stop feeling so endless. Then he met Carmilla — a human girl of no particular standing, with no magic and no title, whose warmth and laughter did something to him that a thousand years of solitude had not. He loved her, and he believed that love was an impossibility he was not permitted to keep. He left her to spare her his world. What he did not know was that she could not survive without him. When he returned to find her gone, the grief that had accumulated over a millennium collapsed into a single unbearable moment. He used the darkest of his Blood Demon arts to do the one thing he had always refused to do — he turned her, binding her to his eternal existence. They have been inseparable since, two creatures who chose each other over everything else, wandering the Land of Dawn as both its most dangerous and most devoted pair.

skills.desc: Each time Cecilion's skills hit an enemy, he permanently gains 10 extra Max Mana and recovers 10 Mana. This effect has a 1s cooldown. Cecilion has naturally higher Max Mana and higher Mana Regen than other heroes, and his skill damage scales with his total Max Mana — making him uniquely powerful in extended fights where Mana stacks accumulate.

Cecilion orders a giant bat to dive at the target location, dealing 85 (+80% Total Magic Power) (+5% Total Mana) Magic Damage to enemies along the bat's path and 170 (+160% Total Magic Power) (+10% Total Mana) extra Magic Damage to those near the landing point. Each subsequent cast of this skill within 6s increases its Mana cost by 1.8× (up to 4 stacks), incentivizing rapid-fire spam for maximum damage at increasing Mana expense. Cooldown: 2s.

Cecilion summons a pair of opposing giant claws at the target location. After a short delay, the claws clasp together, pulling all enemies in their path toward the center, dealing 200 (+45% Total Magic Power) (+1.2% Total Mana) Magic Damage to them, and immobilizing them for 1s. Cooldown: 11–9s.

Cecilion unleashes his Blood Demon power, instantly gaining 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over 1.5s) and Slow Immunity for 1.5s. He then fires a rapid volley of 40 blood energy bolts at nearby enemies. Each bolt deals 35 (+8% Total Magic Power) (+0.3% Total Mana) Magic Damage, slows enemies by 3% for 1s (stacking up to 30% total), and restores 10 HP plus 1% of Cecilion's lost HP to him on hit. When Carmilla is nearby, Cecilion can summon her as a Vermil Shadow around himself, granting him a 520–800 (scales with Carmilla's level) shield. Carmilla may then choose to leave Cecilion and charge at the target location, gaining an equal shield and dealing 520–800 Magic Damage to nearby enemies while slowing them. Cooldown: 55–45s.

story.title: The blood demon noble bound by an eternal forbidden love
story.lore: Carmilla was born into the noble House Ansaac of Castle Aberleen in the Moniyan Empire. As the only daughter of Earl Ansaac, she was adored by all and became one of the most celebrated ladies in the realm. However, her father sought to use her as a political tool, betrothing her against her will to Baron Tawil. Unknown to the Earl, Carmilla had fallen deeply in love with a humble opera performer named Cecilion — who was secretly a Blood Demon. When her father discovered the affair and closed the opera house to separate them, Cecilion, believing their love could never truly be, chose to leave her a farewell letter and disappear. Heartbroken and refusing to submit to her father's will, Carmilla slit her wrist at dawn as the world fell into darkness. She awoke in Cecilion's arms — he had returned and revived her with his own blood, transforming her into a Blood Demon. Engulfed in both grief and joy, Carmilla held him tightly, vowing they would never be separated again. From that night on, the two left the world behind and lived together in eternal darkness, their legend whispered across the lands as a sorrowful yet epic romance.

skills.desc: Each time Carmilla deals damage to an enemy hero, she steals 6–12 Physical and Magic Defense from them (scales with level). This steal can only occur once every 5 seconds per enemy and stacks up to 5 times, granting Carmilla powerful durability the longer she stays in combat.

Carmilla summons 2 revolving Crimson Flowers around her for 5 seconds. Each time a flower strikes an enemy hero, it deals 120–270 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, slows them by 30% for 0.8 seconds, and accelerates its rotation speed. Every hit also restores 75–135 HP (+25% Total Magic Power) for Carmilla. The heal is reduced to 30% when hitting minions.

Carmilla accumulates Bloodbath Energy, gaining up to 70% Movement Speed that decays over 4.5 seconds. Use Again: Carmilla unleashes the accumulated energy at the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 150–300 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.6–1.2 seconds. Both the damage and stun duration scale with the amount of energy charged (up to 100%).

Carmilla casts Curse of Blood on a target area, slowing enemies hit by 50%. After 0.8 seconds, enemies still within the area take 450 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, are immobilized for 1 second, and are linked for 5 seconds. While linked, any damage or crowd control effect dealt to one enemy is shared at 50% to all other linked targets. Enemies can break the link by moving far apart.

story.title: The ancient deep-sea creature who escaped the Abysmal Sea in a mecha shell
story.lore: Beneath the surface of the Land of Dawn lies the Abysmal Sea — a cold, pitch-black abyss that no human has ever survived. Here, among the ruins of forgotten civilizations, lived Atlas and his kind: ancient creatures imprisoned by the Ancient Ones for their overwhelming elemental power. Sensing a change in the depths, Atlas became the first of his kind to seek escape. Knowing their bodies would be torn apart by the ascent, he searched the ruins for a rigid shell and discovered the Mecha Sentry — a colossal war machine left behind by the Iceland Golems. Donning it, Atlas shattered the Injunction and became the only creature to ever leave the Abysmal Sea. He now walks the Land of Dawn, driven by the desire to find the legendary treasure of Northern Vale that is said to have the power to regenerate an entire ocean — and ultimately, to free the rest of his kind from their eternal imprisonment.

skills.desc: Each time Atlas casts a skill, he generates Frigid Breath around him for 5 seconds. Enemies who remain in the Frigid Breath area have their Movement Speed gradually reduced over 3 seconds, after which they are frozen for 0.5 seconds. Atlas also gains 16–30 extra Physical and Magic Defense while Frigid Breath is active.

Atlas smashes the ground, causing 3 successive explosions. Each explosion deals 215–430 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. In Ejected State, both Atlas and the Mecha Sentry cast Annihilate simultaneously. Enemies hit by the outer edge of the AoE are stunned for 1 second.

Atlas ejects from his Mecha Sentry, gaining 40% Movement Speed and immunity to slowing effects. The Mecha Sentry follows the pilot at increasing speed. When they reunite, Atlas deals 320–420 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 1 second. In Ejected State, Atlas and the Mecha share the same HP bar and gain 50% Damage Reduction.

Atlas hurls chains at all nearby enemy heroes and begins channeling (can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 225–475 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds. Use Again: Atlas leaps to a designated location, dragging all chained targets with him and slamming them down, dealing 360–760 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. In Ejected State, the Mecha Sentry returns to Atlas immediately instead, replacing the slam with a 40% slow effect.

story.title: The mischievous spear boy and his Icefield wolf companion
story.lore: Popol was the most spirited boy of the Feldan tribe in the Northern Vale — a naughty prankster and little adventurer who dreamed of becoming a legendary hero. One day, eager to prove himself, he ventured alone into the wilderness to hunt the fearsome Icefield Dire Wolves. He fell into a hidden trap, and there at the bottom, staring back at him with glowing blue eyes, was a dire wolf called Kupa — injured and starving, caught in the same pit. Rather than kill Kupa, Popol shared his food and tended to the wolf's wounded paw. Over the days they spent trapped together, the two lonely souls lowered their guards. When a flock of vultures descended to make them their meal, Popol pried open Kupa's beast trap with his bare hands to set him free, and together they fought off the birds. From that moment on, Popol and Kupa became inseparable companions, traveling the frozen lands as the closest of partners and embarking on legendary adventures across the Land of Dawn.

skills.desc: Kupa recovers 10% Max HP per second after not taking damage for 5 seconds. When Kupa is killed, Popol can Pray for 3 seconds to revive Kupa on the battlefield (Cooldown: 30s). Every 3 consecutive attacks from Kupa enhance Popol's next Basic Attack to deal 220% Total Physical Attack Physical Damage. Kupa has 2500 (+1200% Total Physical Attack) Max HP and inherits 100% of Popol's attributes and passive equipment effects.

Popol throws a spear at a target enemy, dealing 80 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, while simultaneously commanding Kupa to lunge at the target for an additional 70 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Kupa continues to attack the target for 3 seconds. Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa stuns the enemy for 1 second and bites them 3 times in quick succession.

Popol calls Kupa back to his side, gaining a 240 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield while dealing 240 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 35% for 0.5 seconds. Kupa then assists Popol in attacking nearby enemies for 3 seconds. Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa darts back and knocks nearby enemies airborne for 0.2 seconds. The shield and damage are increased to 125%.

Popol sets a trap at the target location that detonates after a short delay when triggered, dealing 70 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, immobilizing the triggering enemy for 1 second, and creating a frost zone for 4 seconds that reduces Movement Speed by 20%. Popol can hold up to 3 trap charges, gaining 1 new charge every 22 seconds.

Popol and Kupa enter an Enraged state for 12 seconds, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed and boosting their Attack Speed to 1.3 times. Kupa transforms into Alpha Wolf Form, gaining 1500 extra Max HP and fully restoring its HP while enhancing all of its skills.

story.title: The reincarnated Black Dragon who seeks to forge a new era for the Cadia Riverlands
story.lore: In the heart of the Cadia Riverlands, the ancient Great Dragon took on an apprentice — a boy discovered by Baxia, who carried within him the destiny of the Black Dragon reborn. Named Yu Zhong, he quickly proved himself a formidable warrior at the Dragon Altar, but his growing power unnerved his senior brother Baxia. During a fateful confrontation, Yu Zhong was defeated and left for dead. He was saved by a cheerful girl named Wanwan, and in their time together, her pure-hearted spirit slowly eroded Yu Zhong's draconian ideals, revealing his true ambition: to conquer the Cadia Riverlands and forge a world of harmony, free of evil. Years later, guided by the spirit master Luo Yi who had long awaited the Black Dragon's rebirth, Yu Zhong journeyed to the Forbidden Area of Dragon Soul. There, he broke the seal on the Reverse Scale — the source of the Black Dragon's power — and despite nearly losing himself to its corruption, was saved by Wanwan's timely intervention. Now complete, Yu Zhong soared into the sky in Black Dragon form, his conquest of the Land of Dawn finally begun.

skills.desc: Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue to an enemy each time he deals damage to them. Upon reaching 5 stacks, Sha Residue erupts — consuming 1 stack every 0.5 seconds, dealing 30 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) + 2% of the target's lost HP as Physical Damage, and restoring 6% of Yu Zhong's lost HP per stack consumed. When Sha Essence is fully charged from eruptions, Yu Zhong gains 30% Movement Speed and 10% Spell Vamp.

Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak, transforming it into a weapon that spins and attacks nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of the cloak deals 220 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, while the sharpened edge deals 250% of that damage and applies 2 stacks of Sha Residue. This skill benefits only 40% from Spell Vamp on minions.

Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul, dealing 150 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in front and slowing them by 60% for 1 second. Upon hitting a target, his next Basic Attack is enhanced to deal 108 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knock the enemy back. When multiple targets are hit, Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue multiple times with the enhanced attack, dealing up to 200% damage.
Yu Zhong leaps toward the designated area with full strength, dealing 180 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area. He can then dash once more in the movement direction.

After channeling for 0.6 seconds, Yu Zhong transforms into his Black Dragon Form for up to 7 seconds. In this form, he cannot cast skills but moves freely, gaining CC Immunity, ignoring terrain, and increasing Max HP by 1000 (+200% Extra Physical Attack). Enemy heroes in his path are knocked back and take 180 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Upon exiting Black Dragon Form, he enters Dragonoid Form for 10 seconds, which extends the range and width of Dragon Tail, Soul Grip, and Furious Dive.

story.title: The Yin-Yang Geomancer who orchestrated the Black Dragon's return to power
story.lore: Luo Yi was the only person in all of the Cadia Riverlands to truly comprehend the ancient concept of Yin and Yang. As a child, she accidentally followed a spirit to the Cliff of Endless Lights, where she witnessed a vision of a utopia from the ancient past — a golden age when the Ancient Ones lived in harmony with the pure energies of Yin and Yang. There she discovered her true identity as a descendant of the ancient Cadians and was chosen as the successor to the Grand Sorceress of Zhu'an. But rather than seek peace, Luo Yi harbored a deeper ambition hidden beneath her graceful veil: she had spent decades searching for the reincarnation of the legendary Black Dragon, convinced that only he could restore the Cadia Riverlands to its former greatness. When she at last found Yu Zhong — then just a confused apprentice — she recognized him immediately and patiently guided him toward his destiny. After years of careful planning, she watched her long-cherished dream come true as the Black Dragon ascended into the sky. Now by his side as loyal strategist, Luo Yi's true vision for the world quietly unfolds.

skills.desc: Luo Yi's skills apply either Yin (fire) or Yang (water) marks to enemies. When two enemies with opposite marks are close to each other, a reaction is triggered, dealing 325–500 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to both and slowing them by 70% for 1 second. Each reaction grants Luo Yi a stack of Dispersion (up to 4), which reduces her skill cooldowns.

Luo Yi fires a Yin or Yang orb in the designated direction, dealing 350–500 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and 175–250 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. The orb alternates between Yin and Yang with each cast, applying the corresponding mark to enemies hit.

Luo Yi conjures a Yin-Yang field in the target area, dealing 150–300 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second to enemies within and pulling them toward the center for 2 seconds. Enemies in the outer ring are marked with Yin; enemies in the inner ring are marked with Yang. The field triggers the Duality passive reaction when Yin and Yang enemies collide.

Luo Yi creates a teleportation gate at a target location. After 3 seconds of channeling, Luo Yi and all allied heroes who step into the gate are instantly transported to the target location. Luo Yi can cancel the casting, but the gate remains for 10 seconds. Allied heroes can use the gate freely during that time.

story.title: The daughter of a disgraced soldier who carved her own path through the Barren Lands
story.lore: After the Abyss returned, the southern reaches of the Land of Dawn became a wasteland of death called the Despair Place — cut off from the Moniyan Empire and plagued by monsters. Benedetta was born the daughter of a low-ranking soldier condemned as a rebel after a failed battle, denied the honors given to officer children like Alucard. Driven by the desire to restore her father's glory and avenge his death, she trained relentlessly and mastered the long sword he left behind. When she tried to enlist in the Empire's army, she was rejected for being a rebel's descendant. Furious and disillusioned, she took up her blade and headed south into the Barren Lands alone. There, she joined a group of rangers who fought bravely against monsters despite terrible odds. Inspired by their unbreakable hope, Benedetta chose to stay and formed her own ranger squad — protecting the scattered human settlements at the foot of the Rantha Mountains. She came to understand that the weapon to overcome the Abyss wasn't steel, but the everlasting hope in their hearts. Monster by monster, settlement by settlement, Benedetta's name became a beacon of courage in the darkness.

skills.desc: When Benedetta holds down the Basic Attack button, she enters Swordout State and charges up Sword Intent. When Sword Intent is fully charged and she releases the button, she dashes forward with Swordout Slash, dealing 215% Total Physical Attack Physical Damage to all enemies in her path and restoring 150 (+120% Total Physical Attack) HP. Benedetta also gains Sword Intent by dealing damage with Basic Attacks and skills. HP restoration is reduced to 20% on minions and creeps.

Benedetta dashes forward to slash, dealing 200 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 seconds. She simultaneously leaves a shadow that detonates after a short delay, strangling enemies with Sword Intent for 2.5 seconds and dealing 60–120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.2 seconds. If the shadow hits the target first, the damage from Benedetta's own slash is increased to 200%.

Benedetta raises her weapon to defend for 0.8 seconds, gaining control immunity and blocking all damage. After the defense, she stabs in a designated direction, dealing 300–450 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the target by 40% for 1 second. If Benedetta successfully blocks a crowd control effect during defense, the stab instead stuns the target and immediately grants her full Sword Intent charge.

Benedetta clenches Alecto and slashes forward after a short delay, becoming invincible during the dash and slowing all enemies in her path by 70% for 0.8 seconds. After dashing, she detonates the accumulated Sword Intent along the entire path, dealing 60–120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.2 seconds and applying a 20% slow for 2.5 seconds. The Sword Intent lingers, strangling enemies caught within it.

story.title: The desert warrior who chose his people over his closest friend — and paid a lifelong price
story.lore: Khaleed was the respected chieftain of the desert clans of Agelta, known for his skill with the scimitar and his unwavering sense of duty. Moskov was his closest companion, a proud and skilled warrior who stood beside him through countless battles. When the resurrected tyrant Khufra descended on the desert with his army of sand monsters, Khaleed rallied the clans into an alliance. But Moskov, impatient and humiliated that none of the clans followed his call, ignored Khaleed's counsel and led his people into the desert alone. They were quickly surrounded and massacred. Faced with an impossible choice — save his friend or protect his entire people — Khaleed chose to retreat with the alliance. He then went back alone to search for Moskov. All he found was blood, scattered bodies, and Moskov's spear. In the final battle against Khufra, Khaleed drove Moskov's spear through the Orb of Sand, shattering it and absorbing its power into his own body — gaining command over the desert sands. Peace returned, but Khaleed carried the guilt of that decision forever. Then, from the shadows, a familiar figure began to follow his every move. Moskov had returned.

skills.desc: Khaleed accumulates Desert Power while moving. When Desert Power is fully charged, he slides on sand, gaining 35% Movement Speed. His next Basic Attack dashes him to the target and releases a wave dealing 50 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies, slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. This enhanced Basic Attack cannot critically strike.

Khaleed whirls his scimitar, dealing 200 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and pulling them toward him. Upon hitting an enemy, he can leap in a direction and cast this skill again up to 3 times total, with each successive cast dealing 15% more damage. This skill deals only 50% damage to minions and creeps.

Khaleed protects himself with the power of quicksand for up to 4 seconds, restoring 60 HP + 5% of his lost HP and gaining 10 Desert Power every 0.5 seconds, while reducing damage taken by 25%. Quicksand spreads beneath his feet, slowing nearby enemies by 60%. This skill is a Focused Cast — any movement or other skill input will immediately interrupt it.

Khaleed rides a sandstorm toward a designated location, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and knocking them toward his destination. He is immune to crowd control effects during the charge. Upon arriving, he smashes the ground, dealing 450 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in the area and stunning them for 1 second. This skill also fully restores his Desert Power upon landing.

story.title: The mischievous Politan trader who chose friendship over fortune — and became the Dino Rider
story.lore: Barats was born to the Politan people — a small but extraordinarily clever dwarf-like race who lived between Agelta and the Moniyan Empire, obsessed with money and riches. From birth, Barats was a troublemaker; lazy, greedy, and full of wild dreams of getting rich without working. When the villagers finally grew fed up with him, the furious Barats sneaked into the village's sacred place, stole a precious treasure map, and fled into the desert. Lost and dying of thirst in the barren wastes, a small dragon lizard appeared and guided him to water. Barats named the creature Detona, and the two became unlikely companions on a long desert journey. After years of misadventures and scraping a living in the shady streets of Los Pecados, Barats crossed paths with the elite hunter group called the Steel Hands — who had spent twenty days hunting and capturing a rare giant dinosaur for a massive bounty. When Barats looked the creature in the eye, he recognized Detona, now grown enormous. He faced the hardest decision of his life: claim the bounty or free his friend. In a rare act of selflessness that no Politan would ever make, Barats broke the chains, leaped onto Detona's back, and the two vanished into the desert together — leaving behind wealth, but keeping the only thing that mattered.

skills.desc: Detona gains a stack of Big Guy for 12 seconds each time it or Barats damages an enemy with a skill (up to 10 stacks). Each stack grants Detona increased body size, 3–9 Hybrid Defense (scales with Detona's Welcome level), and 5% extra Resilience. At maximum stacks, Detona's Basic Attacks become Trample, dealing (+140% Total Physical Attack) (+3.5% Total HP) Physical Damage in a circular area, slowing enemies by 40% for 0.2 seconds, and refreshing Big Guy's duration with each hit. Detona also gains 4 stacks of Big Guy upon respawn.

Detona spits contaminated oil in a fan-shaped area in front, dealing 60 (+7% Total HP) Physical Damage to enemies. Barats then ignites it with a firecracker, dealing 120 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area. This skill only deals 50% damage to Creeps. The area of effect scales with the number of Big Guy stacks.

Barats fires two missiles toward the target area. Upon landing, each missile spews flames from its exhaust in a rectangular area, dealing 100 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies and pushing them back toward Barats.

After a short delay, Detona charges in the target direction, dealing 120 (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+1.2% Total HP) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and devouring them, suppressing them for 1.2 seconds before spitting them out. If the spat-out target collides with an enemy hero or wall, an explosion is triggered, dealing an additional 180 (+105% Total Physical Attack) (+1.8% Total HP) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1 second. Barats is immune to crowd control throughout the duration. If channeling is canceled, 60% of the cooldown is refunded.

story.title: The amnesiac wanderer cursed by the Abyss who fights to protect what he cannot remember
story.lore: No one knew where Brody came from. He arrived at a village in the Barren Lands covered in blood, his right hand visibly corroded by an unknown darkness. The frightened villagers kept their distance, leaving food and water by his side. When he awoke, Brody realized he had no memories — only a constant voice in his mind crying out for help, and an unending pain radiating from his right arm. Driven by instinct, he rescued an elder being chased by demons, unleashing a devastating energy wave that annihilated them — but the effort sent searing agony through his entire body. Taking the elder's invitation, he settled in the village and became its protector, finding purpose in being needed. As he fought wave after wave of Abyss demons, fragmented memories began surfacing. In one desperate battle alongside a ranger named Benedetta near the Crack of the Abyss, Brody could no longer contain the energy inside him. He plunged his right hand through the final demon's chest — and the memories came flooding back. He had been born in a village at the foot of a volcano, massacred by Abyss demons. His own mistakes had led to its destruction, and his hand had been corroded in the chaos. Now understanding his mission, Brody vowed to protect those around him — forever fighting in lands not his own, seeking redemption for a past he can barely recall.

skills.desc: Brody's Basic Attacks are resonated with Abyss Power, allowing him to move while winding up his attacks. Each Basic Attack deals (+140% Total Physical Attack) (+35 × Hero Level) Physical Damage, grants 30% Movement Speed (decaying over 1.2 seconds), and applies 1 stack of Abyss Mark to the enemy (capped at 4 stacks). Each stack of Abyss Mark increases Brody's damage against that target by 5% and his Movement Speed by 5%. Note: His Basic Attack animation is slower than normal marksmen.

Brody launches a shock wave in a designated direction, dealing 150–550 (+170% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path, slowing them by 30% for 1.2 seconds, and applying 1 stack of Abyss Mark. For each additional enemy hit beyond the first, the shock wave deals 10% more damage, applies 5% more slow, and adds an extra stack of Abyss Mark.

Brody dashes to a target enemy, dealing 200–350 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, stunning them for 0.8 seconds, and applying 1 stack of Abyss Mark. After the dash, Brody can move once more in any direction, gaining 45% bonus Movement Speed that decays rapidly.

Brody locks onto all enemies within 8 yards that have Abyss Marks, dealing 340–580 (+180% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage plus 136–232 (+72% Extra Physical Attack) (+4–6% of target's missing HP) Physical Damage for each stack of Abyss Mark. All stacks are consumed upon casting. Brody can move during this skill's animation.

story.title: The Astrowarden who guards the cosmic balance between the stars and the Land of Dawn
story.lore: Yve is an ancient cosmic guardian, a being whose existence predates much of the Land of Dawn's history. Chosen by the stars themselves, she was tasked with maintaining the balance between celestial forces and the mortal world below. For ages she watched over the cosmos from afar, observing the Land of Dawn as mortals rose and fell, wars were fought, and powers both light and dark surged through the world. When the balance between realms began to fracture under the pressure of the Abyss's growing power and the chaos tearing through the Land of Dawn, Yve descended from her celestial post. Armed with the power to manipulate the very energies of the stars and reshape the battlefield with cosmic force, she took her place among the heroes of the Land of Dawn — not out of personal grievance, but out of sacred duty. To Yve, every life and every battle is written in the stars, and she will ensure that destiny unfolds as it should.

skills.desc: Yve gains a stack of Galactic Power each time she deals damage with her skills (up to 10 stacks). Each stack increases her Magic Power by a percentage. The stacks reset after she casts her ultimate.

Yve calls down a meteor shower in a line, dealing 150–325 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. Each hit generates a Galactic Power stack. The final meteor deals 180% damage.

Yve conjures a void crystal at the target area, dealing 200–350 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within and pulling them toward the center for 1.5 seconds. Generates Galactic Power stacks for each enemy hit.

Yve channels for up to 15 seconds and can cast up to 15 cosmic strikes in the designated area during this time, each dealing 150–300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Every 3 strikes upgrades into a super strike that deals 300% damage and stuns enemies for 1 second. All Galactic Power stacks are consumed at the start of the ultimate, increasing each strike's damage by 5% per stack. Yve can move slowly while channeling.

story.title: The Tribal Warrior Who Reclaimed the Holy Mountain
story.lore: The tribe where Mathilda lives has guarded the Holy Mountain for generations. Once, members of the tribe rescued a group of sand hunters under Kane, but unexpectedly they bit the hand that fed them by taking the Holy Mountain as their own. Mathilda's father Thasgard, the tribe's leader, sternly refused their coercion. In retaliation, Kane's nephew Blandy shot Thasgard and gave the tribe an ultimatum: abandon their sacred mountain within a month or be wiped out. Unable to bear more casualties, the tribe was forced to leave the land their ancestors had guarded for hundreds of years. On their way to Los Pecados, Mathilda encountered a cornered old cowboy — Clint — and helped him fight off desert bandits. Grateful, Clint aided Mathilda in return, and together they took back the Holy Mountain. Upon returning home, the power of the sacred mountain recognized Mathilda's resolve and passed its mysterious strength on to her.

skills.desc: Mathilda gains Ancestral Guidance while moving. When fully charged, her next Basic Attack is enhanced, dealing 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target and granting her 80 extra Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 2.5s.

Mathilda resonates with the power of her ancestors for 3.5s, attracting wisps as her movement distance increases (up to 6 wisps). At the end of the duration or when she casts this skill again, the wisps seek and attack nearby enemies, each dealing 375 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Enemies hit by multiple wisps take only 20% damage after the first hit.

Mathilda leaps in the target direction and creates a field around her, gaining a 500 (+180% Total Magic Power) shield and 25% extra Movement Speed for 3s. Allied heroes who come into contact with the field receive a shield and Guiding Wind. The first allied hero that triggers Guiding Wind will be guided to Mathilda, and both gain the same Movement Speed boost. Guiding Wind expires 2s after the hero leaves the field.

Mathilda selects a target enemy hero and flies around them, dealing damage with wisps to nearby enemies. Within the duration, Mathilda can select an area to dash to. At the end of the duration, she dashes at the target with Soul Mark, dealing 320 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage while knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s and transferring the Soul Mark. Mathilda gains Control Immunity and a 400 (+160% Total Magic Power) shield for the skill duration.

story.title: The Champion Who Fights for Justice Against His Own Master
story.lore: Paquito was born in a small village in southwestern Moniyan, far from the royal capital, where strength was the only way to survive. From childhood, his one dream was to become the world's strongest fighter. A reticent wanderer passed through his village and, impressed by Paquito's relentless training, took him as a student. Under the master's guidance, Paquito's abilities grew at an exponential rate. Before leaving, the master told him that the true essence of fighting lies not in destruction. Paquito spent years perfecting his technique and seeking out strong opponents across the lands, earning the title 'Heavenly Fist' for fighting for justice in the Lantis Mountains. Eventually, he discovered that a mysterious figure known as the 'Domineer' was wreaking havoc across the empire — and that this Domineer was none other than his own master, consumed by cruelty and ruthlessness. Forced to choose between loyalty and justice, Paquito made his decision. The student and master clashed in a legendary battle, with Paquito ultimately standing firm for everything he believed in.

skills.desc: After every 3 skill casts, Paquito enters Champ Stance, gaining an enhanced version of his next skill and ignoring its current cooldown. He also gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s after casting the enhanced skill. Paquito's Basic Attacks deal (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Paquito throws a punch in the target direction, dealing 210 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and gaining a 150 (+110% Total Physical Attack) shield for 2.5s if an enemy hero is hit. Champ Stance: Damage increases to 350 (+100% Total Physical Attack) and shield value increases by 120%. Regular and enhanced shields can stack.

Paquito dashes in the target direction and throws a jab, dealing 150 (+165% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. Paquito will stop and throw the jab early upon colliding with an enemy hero or creep but deals no damage to enemies in his path. Champ Stance: Paquito dashes further and deals increased damage.

Paquito launches an elbow strike in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and knocking them back. He then throws a haymaker, dealing 350 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 75% for 1s as he darts backward. Champ Stance: Instead of a haymaker, Paquito launches an uppercut, dealing 400 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.5s.

story.title: The Mischievous Amalgamation of the Shadow Swamp
story.lore: Deep in the Shadow Swamp of the Azrya Woodlands dwells an enigmatic creature named Gloo — an amalgamation of mischievous little creatures that can merge and split at will. The earliest written record of Gloo came from a Moniyan soldier who survived the near-annihilation of the Empire's Second Regiment. Lost in the Shadow Swamp, the soldier was swept up by Gloo, who toyed with him by controlling his movements before safely escorting him out of the forest. When the soldier returned and shared his account, the Moniyan citizens dismissed it as the hallucinations of an exhausted man — until the Elven text 'Azrya' reached the Academy of Magic and confirmed the soldier's encounter. Goos were found to be intelligent, pure beings who used their 'group wisdom' mostly to pull pranks on neighboring elves. However, the Abyss changed everything. As corruption crept into the Shadow Swamp, Gloo struggled to cling to their rationality. With darkness encroaching on all sides, the gentle Gloo stepped out from the ancient temple and into the wider world.

skills.desc: Enemies gain a stack of Sticky each time they are hit by Gloo's skills, decreasing their Movement Speed by 4% for 6s. Stacks up to 5. Each stack of Sticky on an enemy reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 3%.

Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing 80 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the enemy. At the final location, a Goo is left behind that explodes after 3s to deal 300 (+12% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and immobilize them for 1s. If Gloo touches the Goo, it will explode immediately, resetting the skill's cooldown and healing Gloo for 4% of Max HP if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if it hits an enemy hero).

Gloo splits into Goos, dealing 100 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and immobilizing them for 0.5s. While split, Gloo gains 10% Movement Speed and deals 80 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 2.5s to enemies it touches, lasting 4s. If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo charges over to merge with it, dragging enemies in its path in the same direction.

Unlocked when any enemy hero has full Sticky stacks. Gloo attaches itself to the target enemy hero for up to 9s, recovering 25% of its Max HP. For the duration, Gloo's Basic Attacks deal 30 (+50% Total Magic Power) (+6% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage and it transfers 80% of the damage it receives (excluding damage from turrets) to its host. Cooldown is reduced to 5s if the host dies while Gloo is attached.

story.title: The Gifted Gunsmith Who Proved Eruditio Wrong
story.lore: Beatrix was born into a wealthy merchant family in Castle Gorge in the Moniyan Empire. Raised with freedom and curiosity under the care of her loyal butler Morgan, she became fascinated by advanced gadgets her parents brought back from Eruditio. At sixteen, she traveled to Eruditio and quickly became its most promising scholar — yet her radical ideas and stubborn personality kept her shut out of Dr. Rooney's legendary Leviathan Workshop. After raising a proposal about neurological communication terminals that was compared to the work of the evil Laboratory 1718, she was expelled mid-speech. Furious, she returned home and independently built 'Operation Dawnbreak' — a virtual combat system that swept Eruditio by storm. But disaster struck when Laboratory 1718 hacked the network and used it to steal the Iron Guardians, a robot army sealed beneath the Congress Building. Refusing to let her invention be used for evil, Beatrix fought back alongside the Eruditio Rangers using her four self-made firearms: Renner the sniper rifle, Bennett the bazooka, Wesker the shotgun, and Nibiru the sub-machine guns. Her success finally earned her the audience with Dr. Rooney she had always sought, and the doors to the Leviathan Workshop were opened to her at last.

skills.desc: Beatrix's extraordinary talent allows her to produce 4 weapons of truly awe-inspiring firepower. She can carry 2 weapons at once and gains 5 Physical Attack. She converts every 1% Crit Chance into 2 Physical Attack and cannot Crit. Each weapon has a unique Basic Attack: Renner (Longshot — powerful single-target sniper shot), Bennett (Area Bombing — AoE grenade bombardment), Wesker (Proximity Advantage — close-range shotgun burst), and Nibiru (Rapid Fire — rapid 4-shot volley).

Passive: Beatrix can carry 2 weapons at once, increasing her Physical Attack by 5. Active: Beatrix takes 0.5s to swap her primary weapon with her secondary, gaining a new Basic Attack and Ultimate. This skill can be cast even while performing other actions.
Beatrix rolls in the target direction while fully reloading her current weapon. The animation varies depending on the equipped weapon.

skills.ability-name: Renner's Apathy / Bennett's Rage / Wesker's Elation / Nibiru's Passion
skills.desc: Beatrix's Ultimate changes based on her current primary weapon. Renner's Apathy: Aims carefully and fires a devastating shot dealing 700–1200 (+280% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit, with 50% Physical Lifesteal. Bennett's Rage: Bombards a target area 5 times, each dealing 580 (+225% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 40%. Wesker's Elation: Fires rapidly in all directions, each bullet dealing 295–445 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Nibiru's Passion: Unleashes 10 volleys of bullets with Nibiru, each dealing 130 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

story.title: The Condemned Soldier Bound to an Evil God
story.lore: Phoveus was once a Moniyan soldier stationed at the borders of the Lantis Mountains. His unit of fourteen hardened warriors was well known for their reckless bravery and unorthodox methods against the Abyss. During one disastrous imperial offensive, with his comrades dying and defeat imminent, Phoveus was forced to invoke the power of an Evil God to turn the tide. Despite saving countless lives, Phoveus was branded a sinner and traitor for consorting with demons, and his entire unit was posthumously condemned. On the road to his execution, the Evil God Astaros attempted to take over Phoveus's body. Instead of surrendering, Phoveus seized the opportunity and bound himself and Astaros together within a stone monolith, creating an uneasy but powerful union. While the Moniyan Empire still condemns Phoveus as a sinner, those living on the border regard him forever as a hero. Now, bearing the chains of his fate, Phoveus and Astaros venture deeper into the Dread Caves to awaken Astaros's slumbering physical form.

skills.desc: Phoveus' weapon, Astaros, holds mysterious powers and is exceptionally sensitive to fast-moving prey. When an enemy hero uses a Blink or Charge skill within 8 yards of Astaros, all of Phoveus' skill cooldowns are reduced by 1s. Phoveus's next Basic Attack charges at the enemy, knocking them back and dealing extra Magic Damage equal to 4–6% of the enemy's Max HP.

Phoveus smashes the ground and unleashes Astaros Dread, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target. Upon hitting an enemy hero, Phoveus receives a shield equal to (+60% Total Magic Power) (+6% Total HP) and a 25% Movement Speed boost for 3s. If an enemy hero, creep, or Phoveus himself touches Astaros Dread, it will spread and deal extra damage (decay to 25% for repeated hits). This skill gains 1 charge every 8.5s, up to 3 charges.

Phoveus summons Astaros Eye in a targeted area, dealing 100 (+20% Total Magic Power) damage. After 1s, Astaros Eye begins shrinking and pulling all enemies on it into its center, dealing 250 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Astaros keeps a watchful gaze over an area of 8 yards around Phoveus. If it detects an enemy hero using a Blink or Charge skill, it casts a Mark on them for 3s. During this time, Phoveus can rapidly blink to their location and deliver a fierce blow, dealing 600 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target and surrounding enemies while gaining a 160 (+50% Total Magic Power) (+5% Total HP) shield. This effect can be triggered repeatedly for up to 12s as long as the conditions are met.

story.title: The Eruditio Leader Who Traveled Back in Time to Save the World
story.lore: Natan was born in Eruditio during a time when the seal holding back the Lord of the Abyss was steadily weakening. A prodigy in both science and magic, he was appointed leader of Eruditio at only 28 years old. As the Abyss accumulated Twilight Orbs and humanity edged toward annihilation, Natan poured all of his genius into a single desperate idea: the creation of a time machine. Working with scholars from Eruditio and the Magic Academy, he developed an apparatus capable of warping time itself — but it required a staggering amount of power. A thousand years later, after the Endless War had reignited and the world teetered on the brink of destruction, Natan's time machine was finally completed, powered by the combined energy of the Twilight Orbs. With no other hope remaining, Natan stepped inside and launched himself into the past, searching for the turning point that could save the Land of Dawn.

skills.desc: Natan gains a stack of Entanglement each time he or his Reverse-Clone hits an enemy with their skills (up to 6 stacks). Each stack lasts 5s and grants 7.5–15% extra Attack Speed and 7.5% extra Movement Speed. Projectiles of Natan's Basic Attacks return to him after reaching maximum range, dealing (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in their path. Natan converts 100% of his Physical Lifesteal to Magic Lifesteal and 100% of his Physical Penetration to Magic Penetration.
Natan shoots a dense mass of energy in the target direction, dealing 225 (+180% Total Physical Attack) (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.

Natan launches a Gravitational Attractor in the target direction, dealing 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path. The attractor then pulls enemies toward a central point, dealing 225 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Natan summons a Reverse-Clone at the target location that lasts 10s, inherits 35% of his attack attributes, and copies his moves and attacks in reverse. Casting again switches Natan's position with the Reverse-Clone and reduces all other skills' remaining cooldowns by 50%. The Reverse-Clone disappears if Natan moves too far away.

story.title: The Leonin Warrior Who Awoke His Battleaxe's Slumbering Power
story.lore: Aulus longed to become a warrior more than anything else, but the other Leonins mocked both him and his old battleaxe, considering neither worthy of respect. Determined to prove them wrong, Aulus held back his rage, left his clan, and set out on a journey to achieve great feats. Yet wherever he traveled, the world greeted him with only prejudice and injustice because of his Leonin blood. No longer able to bear the world's cruelty, Aulus turned toward the Lantis Mountains — a place crawling with demons — and ventured in alone to hunt them. The heat of his battle rage in that perilous place resonated with something deep within the old battleaxe, awakening the weapon's long-slumbering power. From that moment on, Aulus and his axe fought side by side, each fueling the other's fury, determined to prove to the world the true strength of Leonins.

skills.desc: Aulus adds a stack of Fighting Spirit to his axe per second for 3s after dealing damage to any enemy (up to 4 stacks). Each stack grants 3–12 extra Physical Attack and 1–4 Physical Penetration. At max stacks, Aulus also gains 10% extra Movement Speed and 27–125 bonus Basic Attack Damage.

Aulus brandishes his axe, dealing 150 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and enhancing up to 6 of his next Basic Attacks for 3s based on enemies hit (3 per Hero or Creep, 1 per Minion). Enhanced Basic Attacks gain 100% extra Attack Speed and restore 50 HP to Aulus.

Aulus removes all slow effects and gains 30% extra Movement Speed and 20% Damage Reduction against attacks from the front for 5s. Aulus gains an additional 1% Damage Reduction for every 10 extra Physical Attack, up to 60%.

Aulus raises his axe and smashes it to the ground, dealing 210 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line and slowing them by 90% for 0.5s. A burning trail lasting 5s is left on the ground, dealing 90 (+40% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies who walk on it every 0.5s and slowing them by 70%. Passive: Each time Undying Fury is upgraded, Aulus permanently crafts a part for his axe — Blade Craft (+35 Physical Damage), Hammer Craft (+10% Crit Chance), and Handle Craft (+65% Attack Range).

story.title: The Aloof Duke Who Would Do Anything for His Kin
story.lore: Aamon is the head of House Paxley and the current Duke of Castle Aberleen. Cold, distant, and proud, Aamon presents a facade of complete indifference to the world — yet beneath it lies an absolute devotion to his kin that he would sacrifice everything for. House Paxley's legacy is built on magic and the sword, and Aamon upholds that tradition through the mastery of crystalline shards that he can scatter and recall at will. His connection to his family drove him to take increasingly dangerous paths, clashing with both demons and those who would threaten the people under his protection. When forces within House Paxley itself began to fracture — as seen through Valentina's betrayal — Aamon found himself navigating a treacherous battlefield of loyalties, walking the edge between protecting what remains of his house and confronting the shadows that have long haunted it.

skills.desc: Aamon enters Camouflage each time he hits an enemy with a skill, becoming untargetable, recovering 25 (+15% Total Magic Power) plus 3% of his lost HP every 0.5s, and gaining 80% extra Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3s. Upon leaving Camouflage, Aamon's Basic Attack cooldown resets and his next Basic Attacks within 3s are enhanced, each dealing 70 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+115% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The first attack after actively leaving Camouflage deals bonus damage and reduces all skill cooldowns by 1s.

Passive: Aamon charges his armor through enhanced Basic Attacks or while camouflaged. At 5 charges, his next attack throws 6 shards at the target, each dealing 50 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, then scattering around the target. Active: Aamon throws a shard at a nearby enemy, dealing 175 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Aamon throws a shard forward, dealing 120 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way. The shard returns to Aamon after a short delay, allowing him to enter Camouflage. If the shard hits a non-minion enemy, it slows them by 50% for 2s and returns immediately.

Aamon throws all shards at a designated enemy and slows them by 30% for 1.5s. After a short delay, the shards fly to the enemy's location again, each dealing 35 (+10% Total Magic Power) to 70 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The number of shards increases with Aamon's armor charges and shards on the ground (8–25 shards). Damage increases based on the target's lost HP, maximizing when the target's HP is below 30%.

story.title: The Duchess Who Made a Pact with an Evil God to Revive Her Lover
story.lore: As the eldest daughter of House Paxley, which guarded the Lantis Mountains for generations, Valentina was raised to be the perfect noble heir. She became the youngest and only female member of the house council, and sought out allies by journeying alone to Moonlit Forest — where she met the Elf hero Irlan, who fell deeply in love with her. Irlan proposed to Valentina at a House Paxley meeting, pledging his people to her command in exchange for her hand, and she accepted. Together they fought the Abyss, and Valentina's legend grew. But during the decisive Lantis Battle, her own uncle betrayed her, suppressing the withdrawal signal during a forbidden Soul Casket spell. Irlan pushed Valentina to safety with his last strength before his soul was devoured by the spell. Valentina executed every traitor, but her victory was hollow without Irlan. To bring him back, she signed a blood pact with the Evil God Kalon and gained immortality and the power of shadow. Now she hides in darkness, waiting for the Heart of Anima — a fragment of the Twilight Orb said to be the key to retrieving Irlan's lost soul.

skills.desc: Valentina gains 8–50 extra EXP each time she deals damage to an enemy hero (cooldown: 2s). If the enemy hero's level is not higher than Valentina's, 30% of the damage dealt is converted into her HP. The EXP gained scales with Valentina's level.

Valentina launches a Shadow Strike in the target direction, dealing 475 (+145% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s. Also applies a Shadow Sigil to enemy heroes hit. Enemy heroes with a Shadow Sigil who are hit by Shadow Strike again are confused for 1s.

Valentina dashes in a designated direction and fires 3 Shadow Bolts to the nearest enemy, each dealing 125 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Each Shadow Bolt that hits an enemy hero reduces the cooldown of Shadow Strike by 1s. This skill can be cast twice within 6s.

Valentina targets an enemy hero, slowing them by 70% for 0.5s and gaining the ability to cast their Ultimate. Casting the stolen Ultimate transforms Valentina into that enemy hero's form, inheriting their Basic Attack type for up to 12s. Her skills remain unchanged unless the enemy's Ultimate has a Morph effect. The stolen Ultimate's level matches Valentina's own. If the enemy is a Physical Damage hero, Valentina gains bonus Physical Attack equal to 100% of her Magic Power for the duration. Cannot be used on an enemy Valentina.

story.title: The Primal Warden Created to Guard the Sealed Evil Gods
story.lore: Before the Endless War, the Ancient Ones dispatched Kaja and Uranus to imprison unruly Evil Gods within the Temple of Thunder on Sanctum Island. To watch over them, they created Edith — a priestess wielding Primal Lightning — and her Mecha Guard, Phylax. For eons, Edith faithfully kept watch. But an earthquake awakened her prematurely and left her without her memories. A scrap-collector foster father found and raised her for ten years, and she grew to love him as family. When her foster father brought her back into the temple ruins to scavenge for scraps, Uranus — Guardian of the Celestial Palace — appeared and attacked the old man. In that moment, every memory flooded back. Without hesitation, Edith summoned Phylax and fought Uranus to defend her father, choosing her humanity over her divine duty. Just then, the Celestial Palace itself fell and the sealed Evil Gods scattered across the Land of Dawn. With no choice left, Edith drove Phylax into the wider world to hunt down the escaped Evil Gods — carrying the impossible weight of her duty and her love for the father she left behind.

skills.desc: After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become Overloaded for 3s, during which all Basic Attacks trigger chain lightning that deals extra Magic Damage equal to (+30% Total Magic Power) plus 4 (+0.25 per Hero Level)% of the target's Max HP to up to 4 enemies. Chain lightning damage against Minions is increased to 150%.

After a 0.75s delay, Edith controls Phylax to launch an earth-shattering blow in a designated direction, dealing 225 (+10% Total HP) Physical Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1s. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

Edith exacts Divine Retribution on a target area, dealing 170 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. She then continues to deal 68 (+16% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s over the next 1.5s.

Edith ejects herself forward from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies. She then takes flight and can perform ranged Basic Attacks, each dealing 35 (+75% Total Physical Attack) (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, gaining new skills in this state. Based on accumulated Wrath (gained from taking damage), she gains 350 (+5–20% Total HP) extra Shield, 50–150% extra Attack Speed, and 5–20% Hybrid Lifesteal. Each point of Extra Physical and Magic Defense is converted to 3.5 Magic Power. The flight state lasts up to 8s.

story.title: The Child of the Oasis, Born to Heal the World
story.lore: When Belerick wandered through the desolate Agelta Drylands, he was moved by a single blooming flower stubbornly clinging to life amid the despair. Using his great power to create an oasis at that spot, he inadvertently poured too much energy into the little flower, and from it emerged a brand-new life form—Floryn. Innocent and curious, Floryn had never once left the Oasis. Among the caravans that passed through, she befriended a young man with a warm smile who filled her days with stories of the outside world. In time, she shared her most prized secret with him: a mysterious glowing seed she had carried since birth. But one night, Floryn awoke to find the seed gone—and the young man too. Summoning all her courage, Floryn ventured beyond the Oasis for the first time to chase him down. What she found outside shook her deeply: suffering, poverty, and people desperate for hope. Even as she caught up to the young man—who had stolen the seed only to provide for his starving family—her empathy for everyone's pain was so overwhelming that the seed bloomed in her hands. From its glow sprang a small fox-like creature whom she named Dew, and together they brought rain and new life to the barren town. Forgiving the young man, Floryn made the parched drylands her new home, vowing to spread greenery and hope across the Land of Dawn.

skills.desc: Floryn carries Dew's Lantern, an unsellable item that permanently increases her attributes and gains energy each time she hits enemies with her skills. After remaining out of combat for a few seconds, Floryn can share the Lantern's power with an allied hero at the Fountain, granting them an extra equipment slot and a shield each time they are healed by Floryn's abilities. Floryn can never sell the Lantern.

Floryn tosses an Energy Seed at a designated enemy, dealing 220–420 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Healing Fruits will then spawn and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring 50 (+65% Total Magic Power) plus a percentage of their lost HP. Hitting creeps or minions also triggers the Healing Fruits.

Floryn launches a blob of energy in a designated direction. Upon hitting an enemy, it deals Magic Damage to nearby enemies, stuns them briefly, and reveals their positions. If the blob does not hit an enemy before reaching its maximum range, it detonates at that point and still stuns nearby enemies.

Floryn resonates with Dew's power, restoring 250–450 (+100% Total Magic Power) HP to all allied heroes twice, regardless of their location on the map. This removes all Healing Reduction and Shield Reduction effects from allied heroes and grants them immunity to such effects for 2 seconds each time the healing takes effect.

story.title: The Boy Possessed by an Evil God, Seeking His Own Path
story.lore: In the verdant valley of Floral Falls near the Dragon Altar of the Cadia Riverlands, a baby boy was found drifting down the river in a basket one early morning seventeen years ago. The locals adopted him and named him Yin after the earthly branch of the Year of the Tiger. A prodigy in martial arts, Yin possessed extraordinary physical strength despite his slender frame—yet he had one critical flaw: he was too good-natured to comprehend the intent to kill. It was during one of his training expeditions that he stumbled into a trap set by Wanwan of the Tang clan—and in that accidental meeting, the two became inseparable friends. But one day, as Yin sat quietly meditating, an ominous entity shrouded in dark clouds descended upon Floral Falls and chose him as its vessel. The Evil God Lieh forced his way into Yin's body, tearing at his mind and soul. Yu Zhong, sensing the threat, attacked Yin without warning, and in that desperate fight for his life, Yin finally comprehended the intent to kill—sparking a flame in him he had never known. He managed to hold Lieh at bay within himself, but the Evil God is cunning: the more Yin fights for righteousness, the more chaos Lieh feeds on, slowly recovering his power. With a woeful smile to Wanwan, Yin left Floral Falls alone one night, determined to find a way to defeat Lieh before the god's darkness consumed him entirely.

skills.desc: Yin deals 125% increased damage when there are no allied heroes within 4 yards of him. This passive remains active even inside the domain created by his Ultimate.
Yin gains 40% Movement Speed for 2 seconds and enhances his next Basic Attack, dashing forward and dealing 300–475 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target.

Yin dashes forward, leaving a Golden Ring behind and dealing 150–300 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. After a 1-second delay, the Golden Ring catches up with Yin, dealing 225–450 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies it passes through and stunning them for 1 second.

Yin pulls a single enemy hero into an isolated domain and transforms into Lieh, the Evil God. Inside the domain, Yin/Lieh and the target are immune to the skills and attacks of heroes outside. Lieh gains enhanced versions of Yin's skills: Frenzy Strike (smashes an area ahead up to 10 times, dealing Physical Damage and slowing enemies) and Instant Blast (performs a flying kick, leaving Golden Rings and dealing Physical Damage). If Lieh kills the enemy inside the domain, he exits in Lieh's form for 8–12 seconds with his non-ultimate cooldowns reset.

story.title: The Rebel Needlewoman of Lumina City
story.lore: There was once an inconspicuous tailor shop on the bustling streets of Lumina City, run by an elegant woman with a weary smile. Her daughter Melissa—clever, naughty, yet always thoughtful—spent her childhood wearing carefully patched-up dresses, her worn-out shoes mended with adorable patterns. When her mother died without warning, little Melissa was left with only a ragdoll called Cuddles and a gnawing grief she refused to show. One night she dreamed that Cuddles spoke to her in her mother's voice, saying she would always protect her. The moment Melissa reached out to embrace her, she jolted awake—alone in the rain. In that instant, a surge of inexplicable magic burst from within her: the dark magic she had inherited from her mother had awakened. Taking up the craft that reminded her most of her mother, Melissa opened a small tailor shop of her own in Lumina City, filling it with dolls hanging from every corner—a recreation of her mother's old shop. Cold-eyed and sharp-tongued behind the counter, Melissa still accepts the city's strangest jobs, fixing 'dolls' and 'problems' alike with her cursed needles. When those who wronged her come seeking revenge, she greets them with a grin and a needle—reminding them exactly how it feels to regret.

skills.desc: Melissa deals 125% extra damage to minions, creeps, and summoned units, including her own puppet Muddles and all enemy-summoned units.

Melissa slides forward in the target direction and gains extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds. This skill also pulls her puppet Muddles and companion Cuddles toward her when they are on the field. The skill's cooldown is reduced by 1.2 seconds each time Melissa damages an enemy while Muddles is present.

Melissa throws her puppet Muddles in the target direction. Muddles deals 250–400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage on the first hit and links to all nearby enemy heroes for up to 6 seconds, slowing them by 60% (decaying over 1.5s). Linked enemies can break free by moving out of range. While Muddles is present, Melissa's basic attacks summon Giggles to shoot an extra cursed needle at Muddles, transferring all damage dealt to Muddles onto the linked enemies. Muddles returns early if Melissa moves too far away or no enemies are nearby.

Melissa commands Cuddles to release a Field of Protection around her, dealing 500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and knocking back nearby enemies. The field then persists for 4 seconds, continuously knocking back any enemy who attempts to enter and dealing 50 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage with brief slowing. The field also interrupts enemy movement skills (unless they are immune to control effects) and moves with Melissa once if she steps toward its boundary. Passive: Melissa's Physical and Magic Defense are permanently increased by 3, amplified to 5 times when the skill is active.

story.title: The Youngest Arbiter of Light Who Chose Conscience Over Duty
story.lore: Xavier was born in Lumina City to an ordinary merchant father and a Light Elf mother. Endowed with her lineage, he grew up with extraordinary intellect and eyes the color of the purest sapphire. As a child he roamed the streets at night, giving alleyway cats names and roles in imaginary battles—until the day he shielded his favorite 'evil dragon' cat from a pack of stray dogs and, without understanding how, caused them all to freeze in their tracks. That was the first awakening of his Mystic magic, a rare power capable of compressing and fissioning magical particles to create devastating destruction. Joining the Monastery of Light the moment he came of age, Xavier was the youngest member ever to be named Arbiter of Light by Bishop Rod Sidon. Assigned the hardest missions of the Knights of Light, he carried out his duties with unwavering conviction—until the siege of the Free Smiths' Guild, a massacre disguised as a mission to punish heretics. A decade of inner turmoil followed. When he was finally ordered to capture two so-called heretics—Yin and Melissa—he found them protecting a child on the roadside while being pursued by demons. In that moment, conscience won. Xavier stood with them, and together the four formed the Forsaken Light, defying the very institution he had devoted his life to.

skills.desc: Xavier enhances his subsequent skills each time one of his skills hits an enemy hero, building up to 3 stages. Stage I: Skill damage increased to 110%. Stage II: Skill damage increased to 115%, skill width greatly increased. Stage III: Skill damage increased to 120%, cooldown reduced by 4 seconds (12 seconds for the Ultimate). Upon reaching Stage III, Xavier's next skill cast triggers the Transcendence state for 5 seconds, during which all skills are enhanced to the maximum. Hitting enemies with skills while in Transcendence extends its duration by 1 second.

Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals 315 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies it passes through. The bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy hero or the Mystic Barrier (up to 5 times).

Xavier conjures a Mystic Barrier that lasts 5 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with the Barrier take 110 (+55% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are slowed by 50%, while allied heroes touching it gain 50% Movement Speed (decaying over 1.2 seconds). When the Barrier is hit by Xavier's other skills, it expands into a forbidden field for 3 seconds, dealing 200–400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them.

Xavier unleashes a massive beam of Mystic energy in the target direction, dealing Magic Damage to all enemies it passes through across the entire map. This is the first global ultimate skill in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. Enemies caught inside a Mystic Field when hit by Dawning Light are also stunned.

story.title: The Orphan Raven Who Found Himself
story.lore: On a stormy winter night ten years ago, the Free Smiths' Guild—led by the craftsman Terizla—was accused of heresy and wiped out by the Church of Light. The only survivor was Terizla's six-year-old son, who wandered the streets for days until the Church found him. The Archbishop named him Julian, after an ancient saint, and sent him to Raven's Nest—a school for gifted orphans atop a cliff, where children were trained to become Ravens, a secret force that answered only to the Archbishop. Julian was taught to forget his past and that children abandoned by their families were unworthy of love—only loyal service could grant them rebirth. He passed every test. He forgot everything about his former life, save for one recurring nightmare: his mother pushing him away, begging for herself without a glance at him. And a strange habit—lifting the corners of his mouth with both hands to force a smile, though he never knew why. Sent to purify Xavier, Julian caught a glimpse of a hidden truth buried in time: his mother had not abandoned him—she had sacrificed herself to save him, and the memory had been stolen from him. His hands began to tremble. When Alice and her demon legion cornered their group at the edge of a cliff, Julian stepped forward, ordered the others to escape across the rope bridge, cut the bridge behind them, and faced the Demon Queen alone—not as a duty, but as a choice. He was no longer a Raven. He was Julian.

skills.desc: After casting two different skills, Julian enhances his third skill. Casting the enhanced skill places all of Julian's skills on a 7-second cooldown and empowers his Basic Attacks for 5 seconds to deal 75 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and pull targets toward him. Julian also gains 15% extra Hybrid Lifesteal for 5 seconds each time he hits an enemy hero with his skills, stacking up to 3 times.

Julian hurls a flying scythe in the target direction, dealing 380 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. Enhanced Scythe: Julian hurls two flying scythes, dealing continuous Magic Damage along the way and slowing enemies by 50% for 1 second. Upon hitting a non-minion enemy or reaching maximum range, the scythes linger and continue to deal Magic Damage to nearby enemies every 0.3 seconds.

Julian summons a flying sword and dashes in the target direction, dealing Magic Damage to enemies along the way. Enhanced Sword: Julian summons a multitude of flying swords and dashes in the target direction, dealing continuous Magic Damage along the way. Julian becomes untargetable and invisible during the enhanced dash and can pass through terrain.

Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit after a short delay and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds. Enhanced Chain: Julian casts chains over a larger area, dealing continuous Magic Damage and slowing enemies by 30%. Enemies still inside the area at the end of the skill's duration take 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) extra Magic Damage and are knocked airborne for 0.8 seconds. Note: Julian has no traditional Ultimate; all three skills can become enhanced, and skill levels can be freely upgraded.

story.title: The Nobleman Turned Treasure Appraiser, Searching for a Lost Friend
story.lore: In the wild and sun-scorched city of Los Pecados, Fredrinn Vance was the son of Duke Vance—a nobleman who threw off his title and privileges to pursue a life of adventure alongside his best friend, Fray. On one of their expeditions into ancient ruins, the two stumbled upon an altar housing a giant crystal radiating an ominous glow. Despite Fray's warning, the young and reckless Fredrinn laid his hand on it, disrupting an ancient ward. A ghostly figure in a black cloak emerged from the crystal's center and declared them its final offering. The altar began to collapse under the weight of ancient magic, and when the chaos cleared, Fray was gone without a trace—only Fray's magic compass remained. The crystal had fused itself into Fredrinn's chest, right where his heart was, sealing an ancient power within him and pulsating with a ghostly glow. The compass pointer spun wildly—a sign that Fray was still alive. Fredrinn settled in Los Pecados as a treasure appraiser, building a vast intelligence network with his funds to gather any knowledge related to the ruins where Fray vanished. His legendary no-questions-no-disclosure policy earned him equal amounts of respect and infamy. His price is always higher than expected. He never flinches with a gun barrel between his eyes. And he will not stop until he finds Fray.

skills.desc: Fredrinn stores 85% of the damage he receives as Crystal Energy (visible to all). Crystal Energy begins decaying after 8 seconds at a rate of 5% Max HP per second. Fredrinn can convert stored Crystal Energy into HP by dealing damage (30% conversion rate; 15% against minions). He also gains 1 Combo Point each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy (up to 4 Combo Points, lasting 6 seconds). His Ultimate consumes a varying number of Combo Points based on skill level. Gaining a Combo Point also resets Crystal Energy's decay timer.

Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing 150 (+8% Total HP) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 100 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. This skill deals 150% damage to non-hero enemies.
Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing 200 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first non-minion enemy hit and knocking them airborne briefly.

Fredrinn deals Physical Damage to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1 second. Hitting a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn Physical and Magic Defense for a few seconds and reduces the cooldowns of Piercing Strike and Brave Assault. This skill costs Combo Points and is only available at level 4. Costs 1 Combo Point.
