Fredrinn forcefully swings his sword in a fan-shaped area, dealing Physical Damage plus a percentage of his stored Crystal Energy as additional Physical Damage after a short delay. Enemies at the center of the area take greater damage. Doubles the conversion ratio from Crystal Energy to damage dealt against enemy heroes. The more Crystal Energy Fredrinn has stored, the more devastating this skill becomes. Costs 3 Combo Points at max level.

story.title: The Child of the Leonin Prophecy, Who Chose Her Own Destiny
story.lore: For as long as she could remember, Joy and her adoptive grandmother had lived in the slums of Lumina City—poor, but never hungry as long as grandma could find a way. She was the infamous little thief who targeted only the caravans of Eruditio-bound scholars, returning each time with sacks of dusty books, claiming she wanted to be an inventor. That all changed the day an emissary of the Leonin clan arrived with a startling revelation: Joy was born on a stormy night clutching the Leonin Crystal—the mark of the 'miracle child' foretold in ancient prophecy to save the Leonin people. She was taken to the Leonin Temple, where her necklace resonated with the enshrined Crystal in a pattern of beats: one, two, three, four—just like grandma's old song. Joy didn't take prophecy seriously at first. She threw a BBQ party in the sacred temple. She played pranks on the elders. But when a catastrophic abyssal thunderstorm threatened to destroy the Leonin clan, something shifted inside her. Instead of asking her to sacrifice herself, the Leonin patriarch ordered Joy to run to safety—they cared for her, not because they wanted something from her, but because she was a child who deserved love. The realization cracked something open in her heart. Joy looked up at the collapsing temple, at the Leonins struggling to hold it up with their last bit of magic—and chose to fight. The Leonin Crystal blazed with her resolve, and like golden lightning, she tore through the dark clouds above.

skills.desc: Each time Joy's skill hits a non-minion enemy, she deals 100 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and gains 60% Movement Speed for 4 seconds (decays over time). This effect has a 4-second cooldown per target. Joy's Basic Attacks deal Magic Damage equal to 65 (+65% Total Physical Attack)(+65% Total Magic Power).

Joy throws her Leonin Crystal to a designated location near an enemy. It deals 200–300 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage on impact and slows the target by 30% for 1 second. Joy can also target the Crystal itself with her second skill to extend her dash range.

Joy dashes toward a target, dealing 120–210 (+55% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way. Each cast timed to the beat increases the Beat Energy gauge; at full Beat Energy, Joy unlocks her Ultimate. Well-timed casts also generate a shield and increase her Ultimate's damage. This skill can be cast up to 5 times in succession.

Joy removes all Crowd Control effects on herself and unleashes a burst of lightning energy, dealing 180–270 (+55% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies 8 times over several seconds, while gaining 30% Movement Speed, slow immunity, and bonus Physical and Magic Defense. The Ultimate's damage is increased by 40% and grants Spell Vamp if all previous Meow, Rhythm of Joy! casts were performed on beat. Hitting the same target multiple times reduces the damage by 20% per additional hit.

story.title: The Last Astral Artificer Who Defied the Stars Themselves
story.lore: Novaria was born in the Valley of Stars, home to the Astral Artificers—a people gifted with a fragment of the stars' power. They spent their lives studying the heavens and constructing the Star Atlas, a great mechanism they believed would unlock the stars' secrets. But the stars themselves regarded the Artificers as naive mortals, and had long ago written Novaria's fate into their design: she would be the First Observer, unknowingly destroy the Star Atlas, and doom her entire people. For years, Novaria hid the power awakening inside her out of fear. Then one day she foresaw in the stars that her mother would face a tragedy—and she altered the Star Atlas to prevent it. When her mother came home safely, Novaria understood the connection between the Atlas and the stars' will. On the night of her sixteenth birthday, she defied destiny and completed the Star Atlas according to her own design. But the stars showed no mercy. The Atlas shattered into a rift that consumed her, pulling her into the cosmos and transforming her into a half-human, half-astral being—her skin and eyes reshaping into starlight. Shackled by astral rings in the darkness, she was a prisoner of the cosmos, forced to replay her story endlessly. But one night, a single bright star shone differently—and Novaria shattered it. The stars trembled. The rings cracked. She broke free, clutching a burning star fragment on her fingertip, determined to write her own story.

skills.desc: Astral Spheres summoned by Novaria continuously slow nearby enemies by 20%. When an Astral Sphere explodes, it deals Magic Damage equal to 260 (+50% Total Magic Power) plus 4% of the enemy's Max HP to nearby enemies and multiplies the slow effect to 2.5 times for a brief period. Astral Spheres also reveal hidden enemies' locations for 2 seconds when they make contact.

Novaria summons an Astral Sphere at the target location, continuously dealing 75 (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. After 2 seconds, the sphere explodes, dealing Magic Damage (scaled by skill level) to nearby enemies and multiplying the passive slow by 2.5 times.

Novaria summons an Astral Sphere at a distance and begins drawing it toward herself. During this time, she gains 20% Movement Speed and can pass through terrain; passing through a wall increases the Movement Speed bonus to 60%. When the sphere reaches Novaria, she can launch it in a target direction within 5 seconds, dealing massive Magic Damage to the first enemy hero struck.

Novaria scatters Astral Echo in the target direction, briefly slowing enemy heroes by 50% and applying an Astral Ring on them. The Astral Ring expands the hitbox of affected enemies by 250% and reveals their locations for 8 seconds, making them significantly easier to hit with Novaria's other skills.

story.title: The Half-Demon Who Found Humanity in a Human Girl's Kindness
story.lore: Born of both human and demon blood, Arlott was ostracized by both worlds from the moment he came into being. Driven away by humans who feared his half-demon nature and rejected by his own father's kin for his human blood, the young Arlott drifted toward the Barren Lands and joined a demonic warband—believing strength and loyalty to the demons was all he had left. But on the battlefield, they betrayed him. Left for dead among the ruins of a skirmish, his wounds deep and his will extinguished, it was a human girl named Mila who found him. She nursed him back to health without hesitation, without conditions, and without fear. In their time together, her innocence and sincerity dismantled everything Arlott had been taught to believe about humans. He had never known such warmth. But it was not to last—the Church of Light seized Mila on charges of heresy and executed her before Arlott could reach her in time. Her death reignited the fury within him, yet it also left him with something he could not extinguish: the memory of her kindness, and the question of what it means to truly belong. Now, Arlott fights alone—neither fully demon nor fully human, carrying two lances and a wound that may never close.

skills.desc: Arlott's demonic eyes automatically mark nearby enemy heroes visible to him and those affected by Crowd Control effects. Marked enemies glow red and remain marked for 5 seconds. Arlott's second skill, Vengeance, is guaranteed to critically strike marked targets. This effect has a 10-second cooldown.

Arlott slashes his lance in the target direction, dealing 200–400 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds. Enemies at the outer edge of the strike are stunned for 1 second, while enemies closer to Arlott are stunned for a shorter duration.

Arlott dashes in the target direction, dealing 100 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and healing himself. If this skill strikes a marked enemy (from Demon Gaze), it deals a guaranteed critical hit and its cooldown is immediately reset, allowing Arlott to chain multiple dashes.

Arlott sweeps his spear from left to right in a wide fan-shaped arc, dealing heavy Physical Damage to all enemies within the area and displacing them to the far edge of the swing. This skill also applies the Demon Gaze mark to all enemies hit.

story.title: The Desert Outlaw Who Proved Hunters and Inventors Can Be the Same
story.lore: Born into the Sand Hunters, a tribe of desert raiders in the Agelta Drylands, Ixia was learning to load a gun before she could walk straight. While the rest of her tribe concerned themselves only with plunder, Ixia had a peculiar obsession: she stole exclusively from caravans bound for Eruditio, returning each time with sacks full of dusty books. She said she wanted to be an inventor. Her tribemates called her a fool. With relentless ingenuity, she built increasingly elaborate contraptions from scavenged materials—a grill from a guitar, swimming gear for the desert—and earned both admiring followers and exasperated enemies. Eventually she assembled Bad Soul, a crew of like-minded outcasts who believed, as she did, that science should not be a tool reserved only for the academics of Eruditio. After encountering a powerful Starlium reactor during one of her raids, Ixia reverse-engineered and integrated it into a weapon of her own design—a modular energy cannon capable of firing charged beams and even splitting into six smaller guns. She roams the Drylands by her own rules, like the ever-shifting sands, answering to no one. When a passing traveler once asked her how she could be a Sand Hunter, an inventor, and an outlaw all at once, she simply smiled and replied: 'They say you can't be all three. But who are they to define us?'

skills.desc: Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Starlium Charge to enemies on hit. When Ixia performs a Basic Attack on an enemy with 2 stacks of Starlium Charge, the stacks are consumed and the attack becomes a Siphon Starlium hit dealing (150% Total Physical Attack)(+200*Lifesteal)+(10*Hero Level) Physical Damage. Siphon Starlium also heals Ixia for the full damage dealt (only 10% against non-hero units) and slows the target by 25% for 1 second. Siphon Starlium can trigger on all enemies in front of Ixia within her attack range, but cannot deal Critical Hits. Ixia's Basic Attacks do not trigger Lifesteal on their own.

Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing 100 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area. Enemies hit by both beams take double damage. When the beams hit enemy heroes, Ixia gains 50% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

Ixia unleashes a canister of Starlium energy in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies on impact. After a short delay, the released energy pulls all enemies within range toward the center line and deals 200 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Ixia reassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the Barrage state for 4 seconds. In this state, she cannot move but her Basic Attacks and skills fire in a wide fan-shaped area and can hit up to 6 targets simultaneously (prioritizing heroes). Siphon Starlium's damage is significantly increased while Barrage is active. Dual Beam and Star Helix gain extended range. Full Barrage also reveals enemies hiding in nearby bushes or using camouflage. Ixia can use Flicker to reposition while the state is active.

story.title: The Scholar Who Scattered His Soul Across the Multiverse
story.lore: Nolan, a poised and prominent scholar from Eruditio, yearned to unlock the secrets of the multiverse. But after discovering a cosmic threat of unimaginable proportions, he was forced to give up everything he held dear in order to stop it. Despite his initial efforts, Nolan fell into despair when he realized that the ever-expanding Calamity would soon find its way to his world — to his daughter, Layla. But he could not give up. As he looked beyond the universe for a solution, he discovered a sliver of hope within himself: his soul. Thus, Nolan left everything behind and set out on his mission across the multiverse, scattering fragments of his soul as beacons to trap the Calamity. Through all of the pain he has endured, he never lost sight of his goal — his Layla.

skills.desc: Nolan's skills leave a Rift on the ground that lasts 5s and slows enemies that pass through it by 30%. When a Rift comes into contact with another Rift, they activate and pull enemies to their center, then deal 240 (+140% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage after a short delay. Each time a Rift activation hits an enemy hero or creep, Nolan gains 20 Energy. If an enemy is hit by multiple Rift activations simultaneously, damage after the first hit is reduced by 40%. Cosmic Leap: If Nolan does not deal or take damage for 5s (damage to/from minions or creeps does not count), he enhances his next Basic Attack to dash to the target, dealing 120% Total Physical Attack Physical Damage and leaving a Rift.

Nolan cuts a rectangular area in front of him with his cosmic gauge, dealing 230/280/330/380/430/480 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and leaving a Rift at the first enemy hit. Enemies hit are also slowed by 30% for 1s.

Nolan charges in the target direction and slashes with his cosmic gauge, dealing 70/100/130/160/190/220 (+13% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and leaving a Rift. This skill can be used to cross thin walls.

Nolan removes all debuffs on himself and slashes at the target location 3 times, dealing 130/170/210 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with each slash while leaving 3 Rifts and slowing targets hit by 30% for 0.5s. The Rifts activate automatically while Nolan dashes backward.

story.title: The Performer Who Brought Joy Back to Castle Aberleen
story.lore: Cici, the lead act of the Whimsical Wonders theater troupe, accompanied by her magical companion Yoyo, embarked on the annual tour. She chose Castle Aberleen, the city where her aunt was once called the Queen of Revelry, as her first destination. But upon arrival, Cici discovered that the city had forbidden unsanctioned performances of any kind, especially folk performances, and her aunt had been exiled when the law was enacted. Undaunted, Cici resolved to bring fun and wonderment back to the city. Inspired by her spirit, the long-muted performers of Castle Aberleen emerged from the shadows and took part in the most magnificent show the castle had ever witnessed.

skills.desc: Cici generates a stack of Delight after dealing damage, increasing her Movement Speed by 0.75% and Spell Vamp by 0.75% per stack, up to 10 stacks. At full stacks, both effects are doubled, granting up to 15% Movement Speed and 15% Spell Vamp.

Cici throws Yoyo at the nearest enemy within range and locks onto them for 3.5s, hitting them up to 10 times. Each hit deals 50–100 (+1% Extra Physical Attack per hit scaling) plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as Physical Damage. Cici can move and use other abilities while Yo-Yo Blitz is active.
Cici leaps to a target location. If she lands on an enemy, she deals 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them and can leap again in the target direction.

Cici throws Yoyo at a target enemy hero and links them with another nearby enemy hero, dealing 100 (+10% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, slowing them by 30%, and pulling them together for 4s. During this time, Cici can use Yo-Yo Blitz to attack both linked targets simultaneously. If only one target is within Yo-Yo Blitz's range, Cici attacks that target twice, but the second attack deals only 25% damage.

story.title: The Lazy Fox Who Had to Work One Last Time
story.lore: Chip was once a small fox trying to survive in the harsh desert of Ageltha. By chance, he was discovered by Dr. Baker and brought to the 1718 Laboratory, where he was genetically enhanced with superior intelligence and tasked with testing the laboratory's portal technology. But he was lazy by nature and just wanted to enjoy a peaceful life. When an internal power struggle arose in the secret lab, Chip's life was turned upside down and he was forced to make tough decisions. He had to work one last time to return to the peaceful life he had always dreamed of — the golden beaches of the Agelta Coast, where he had hidden all his chips and waited for that day.

skills.desc: When out of combat, Chip eats potato chips to regenerate HP. After 5 bites, he finishes a bag and restores 150 (+15% of missing HP) HP. After finishing a bag, Chip cannot eat again for 5s.

Chip rams his hovercraft into the ground, dealing Magic Damage equal to 100 (+4% of target's Max HP) and applying Chip's Mark on enemy units hit. Upon hitting an enemy hero, Chip gains a 300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Shield that increases by 40% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next Basic Attack becomes ranged and also hits all nearby enemies with Chip's Mark, detonating the mark to deal 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stun each target for 0.6s.

Chip rushes forward for 2s, gaining up to 65% extra Movement Speed, then maintains maximum speed for an additional 2s. Chip's next Basic Attack during this state causes him to charge at an enemy, dealing 200 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and knocking them back slightly.

Chip drops a Main Portal on a target enemy hero, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and briefly slowing them by 25%. The Main Portal deals 2× damage and immobilizes the target for 1s after a short delay. Connecting Portals are simultaneously created near allied heroes and behind the allied base, remaining active for 10s. Allies can enter a Connecting Portal to teleport to the Main Portal's location and return through any active portal. Enemies can destroy the Main Portal. Chip also has a Special Skill — Why Walk? — allowing him to teleport between 4 fixed beacons placed around the map (cannot be used in combat).

story.title: The Thousand-Year Wanderer Searching for the Purest Wish
story.lore: Zhuxin is an enigmatic young woman from the city of Zhu'an, nestled in the mountains of the Cadia Riverlands. Using her Lantern of Spirits, she guides the ember butterflies and walks between life and death. She is able to hear the desires of mortal hearts, and those who can pass her trials will have their wishes granted. For nearly a thousand years, she has wandered in search of the purest wishes to fulfill, hoping to one day find her own. Legend has it that anyone who accepts her help will be subject to her trials, which can range from wagering entire fortunes to walking the line between life and death. Some attempt to get in her good graces, while others curse her as a malevolent witch, but she has never minded what others think. Once a pact has been made and the butterflies begin to dance, neither heaven nor earth, life nor death can stop her from fulfilling a wish.

skills.desc: Every time Zhuxin channels Lantern Flare, she converts the Mana spent into up to 15 Crimson Butterflies that follow her Spirit Lantern. After Zhuxin stops channeling Lantern Flare, the Crimson Butterflies gradually disappear, each restoring 3% of her Max Mana. Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana that does not scale with level.

Zhuxin deals 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack of Soul Snare. She also slows all enemy heroes hit by 20% and gains 20% extra Movement Speed herself for 1.5s.

Hold: Zhuxin continuously consumes Mana while the Spirit Lantern can be moved with the skill button, dealing 35 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (increased to 60% Total Magic Power against Minions) to all enemies in range every 0.33s and applying Soul Snare to enemy heroes hit. When an enemy hero accumulates 10 stacks of Soul Snare, the Crimson Butterflies capture them, lifting them airborne for 1s. Release: Zhuxin throws all captured enemies to the target location, dealing 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage plus 10% of the captured target's Max HP as Magic Damage to all enemies in the landing area. Subsequent hits on the same target deal 80% less damage. After a target is captured, Soul Snare cannot stack on them again for 4s.

Zhuxin blinks to the target location and enters a flying state, gaining a 500/750/1000 (+20% Total Magic Power) Shield. While flying, she creates an aura field around her for 6s that deals 60/75/90 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applies 1 stack of Soul Snare to enemies every 0.5s.

story.title: The Last Exorcist Who Walks Between the Mortal and the Immortal
story.lore: As the last descendant of the Exorcists of Nuo, Suyou carried the power of the immortal deity within his body, using it to guide the people toward enlightenment. He walked the mortal plane like a wandering swordsman — charming and uninhibited — but never forgetting that the power of Nuo comes from the faith of the people. And so, he went about purging evil from the hearts of men and safeguarding their hopes for the future. When the thunderous drums and gongs of the Nuo ritual once again sounded across the land, Suyou took up his sacred blade and two forms of himself — mortal and immortal — to answer the call.

skills.desc: Tap-casting any skill puts Suyou in his Mortal form, granting him 40 bonus Movement Speed and decreasing the interval between Basic Attacks. Hold-casting any skill puts him in his Immortal form, increasing Basic Attack damage to 125% and granting 20% Physical Damage Reduction. In Immortal form, for every 20 extra Physical Attack Suyou has, he gains an additional 1% Physical Damage Reduction (up to 40% total). Additionally, 1% Cooldown Reduction converts to 3 bonus Physical Attack.

Tap: Suyou throws his weapon in the target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. He then blinks to the weapon's location, catches it, and performs a slash in the opposite direction, dealing 375 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power and charges in the target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path. When hitting an enemy hero, he stops and stuns enemies in a rectangular area in front of him for 0.6s. The charge distance increases with hold time. Suyou can be steered while charging but the skill cannot be interrupted.

Tap: Suyou performs a sweeping attack with his weapon, dealing 300 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) plus 15% of the target's Lost HP as Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power to unleash 3 consecutive cleaves in a fan-shaped area. The first two strikes each deal 250 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, while the final strike deals 400 (+128% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and restores 150 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) HP for Suyou.

Tap: Suyou glides backward and swings his weapon in the target direction, dealing 420/460/500/540/580 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s. Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power to shoot a deadly arrow in the target direction, dealing 580/640/700/760/820 (+165% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target hit. The arrow's range increases with hold time. Note: Evil Queller functions as Suyou's Ultimate and can be upgraded up to 5 times starting from level 1.

story.title: The Sacred Beast of the Moniyan Empire, awakened after a millennium
story.lore: In the heart of the Imperial Sanctuary stood a statue that had endured for a thousand years, a symbol of the Moniyan Empire's past glories. Lukas, the Beast of Light, had sealed himself inside alongside Emperor Gaius's holy lance, waiting for a worthy descendant to awaken him. Even the mightiest mortals could not escape the inevitable — after Gaius passed away, the Beast of Light fell into deep sorrow for a very long time, but he never forgot his promise. Then one day, a young princess broke into the Sanctuary. As one of Gaius's lineage, Silvanna was able to draw the holy lance, and without fear or hesitation she invited the intimidating Beast to join her in pushing back the invading Abyss legions. Lukas could never acknowledge a human so easily, and a titanic battle ensued — but Silvanna did not fall back a single step, carrying the glory of Lumina City on her shoulders. The Beast of Light gazed into her blue eyes, full of hope and determination, and was reminded of the young Gaius. At that moment, the flame inside him that had gone cold for a thousand years ignited once more. He ceased his attack and chose to stand by the princess's side, vowing to rewrite the legend of the Beast of Light and illuminate every corner of the Moniyan Empire.

skills.desc: Lukas gains 0.5 Resolve per second passively and an additional 2 Resolve each time he deals damage to an enemy hero. While in Sacred Beast form, he consumes 10 Resolve per second; the transformation ends when all Resolve is depleted. Lukas must accumulate 100 Resolve before he can activate his Ultimate.

Passive: Basic Attacks enhance Flash Combo up to 2 times, each stack lasting 4s. Active: Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash Pulverize, dealing 220 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 5% of his Max HP when hitting a hero or minion. With 1 stack: Lukas briefly stuns the target and spins his tonfa hammers to deal 100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times, pulling the enemy toward him. With 2 stacks: Lukas briefly stuns the target and follows up with 2 attacks dealing 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, then spins his tonfa hammers to deal 100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times, gaining Control Immunity during this period. In Sacred Beast form, this skill becomes a tail swing dealing 220 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 5% of his Max HP when hitting a hero.

Lukas dashes in the target direction. In human form, the dash enhances his next Basic Attack, causing him to blink behind the target and deal Physical Damage, while also gaining increased Movement Speed, Attack Speed, and Attack Range. In Sacred Beast form, the dash becomes more powerful, knocking back enemies upon arrival and dealing increased Physical Damage, while also summoning sacred lightning that amplifies subsequent attacks.

Lukas transforms into his Sacred Beast form, briefly gaining Control Immunity during the transformation. His base Movement Speed increases by 30 and all attributes (HP, Physical Attack, Attack Speed, Physical & Magic Defense, and Attack Range) are increased by 15%. All his skills gain enhanced effects in this form. Use Again: While in Sacred Beast form, Lukas fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction (gaining Control Immunity during the cast) that explodes upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450 (+155% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

story.title: The proud descendant of the Great Serpent, protector of the Vonetis Sea
story.lore: Born as the descendant of the legendary Great Serpent, Kalea awakened the power of her heritage at an early age — but she could never control it. Her power would surge outward without warning, turning the seas upside down, much to the dismay of the creatures living there. Kalea firmly believed it was her weak, human-like body that was holding her back. If only she could take the form of the Great Serpent, no monster in the sea or on land would be a match for her. Kadita, who had been secretly watching over her, appeared and explained that Kalea could not simply shed her skin like a serpent. Determined, Kalea began secretly studying how Badang fought with his fists, quietly learning to use her hands while channeling the serpent's strength within. Though she tried to keep her distance from the villagers of Solari Isle, she found her power was inexplicably connected to them — whenever it surged outward, it always sought out those in need and healed them. One night, Solari Isle faced the storm of the century. A lone fishing boat, caught in the typhoon, was lifted high into the air by the waves. With a splash, Kalea leaped to action, grabbed the side of the boat, and gently deposited the fallen fishermen back on board with her tail. The Great Serpent's power surged from her body and flowed into them, healing them. Looking at her reflection in the parting waters — her tail swaying with purpose, her hands holding tightly onto the fishermen — she was no longer fixated on becoming the Great Serpent. She had finally found the purpose of the power she once sought to contain.

skills.desc: After casting any skill, Kalea creates a Water Zone at her current position. If she casts another skill while standing within a Water Zone, she absorbs it and enhances her next three Basic Attacks with unique effects. The first enhanced attack dashes toward an enemy, dealing Physical Damage. The second enhanced attack unleashes a flurry of strikes that deal Physical Damage and restore HP for herself and her nearest ally with the lowest health. The third enhanced attack sweeps the area with her tail, dealing AoE Physical Damage and creating a new Water Zone.

Kalea slams her fist into the ground, dealing Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them. Enemies hit at the center are knocked airborne for 0.8 seconds. When cast inside a Water Zone, this skill can be used a second time in quick succession.

Kalea dashes forward and grabs the first enemy hero she hits, going airborne and slamming them into the ground to deal Physical Damage. If Kalea hits an obstacle or the edge of a Water Zone during the dash, she instead triggers Rolling Wave — leaping into the air. Rolling Wave can then be cast again to dive at a target location, dealing Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne upon landing.

Kalea grabs a nearby enemy hero with her tail and leaps into the air, slamming down in the direction controlled by the joystick and dealing Physical Damage to the target and all nearby enemies upon impact. The player can choose the direction in which the enemy is slammed. In Serpent form, this skill's impact is amplified — launching the enemy farther and triggering aftershock damage in a small radius around the landing point.

story.title: The Phoenix Empress of Shendu, reborn to reclaim the Divine Capital
story.lore: Millennia ago, the woman who founded the Divine Capital drew upon the Ancient Ones' art of manipulating Yin and Yang, harnessing the phoenix spirit of her lineage to establish Shendu and become its first sovereign. She overexerted her power protecting the Cadia Riverlands and fell into a deep slumber at the bottom of the Lake of Reflection, her identity erased from history. A thousand years passed. Zetian knew herself only as a wandering orphan with no memory of where she came from — her earliest recollection was being found by the side of the Lake of Reflection by a humble merchant named Wu, who taught her to read, write, and feel compassion for all living things. Blessed with a keen intellect, Zetian climbed the empire's corridors of power through brilliantly composed political treatises and battlefield victories, gradually approaching the epicenter of power. Then one day, standing once more by the Lake of Reflection beneath Dragon's Ridge, a gust of wind stirred the water's surface and her reflection pulled her beneath the waves. There, she heard her own voice from a past life recount the lost history of Shendu's founding. At that moment, Zetian finally understood — she was not merely the heir to a throne, but the one who built it. The power that had once dissipated to protect the mortal world flowed anew at her fingertips, drawn by the collective will of her people. With a mere thought, peonies bloomed at her brow and a majestic phoenix spiraled upward from her fingertips. By Heaven's decree, Empress Zetian ascended her throne once more.

skills.desc: This passive has two components. Phoenix Crown: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with Phoenix Strike or Phoenix Descent, she gains 1% Spell Vamp for 5s, stacking up to 10 times. Celestial Robe: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who approaches too close while dealing 90 (+10×Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. She also gains a 300 (+20×Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Shield that lasts 3s. This effect has a 120s cooldown.

Zetian unleashes a Phoenix Wave in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave, up to 3 times in total. While casting, Zetian can use other skills. The 1st wave deals 150 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, the 2nd wave deals 150 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, and the 3rd wave deals 360 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage over a larger area and pulls enemies slightly toward the cast direction (not considered a control effect). Spell Vamp ratio is limited to 65% against Minions.

Zetian summons a Phoenix Spirit at the target location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The Phoenix Spirit hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.5s and reducing enemies' Magic Defense by 10% while revealing their surrounding area. While the Phoenix Spirit is active, Zetian can recast this skill to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect upon arrival.

Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 40% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes on the map, dealing 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.8s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time. She can cast other skills freely while channeling this ability.

story.title: The ancient sovereign who built the Abyss, now hunting its corrupted remnants
story.lore: Deep in the vast, dark depths of the Abyss, Obsidia hunts. The stench of rot emanates from ancient blood like beacons flickering in the darkness, marking the path of her prey — the Spawns of Decay. As her power grows, the bones of her weapon multiply, swaying in her wake. When she tracks down a Spawn of Decay, the hunt is already over. Another demon corrupted by dark power, another weakling who succumbed to the God of Darkness's temptation — having lost their reason, will, and self, their flesh and form completely warped into empty puppets. Obsidia had felt that power before. In ancient times, she had been a powerful warrior who used the dark arts to unify the world underground, granting power to those who submitted and leaving the bones of those who rebelled piled high. She named her kingdom the Abyss, and she became its one true sovereign. But she had forgotten that above rulers, there were gods — and power always carried a price. When Obsidia awakened from her dream, the Abyss had become a tool of the God of Darkness. Her subjects were thrown into the forefront of an endless conflict between light and darkness; barely one in ten survived, and those who did came to view her as a merciless goddess of death. The demons she had granted power had lost their reason and will, marching to their deaths in an eternal battle. Obsidia struck a devastating blow to the God of Darkness during its war against the God of Light, but she was mortally wounded in the process. Revived again, she now descends into the depths she once ruled, hunting the Spawns of Decay — not as their queen, but as their executioner.

skills.desc: Obsidia accumulates Bone Energy by attacking enemy heroes or minions (not jungle creeps). When enough Bone Energy is gathered, it condenses into Bone Shards, stacking up to a maximum cap. With each Basic Attack, all stored Bone Shards automatically strike the target, each dealing 6% Total Physical Attack Physical Damage and inheriting 6% of attack effects (lifesteal, slows, etc.). When Obsidia kills an enemy hero, she directly gains 1 Bone Shard. If Obsidia dies while holding more than one Bone Shard, she loses 10 Bone Shards. As Bone Shards accumulate, they enhance her active skills at specific thresholds.

Obsidia launches an Abyssal Bone Needle in the target direction, dealing 325 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and triggering Return to the Bone on the first enemy hero struck. At 5 Bone Shards, this skill is enhanced and the needle pierces through multiple enemies in a line.

Obsidia descends into the Abyss and enters Shadowmeld Form, gaining 500% Movement Speed for 0.3s, allowing her to reposition, dodge skills, or engage rapidly. At 12 Bone Shards, this skill is enhanced — granting her untargetable status for a brief moment during the dash. While Hunt of Bone is active, this skill's duration is extended to 1s and its cooldown is reduced by 33%.

Obsidia shoots Bones of Wrath in the target direction, dealing 125 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning the first enemy hero hit, then pulling herself to the target. The Bones of Wrath tether Obsidia to the enemy for 3s, preventing her from moving more than 4 units away. While tethered, the enemy cannot use displacement skills and their movement will drag Obsidia along. During this time, Obsidia can move through obstacles and continue using Basic Attacks and Phantom Shadowmeld, which also becomes enhanced for the duration.

story.title: The free-spirited cloud wanderer of the Agelta Drylands, bearer of rain and hope
story.lore: Amidst the windswept sands of the Agelta Drylands, a boy named Sora drifts as freely as the flowing clouds. Pure and free-spirited, he wields fists wreathed in ever-shifting clouds — sometimes as thunderclouds crackling with fierce lightning, other times accumulating into thick cumulus clouds to shield against the desert's fury. Adventure calls to Sora like an alluring song, drawing him deep into uncharted desert ruins where he seeks out mysterious wonders. Yet the people know that when droughts loom and despair takes hold, he will come riding the winds, bearing the precious rains their parched lands crave. Ninety-nine oases crossed, ninety-nine sandstorms weathered. In the heart of ancient ruins, where thunder calls, the mystical clouds gather. One day, deep within those ruins, Sora beheld a strange radiance pulsing at the center — a fragment of the very Twilight Orb whose explosion had once fractured the Agelta Drylands, its lingering energy still coursing through the hallowed space. This energy possessed the miraculous ability to transmute the abstract into reality; the unfulfilled dreams of all those cloud-seeking adventurers had been touched by its influence, crystallizing into the monuments surrounding him. An overwhelming surge of purpose flooded Sora's heart as he reached toward the energy core. In an instant, the clouds and illusions dissipated, streaming toward his outstretched hands — evaporating, expanding, spiraling skyward, condensing into living clouds. Now Sora continues his journey along the ancient Emerald Road, carrying rain-bearing clouds to every corner of the desert, and hope to every desperate tribe.

skills.desc: Sora gains 1 stack of Cloudstep each time he damages an enemy hero or their summons, lasting 6s. At 5 stacks, he can activate his Ultimate to ascend to either Thunder or Torrent form. After ascending, dealing damage to heroes grants Cloudstep stacks again; reaching 5 stacks while ascended unlocks his True Art. Thunder form converts 30% of Max HP into Physical Attack (at a ratio of 10% Max HP per attack point), adopting an assassin style. Torrent form converts 30% of Physical Attack into Max HP (gaining 10 HP per 1 Attack), adopting a tank style.

Base form: Sora strikes twice, dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, then lunges forward, dealing 240 (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage. He can dash after striking. Thunder form (Thunderflash): Sora strikes four times, dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, then lunges forward, dealing 240 (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage. He can move freely during this skill. Torrent form (Overwhelm): Sora strikes twice, dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 40%, then lunges forward, dealing 240 (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage and stunning enemies for 0.5s. Cannot move freely during the skill in Torrent form.

Base form: Sora leaps forward, stopping when hitting an enemy hero or reaching max range, dealing Physical Damage and slowing the enemy. Thunder form: Unchanged — the leap deals Physical Damage and slows the enemy on contact. Torrent form (Skyfall): Sora leaps forward, dealing Physical Damage and knocking enemies back to the landing point. He then smashes the ground, dealing Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.5s. Hitting a hero with the landing smash reduces this skill's cooldown by 2s.

Requires 5 Cloudstep stacks. Swipe Left to ascend into Thunder form for 10s: Sora gains a brief bonus Movement Speed and becomes untargetable during the ascension, then deals 250 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Swipe Right to ascend into Torrent form for 10s: Sora immediately gains Control Immunity and pulls in nearby enemies after a short delay, dealing 250 (+8% Total HP) Physical Damage. After ascending and collecting 5 more Cloudstep stacks, True Art is unlocked. Thunder True Art (Heaven's Wrath): Sora leaps into the air and strikes a target area 15 times, dealing 50 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage with each hit. He can move freely during this skill. Torrent True Art (Stormbind): Sora leaps into the air and strikes a target area 10 times, dealing 50 (+2% Total HP) Physical Damage per hit with a brief slow. He can move freely during this skill.

story.title: The elegant photographer of House Paxley, whose split soul became his greatest companion
story.lore: Marcel Paxley was born in the gloomy halls of Castle Aberleen, the estate of House Paxley — the most powerful and feared magical family in the Moniyan Empire. He inherited his father's potent dark magic, as well as his infamy: after a spate of family infighting, his father committed suicide to escape judgment, and Marcel was branded the 'son of a traitor.' His peers used violence to 'discipline' him, to mold him into a person worthy of the Paxley name, yet Marcel always smiled gently and stood up straight. Through it all, his lifeline was his mother — a woman from a removed branch of the family, enshackled to House Paxley through marriage, but with a soul that yearned for freedom. She loved embroidery and photography, and on one of Marcel's birthdays, she gifted him a camera, teaching him to frame a frozen moment and develop it into memory on film. Then she left. After his father's death, his mother endured every form of pressure the family could apply before finally securing a way out — but the family forced her to leave her magically gifted son behind. Marcel came home one day covered in wounds and found only her departing silhouette. She never looked back. The beatings continued until one near-death experience made Marcel reach instinctively for the camera hanging on the wall. His dark magic powers fully awakened — and in the same instant, a second soul was born inside the camera: Clemar, a torn fragment of Marcel's pain and grief, which had broken away from him and taken on a life of its own. Since then, they have gazed at the world through two viewfinders. Together, Marcel and Clemar believe pain is the best chemical for development, while imperfection defines true depth of field. Marcel serves as a distant cousin to Aamon and Gusion, and half-brother to Melissa through their shared mother. Now he stands with Clemar, looking through the viewfinder, ready to step forward into their future.

skills.desc: Clemar automatically photographs nearby enemy heroes on a 12-second cooldown per target. When triggered, the targeted enemy is briefly immobilized (Frozen Moment) and suffers True Damage equal to 5% of their Max HP. Marcel and his nearest allied hero each gain a shield equal to the True Damage dealt. Marcel's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 1 second per hit. Marcel's Basic Attacks also deal bonus Physical Damage scaling with his Total Physical Attack, Physical Defense, and Magic Defense. He cannot critically strike and does not benefit from bonus Attack Speed.

Clemar focuses on an area around Marcel. After a 2.5-second delay, the 'photo' is complete — dealing Physical Damage scaling with Marcel's Total Physical Attack, Physical Defense, and Magic Defense to all enemies caught in the area, and immobilizing them for 1 second. If Tracking Shot is active when this skill is cast, Clemar remains at the original position while Marcel repositions, allowing for split-camera plays. Enemies can escape by leaving the focus area before the shot fires.

Marcel enters Tracking Haste for 3 seconds, gaining bonus Movement Speed that significantly increases (up to 75%–112.5%) when moving toward enemy heroes. Reactivating this skill causes Marcel to dash in the target direction. If Framed Moment is currently active, recasting this skill causes Clemar to remain behind at its position while Marcel dashes away, maintaining the focus area remotely. This skill's Tracking Haste stacks with the movement speed bonus from Golden Hour.

After a brief delay, Clemar takes a wide-angle shot over a designated area lasting 3 seconds. All units inside the area — enemy heroes, minions, jungle objectives, turrets, and even the Lord and Turtle — enter Frozen Moment stasis. Frozen units cannot move, act, or receive damage from anyone except Marcel. All ranged Basic Attacks and projectiles (including ally projectiles) inside the area are suspended mid-flight and resume with 50% damage when the effect ends. Marcel himself is unaffected and can move freely inside the area, gaining Tracking Haste during this time. Golden Hour resets the cooldown of Platinum Snap for each enemy hero caught inside. This CC is not countered by Purify or CC Immunity.
